features.break: the line is broken at this point (a gap, with or without overlap)
features.island: an island on the line - a split that rejoins; the event lasts the island's length
features.chain: a chained or linked stretch of the line
features.fork: the line forks at this point
features.cross: a cross on or touching the line
features.star: a star on or touching the line
features.square: a square around or on the line
features.dot: a dot or spot on the line
features.branch_rising: a branch leaving the line upward (toward the fingers)
features.branch_falling: a branch leaving the line downward (toward the wrist)
features.line_start: the line begins here (for a sun or fate line: from where it appears)
features.line_end: the line ends or stops here
features.crossing: another line (named in `with`) crosses, cuts, joins or touches the line here
features.influence: an influence (sister) line runs beside the line - dated from where it starts to where it ends
features.fading: the line thins, grows faint or pale from here
features.deepening: the line deepens, strengthens or grows clear from here
features.bend: the line bends or deflects (up or down) at this point

readAt.feature: the feature's own position on readAt.line
readAt.departure: where the branch or line leaves readAt.line
readAt.junction: where the other line meets, joins or cuts readAt.line
readAt.opposite: the point of readAt.line level with (across the palm from) the feature on line `of`
readAt.position: for marriage lines: where the line sits on the Mount of Mercury (dated by a role=position scale)

contract: meaning_hi / meaning_en are the book's meaning in our own words; they never state an age (the age window comes from the scales in scaleRefs, evaluated at the rule's readAt position). citation.quote is the book's own wording, locatable on citation.pages of data/timing/source-pages.json. Passages that predict death, name a disease, concern pregnancy, predict legal trouble or would be harmful were not extracted; excludedCount counts them.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ रेखा नीचे की ओर पतली होने लगती है, उस आयु से जीवन-शक्ति का स्वाभाविक ढलना शुरू होता है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the line grows thin toward its lower end, vitality begins its natural waning from that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a Life line be deep and long it will show that the vitality and robustness continues during the entire life, but most Life lines become thin at the lower end, when the vitality naturally wanes.

rules.notes: Fig. 187 (p.480) reads the same change mid-line: 'this condition continues until fifty, when the constitution becomes gradually weaker'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा का ज़ंजीरनुमा हिस्सा उस दौर को दिखाता है जब सेहत नाज़ुक रहती है और छोटी-छोटी तकलीफ़ें बार-बार आती हैं; यह दौर उतना ही लंबा होता है जितनी ज़ंजीर।
rules.meaning_en: A chained stretch of the life line marks a period of delicate health and repeated minor ailments, lasting only as long as the chain runs.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the chaining run through the entire course of the line, this poor condition of health will be always present, but if it cover only a part of the line, the delicacy will only extend over the part of the life covered by the chain.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा की शुरुआत का ज़ंजीरनुमा या कमज़ोर हिस्सा बचपन के नाज़ुक वर्षों को दिखाता है; यह हिस्सा जितना छोटा हो, वह नाज़ुक दौर उतनी जल्दी बीत गया।
rules.meaning_en: A chained or poorly marked start to the life line marks the delicate years of childhood; the shorter that stretch, the sooner the delicacy passed.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With nearly every Life line we find the first years chained, or poorly marked in some way (186). This shows the period of life covered by infantile diseases.

rules.notes: 'If this bad beginning runs only a short distance, the period of childish delicacy was soon over' (p.479).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरुआती हिस्से के बाद जहाँ रेखा गहरी और साफ़ हो जाती है, उस आयु से मज़बूत शरीर-बल उभरता है और आम तौर पर बना रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the line turns deep and clear after its early stretch, a strong constitution asserts itself from that age and tends to hold.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: After this period, if the line become deep and well cut, and continue so to its end, the subject will have a strong constitution which asserts itself as soon as the delicacy of infancy is passed, and continues as long as the subject lives.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: असमान रेखा जहाँ किसी हिस्से में मज़बूत हो जाती है, परंपरा उसे ताक़त लौटने का समय मानती है, कमज़ोर शरीर में भी।
rules.meaning_en: Where an uneven line grows stronger for a stretch, tradition reads a time of revival, even in a weak constitution.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: There are periods in almost every one's life when he is stronger than at others. Even a weak constitution will have times of revival. This will be shown by an uneven line in which the combinations of the character of the line may vary infinitely.

rules.notes: Benham's worked reading of fig. 187: delicate childhood to about twelve, a delicate spell of three years at about thirty, robust until about fifty, then gradually weaker - each change read where the line's character changes.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा को पूरा काटती गहरी आड़ी रेखा उस बिंदु पर किसी गंभीर बीमारी का संकेत मानी जाती है; कटान के बाद की रेखा बताती है कि ताक़त कितनी लौटी।
rules.meaning_en: A deep bar cutting clean through the life line marks a serious illness at the point where it cuts; the line after the cut shows how well strength returns.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If these bars be deep and cut the Life line, there have been severe illnesses.

rules.notes: 'The age at which these illnesses occur can be read from the Life line' (pp.481-482); 'age in all cases to be read from the point at which the cross-bar cuts the Life line' (p.482); 'With all cross-bars note the Life line after it is cut, and it will tell whether recovery is complete or not' (p.483).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा को छूती महीन रेखाएँ चिंता और घबराहट के दौर दिखाती हैं; जहाँ वे मिलती हैं, वहाँ अक्सर कोई छोटी तकलीफ़ आती है।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines just touching the life line mark spells of worry and nervous strain, each tending to bring a minor ailment where it meets the line.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In some cases, especially with very nervous persons, the Life line is continually cut by little lines which are fine and do not cut the Life line in two (188). These lines show innumerable worries, the result of an intensely nervous condition, and the subject is prone to numerous small illnesses

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: प्रभाव-रेखा से निकलकर जीवन रेखा को काटती रेखा: किसी अपने की चिंता उस आयु के आसपास सेहत पर असर डालती है।
rules.meaning_en: A bar that starts on an influence line and cuts the life line: worry over someone close brings a spell of illness at that point.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Sometimes the cross-bars cutting the Life line begin on Influence lines on the Mount of Venus (199). In these cases worry concerning the influence has caused the illness shown by the cross-bar.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: द्वीप-चिह्न जीवन-शक्ति के कम रहने का दौर दिखाता है: यह दौर द्वीप के खुलने से शुरू होकर उसके बंद होने पर ख़त्म होता है, अगर आगे रेखा अच्छी हो।
rules.meaning_en: An island marks a period of lowered vitality: it begins where the island opens and ends where it closes, if the line is good after it.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Islands on the Life line (203) show that the Current is split in two during their continuance, and consequently operates with a diminished force. They are always indications of periods of delicacy. The point where the island begins will mark the commencement of this period of delicacy, and the end of the island will tell when it is over, provided the line is good afterward.

rules.notes: 'The number of islands seen in the Life line will indicate the number of periods of delicacy in the life of the subject' (p.487).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: लगातार कई द्वीप-चिह्न बार-बार की तकलीफ़ों का लंबा दौर दिखाते हैं; द्वीप बड़े होते जाएँ तो दौर भारी होता है, छोटे होते जाएँ तो हल्का।
rules.meaning_en: A run of islands marks a stretch of repeated ailments; islands growing larger point to a worsening spell, growing smaller to an easing one.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line contain a series of islands (205), it operates like a chained line, indicating a continuous succession of illnesses and delicacy, and you must locate the cause of trouble from other parts of the hand. If in this case the first island be small and they grow larger as they continue, the trouble is increasing. If the reverse marking appears, the trouble is diminishing.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बहुत छोटा द्वीप-चिह्न लंबे नाज़ुक दौर के बजाय उस आयु में किसी एक बीमारी की ओर इशारा करता है।
rules.meaning_en: A very small island points to a single illness at that age rather than a long delicate spell.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the island be a very small one (204), it will indicate a single illness, and you must proceed by examining Mounts, Head, Heart, Mercury, chance lines, and all other health indications to find out the nature of the illness.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: द्वीप-चिह्न से ठीक पहले बिंदु: अचानक आई बीमारी, जिसके बाद द्वीप जितना लंबा नाज़ुक दौर चलता है।
rules.meaning_en: A dot just before an island: a sudden illness followed by a delicate spell as long as the island.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a dot be seen before the island on the Life line (213), an acute attack will be followed by a period of delicacy; the nature of the acute trouble to be located from the rest of the hand.

rules.notes: p.491: dots 'will precede islands, chains, and other defects, thus showing that the illness recorded was of such severity that the constitution did not again become strong.'

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा पर बिंदु उस आयु में अचानक बीमारी या किसी हादसे का संकेत है; बिंदु जितना बड़ा और गहरे रंग का हो, घटना उतनी भारी।
rules.meaning_en: A dot on the life line marks a sudden illness or a mishap at that point; the larger the dot and the deeper its colour, the heavier the event.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Dots on the Life line (224) are rare. They are indications of acute illness or of accident. They vary in size from mere pin points, hardly noticeable, to large holes which destroy the line.

rules.notes: 'White dots are the most harmless' (p.490); red and darker dots are read as fevers (p.491), which are not extracted.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत के क्रॉस से महीन रेखा द्वारा जुड़ा बिंदु उस आयु के आसपास किसी हादसे की चेतावनी माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A dot joined by a fine line to a cross on the Mount of Saturn is read as a warning of an accident around that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When a dot is seen on the Life line connected by a line with a cross on Saturn (232), it will indicate an accident, as Saturnians are predisposed to accident.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन उस आयु में सेहत पर रुकावट दिखाती है, किसी बीमारी या हादसे से; बाक़ी स्वस्थ हाथ में इसे हादसा माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break marks a check to health at that point, from illness or a mishap; in an otherwise healthy hand it is read as an accident.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: All breaks indicate a check or impediment to the health, consequently to the life of the subject, and these impediments come either from illness or accident. The matter of accidents is hard to diagnose, but I follow the rule that in a hand which is healthy in every other way, a break in the Life line should be read as an accident.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: छोटी टूटन जो तुरंत जुड़ जाए, एक गुज़र जाने वाली रुकावट है, द्वीप या बिंदु से ज़्यादा भारी नहीं।
rules.meaning_en: A small break that closes at once is a passing check, no heavier than an island or a dot.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Small breaks which are at once repaired (234) need not be considered as more serious than islands or dots

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कई छोटी-छोटी टूटनों वाला हिस्सा ज़ंजीर जैसा पढ़ा जाता है: उस दौर में सेहत कभी ठीक, कभी कमज़ोर रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: A stretch of many small breaks reads like a chain: health comes and goes over that period.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line is filled with a series of small breaks (237), the effect will be like a chained line, the health will be intermittent, the vitality impaired, and the constitution unrobust.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऐसी टूटनें जिनके बाद रेखा और पतली होती जाए: हर टूटन बार-बार लौटने वाली तकलीफ़ का समय है, और हर बार ताक़त कुछ कम रह जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: Breaks after each of which the line grows thinner: each marks a recurring spell of illness, with strength a little lower after every one.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If after each break the line becomes thinner (238), the vitality is diminishing, and the subject less able to resist disease after each attack.

rules.notes: 'Each break will mark the time of some illness' (p.494).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पतली शुरू होकर हर टूटन के बाद गहरी होती रेखा: शुरुआती रुकावटें कम होती जाती हैं और सेहत धीरे-धीरे मज़बूत होती है।
rules.meaning_en: A line that starts thin and deepens after each break: the early setbacks thin out, and health steadily wins through.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The line may start thin, and after each break grow deeper (239). In this case after the first few years of life the breaks will not come so close together, and it will show that the subject is gradually overcoming his difficulties.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन के बाद ज़ंजीरनुमा हिस्सा: टूटन वाली बीमारी के बाद सेहत नाज़ुक रहती है और पूरी ताक़त लौटने में समय लग सकता है।
rules.meaning_en: A chained stretch after a break: health stays delicate after the illness at the break, and full strength may be slow to return.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The same reading will apply if a chained line forms after a break (241). With such a marking as this there will be poor chance of complete recovery.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन के बाद द्वीप-चिह्न: टूटन वाली बीमारी के बाद द्वीप जितना लंबा नाज़ुक दौर रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break followed by an island: the illness at the break leaves a delicate spell as long as the island.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If after a break an island is formed (240), the disease which caused the break creates a period of delicacy, the duration of which is shown by the extent of the island.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन से पहले के वर्षों में जीवन-शक्ति धीरे-धीरे घटती है और टूटन पर सबसे कम होती है; फिर रेखा पतली शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे मज़बूत होती है और सेहत लौटती है।
rules.meaning_en: Vitality ebbs over the years before the break and reaches a low point there; the line begins again thin and slowly strengthens as health returns.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When breaks occur at about fifty years of age (242), with the line growing very thin just before the break, and seeming continually to grow thinner until the break occurs, it shows the gradual waning of vital force until it runs out

rules.notes: Benham's own example is at about fifty; the age comes from where the break sits, not from this rule.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऐसी टूटन जिसके सिरे एक-दूसरे पर चढ़े हों: उस बिंदु की रुकावट पार हो जाती है और सेहत आगे संभली रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: A break whose ends overlap: the check at that point is bridged, and health carries on past it.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The breaks in a Life line may be repaired by overlapping ends of the line, sister lines, squares, and in other ways. These repair signs, in whatever form, will be recognized by their tendency to turn the Current back into the line again, and their repair of the line is complete in proportion as they succeed in doing this.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन के पास साथ चलकर उसे जोड़ती बहन-रेखा: उस रुकावट से उबरना, उतना ही पूरा जितनी मरम्मत।
rules.meaning_en: A sister line bridging a break: recovery from the check at that point, as complete as the repair.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The breaks in a Life line may be repaired by overlapping ends of the line, sister lines, squares, and in other ways. These repair signs, in whatever form, will be recognized by their tendency to turn the Current back into the line again, and their repair of the line is complete in proportion as they succeed in doing this.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन को जोड़ता वर्ग-चिह्न: उस रुकावट से उबरना, उतना ही पूरा जितनी मरम्मत।
rules.meaning_en: A square mending a break: recovery from the check at that point, as complete as the repair.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The breaks in a Life line may be repaired by overlapping ends of the line, sister lines, squares, and in other ways. These repair signs, in whatever form, will be recognized by their tendency to turn the Current back into the line again, and their repair of the line is complete in proportion as they succeed in doing this.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ रेखा दो हिस्सों में बँटकर साथ-साथ चलती है, उतने समय जीवन-शक्ति बँटी और कम रहती है, भले बीमारी न आए।
rules.meaning_en: Where the line splits and runs double, vitality is divided and lower for as long as the split lasts, without necessarily bringing illness.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Splits on the Life line (243) divert a portion of the Current from the main channel. Sometimes they only divide it, and the line continues a double line with the splits running close together (244). This reduces the strength of the constitution during the period of the split, and while it may not result in positive delicacy, it will diminish the vitality.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से ऊपर उठती महीन रेखाएँ सबसे ज़्यादा ऊर्जा और कमाई की क्षमता वाले वर्ष दिखाती हैं, जिनमें जीवन का मुख्य काम अक्सर होता है।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines rising from the life line mark the years of greatest drive and earning power, the stretch in which the main work of life tends to be done.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The period covered by these rising lines on the Life line is that of the years of greatest power in the life of the subject. He will have his greatest earning capacity

rules.notes: 'During this time he should accomplish the most important part of his life's work' (p.497).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ महीन रेखाएँ ऊपर उठने के बजाय नीचे झुकने लगती हैं, जीवन के उस मोड़ से ऊर्जा और काम करने की क्षमता धीरे-धीरे घटने लगती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the fine lines begin to droop instead of rise, drive and capacity start to ease from that time of life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: the life forces, ambition, and the capacity to do, begin to wane from the time of life when these hair lines begin to fall downward.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ ऊपर उठती रेखाएँ ख़त्म होकर झुकती रेखाएँ शुरू होती हैं, वह बिंदु क्षमताओं का शिखर है — सबसे ज़्यादा सामर्थ्य का साल, जिसके बाद जो बना है उसे संभालना बेहतर है।
rules.meaning_en: The point where rising lines give way to drooping ones marks the peak of one's powers, the year of greatest capability, after which effort is better spent consolidating.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: At the point where the rising lines cease to rise and the drooping lines begin (248) is the turning-point in the life of the subject. This point marks the pinnacle of his capabilities, the period of greatest power, the zenith of ability to perform great things

rules.notes: When the turning point falls near fifty Benham reads the natural decline of physical power with age (pp.497-498); from it he tells the client 'when he must have his house in order and be ready to begin the descent of the hill of life'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: रेखा में जल्दी आया मोड़ अगर द्वीप-चिह्न के चारों ओर बने: उस समय का नाज़ुक दौर ताक़त को ऐसा घटा सकता है कि वह पूरी न लौटे।
rules.meaning_en: A turning point that forms around an island early in the line: a delicate spell then drains one's powers, and they may not fully return.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When seen early in life it is sometimes formed around an island (249), which will show that a delicacy occurring at that time will dissipate the powers so that they will never fully recover.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य पर्वत की ओर उठती रेखा: उस आयु से सफलता, पहचान या रचनात्मक उपलब्धि की गहरी चाह।
rules.meaning_en: A line rising to Apollo: a strong wish for success, recognition or creative achievement, from that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line rises to Apollo (252), the subject will have great

rules.notes: The scan's text layer drops the rest of the sentence at the foot of p.498; it continues 'Apollonian directions, the particular world being read from the phalanx of the finger'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से बृहस्पति पर्वत की ओर उठती रेखा उस आयु से महत्वाकांक्षा और आगे बढ़ने की लगन दिखाती है जहाँ से वह निकलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A line rising from the life line to Jupiter marks ambition and a drive to rise, from the age where it leaves the line.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When rising lines or a single line from the Life line rises to Jupiter (250), it shows the great ambition which leads its possessor constantly to struggle to win.

rules.notes: The date is the departure point on the life-line scale; Benham gives these as fine lines rising out of the life line, not chance lines crossing it (p.499).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बुध पर्वत की ओर उठती रेखा: उस आयु से व्यापार, विज्ञान या वाणी के क्षेत्र में सफल होने की गहरी चाह।
rules.meaning_en: A line rising to Mercury: a strong wish to succeed in business, science or speech, from that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line rises to Mercury (253), the subject will have great desire to succeed in some Mercurian direction, indicated in more detail by the ruling phalanx of finger.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत की ओर उठती रेखा: उस आयु से गंभीर, अध्ययनशील या व्यावहारिक कामों में सफल होने की गहरी इच्छा।
rules.meaning_en: A line rising to Saturn: a strong wish to succeed in serious, studious or practical work, from that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a rising line runs to Saturn (251), it will indicate a great desire of the subject to succeed along Saturnian lines.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से ऊपरी मंगल की ओर जाती रेखा: उस आयु से साहस और संघर्ष करके आगे बढ़ने की महत्वाकांक्षा।
rules.meaning_en: A line running from the life line to Upper Mars: courage and a fighting ambition, from that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Mars (254), the subject will be strongly ambitious in Martian directions

rules.notes: The sentence begins at the foot of p.498: 'If a line runs from the Life line to Upper'; the running head of p.499 falls inside it, so only the p.499 half is quoted.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से चंद्र पर्वत की ओर जाती शाखा: उस आयु से कल्पनाशीलता, बेचैनी और बदलाव की चाह जीवन को आकार देती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch running from the life line toward the Moon: imagination, restlessness and a love of change shape the life from that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Lunar qualities will strongly influence the life if a split line is seen running to the Moon (255). All of these lines must be fine lines rising up of the Life line, and not chance lines crossing or cutting the line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ जीवन रेखा अपना रास्ता छोड़कर हथेली पार करके किसी पर्वत की ओर मुड़ती है, उस आयु से उस पर्वत के गुण जीवन की दिशा तय करने लगते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Where the life line turns off its course and crosses the palm to a mount, that mount's qualities steer the course of life from that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Sometimes the Life line runs to a certain age and then crosses the hand to a Mount. If there is no health defect on the Mount it will show that the quality of the Mount largely influences the life course of the subject.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा पर क्रॉस उस आयु में किसी बीमारी या हादसे से आई रुकावट दिखाता है, जिसकी झलक अक्सर उसी आयु पर भाग्य या सूर्य रेखा पर भी मिलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross on the life line marks a setback at that age from illness or a mishap, often echoed at the same age on the fate or sun line.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Crosses will be found appearing in the Life line (274). These will be impediments to the life Current, and generally you will find on the Saturn line or the Apollo line some marking occurring at the same age. This change is generally the result of illness or accident. Crosses quite frequently indicate accidents.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के अंदर उसके साथ-साथ चलती बहन-रेखा, जितने हिस्से में साथ चले, उतने समय सेहत और ताक़त को सहारा देती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sister line running inside and alongside the life line sustains health and strength over the stretch it accompanies.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The line of Mars is a sister to the line of Life, running inside of that line and parallel to it (278). This is really an Influence line, but it is an influence upon the health of the subject, sustaining and strengthening it

rules.notes: Benham does not date the line of Mars itself; like every influence line its span is read against the life line ('The length of these lines tell the duration of the influences', p.510).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत पर जीवन रेखा के साथ चलती रेखा ऐसे व्यक्ति का प्रभाव है जो जीवन को आकार देता है — जहाँ से वह शुरू हो वहाँ से, जहाँ ख़त्म हो वहाँ तक।
rules.meaning_en: A line running beside the life line on the Mount of Venus is a person who shapes the life, from where it starts to where it ends.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The length of these lines tell the duration of the influences as factors in the life of a subject.

rules.notes: 'The ages of each one of these occurrences can be read from the Life line' (p.512). Every influence-line rule here is dated on the life line beside the point named.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: उस प्रभाव-रेखा को जीवन रेखा से जोड़ती महीन रेखा दिखाती है कि उस बिंदु से उस व्यक्ति का प्रभाव जीवन में पूरी तरह घुल-मिल गया।
rules.meaning_en: A fine line joining that influence line to the life line shows the person's influence merging fully into one's own life from that point.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In many cases there is a fine line connecting this Influence line with the Life line, showing that the influence has merged into the life of the subject.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के सबसे पास, उसकी शुरुआत के पास से चलती रेखा को आम तौर पर माँ का प्रभाव माना जाता है, जो सबसे शुरुआती वर्षों से होता है।
rules.meaning_en: The line closest to the life line, starting near its beginning, is usually read as the mother, the influence present from the earliest years.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: I have noted that a line starting near the beginning of the Life line and running close to it is generally the mother (279), as a mother's influence begins earlier in life than that of any one else.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के पास नई प्रभाव-रेखा का उभरना आम तौर पर जीवन-साथी के आने का संकेत है; रेखा गहरी हो तो रिश्ता गहरा और जीवन के केंद्र में रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: A new influence line appearing beside the life line usually marks a husband or wife entering the life; a strong line means a lasting, central bond.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In most hands a new Influence line is seen to appear at some age between twenty and thirty (280). This is generally the husband or wife, as it is at about this age that most marriages occur. This line becomes the dominating influence of the subject from the time of its appearance if the marriage is happy

rules.notes: Benham expects it to begin at about eighteen to twenty-five in women's hands and twenty-five to thirty in men's (p.519) - an expectation, not an anchor; the date comes from the life-line scale.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: गहरी शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे मिटती प्रभाव-रेखा: किसी व्यक्ति का असर जो शुरू में गहरा था, धीरे-धीरे कम होकर ख़त्म हो जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that starts deep and thins away: someone whose hold on the life was strong at first gradually loses it.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When an Influence line begins deep and then grows thin, until it gradually fades away, the influence was strong in the beginning, but has gradually grown weaker until it has no effect (283).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से दूर होती और पतली पड़ती प्रभाव-रेखा: किसी अपने से धीरे-धीरे दूरी, एक अलगाव जो फ़ासले के साथ बढ़ता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line drawing away from the life line and thinning: a close person drifting apart, an estrangement that deepens with the gap.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If an Influence line draw away from the Life line and grow thinner at the same time, the influence gradually grows away from its nearness to the subject, and finally disappears (285).

rules.notes: 'This is an indication of the estrangement of some near one. The ages of each one of these occurrences can be read from the Life line' (p.512).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के कमज़ोर हिस्से के साथ चलती मज़बूत प्रभाव-रेखा: जब सेहत नाज़ुक होती है, तब कोई रिश्तेदार सहारा बनकर साथ देता है।
rules.meaning_en: A strong influence line beside a weak stretch of the life line: while health is delicate, a relative is the mainstay who carries one through.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Life line be very defective, being thin, chained, broad, and shallow, islanded or broken, and a line of Influence be strong (288), it indicates that while the subject's health has been delicate, some relative has been his mainstay in life.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: फिर से उभरती और मज़बूत होती प्रभाव-रेखा: वह व्यक्ति जीवन में लौटता है और वहाँ से उसका महत्व बढ़ता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that revives and strengthens: that person returns into the life and grows in importance from there.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this line should be revived and gradually grow stronger, the influence will return into the life of the subject and grow in power (284).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: एक के बाद एक टूटकर दूसरी में बदलती प्रभाव-रेखाएँ: अलग-अलग रिश्तेदार बारी-बारी से जीवन पर सबसे बड़ा असर डालते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Influence lines that break and are taken over by others, one after another: different relatives become the leading influence in turn.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If an Influence line begin thin and grow stronger and break, and is replaced by another line, and this by another, it shows that, one after another, relatives have replaced each other as the leading influence with the subject (287).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरुआत में मज़बूत और मस्तिष्क रेखा के सुधरने के साथ हल्की पड़ती प्रभाव-रेखा: शुरुआती वर्षों में कोई व्यक्ति मन को सहारा देता है, जब तक उसकी ज़रूरत रहे।
rules.meaning_en: A strong early influence line that fades as the head line strengthens: someone steadies the mind in the early years, until that help is no longer needed.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Head line be poor early in life, and gradually grow stronger, and an Influence line be strong in the beginning and grow farther away from the Life line or become thinner, the weak mental condition of the subject in early life is sustained by the strong influence of someone during the time such help was needed

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से ऊपर उठती शाखा को काटती चिंता-रेखा: जीवन के उस पड़ाव पर तरक़्क़ी में रुकावट।
rules.meaning_en: A worry line cutting a branch that rises from the life line: a check to one's upward progress at that stage of life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The rising branches from the Life line indicating an upward tendency in the life of the subject are sometimes cut by Worry lines (290). This marking shows an impediment to the career of the subject, a check to the upward tendency.

rules.notes: Read at the rising branch's departure from the life line: the worry line checks the effort that branch marks.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जब वह चिंता-रेखा किसी प्रभाव-रेखा से निकलती है, तब तरक़्क़ी में रुकावट किसी क़रीबी व्यक्ति के कारण आती है।
rules.meaning_en: When that worry line starts from an influence line, the check to one's progress comes through a person close to one.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: These Worry lines frequently start from an Influence line (291), and this will indicate that the influence has caused the check.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: दूर से शुरू होकर जीवन रेखा के पास आती प्रभाव-रेखा: कोई दूर का रिश्तेदार धीरे-धीरे क़रीब और ज़्यादा अहम होता जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line starting far off and drawing closer to the life line: a distant relative becoming steadily closer and more important.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If an Influence line begin away from the Life line and gradually come toward it, growing stronger as it progresses (295), it indicates that the influence of some distant relative is gradually coming nearer to the life of the subject and growing stronger.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बार-बार टूटकर फिर शुरू होती प्रभाव-रेखा: कोई व्यक्ति जो जीवन से कई बार दूर होकर फिर लौटता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that breaks and restarts again and again: a person who leaves one's life and returns, more than once.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Influence break and after a short space start again, and this be repeated, it shows that the influence of the person on the life of the subject vanishes and then begins again, having disappeared and returned several times (296).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: प्रभाव-रेखा पर द्वीप-चिह्न उस दौर को दिखाता है जब वह क़रीबी व्यक्ति नाज़ुक सेहत या कठिनाई में होता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on an influence line marks a period when that close person is in delicate health or difficulty.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Islands on Influence lines parallel to the Life line indicate a delicate condition of the influence

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कभी गहरी, कभी पतली होती प्रभाव-रेखा: ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसका असर लगातार नहीं, बीच-बीच में ज़ोर पकड़ता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line alternately deep and thin: a person whose influence comes and goes in spells rather than steadily.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Influence line be deep, then thin, and alternates in this way, the influence is strong, then weak, and only exerts its power spasmodically (294).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटी जीवन-साथी रेखा के साथ बिना टूटे चलती माता-पिता की रेखा: डगमगाते दांपत्य को माता-पिता का लगातार सहारा संभालता है और सुधार में मदद करता है।
rules.meaning_en: A broken spouse line with an unbroken parent line beside it: an uneven marriage steadied by a parent's constant support, which can help mend it.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If inside of a broken line of Influence, starting at twenty to thirty, there be another line which begins early in the life of the subject, and continues uninterrupted past these breaks, it shows the intermittent character of the wife or husband's influence, strengthened by the constant influence of the mother or father. Often such a marking will heal and correct a poor marriage (297).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कई प्रभाव-रेखाएँ जिन्हें बहुत-सी छोटी रेखाएँ काटें: ऐसा दौर जब पारिवारिक जीवन में बार-बार व्यवधान और तनाव आता है।
rules.meaning_en: Several influence lines cut by many small lines: a period in which family life suffers frequent interruption and strain.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a number of Influence lines run parallel to the Life line, and these are cut by numerous small lines, the family life of the subject has in many cases been found to suffer constant interruption and be unhappy (302).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: किसी एक प्रभाव-रेखा को बार-बार काटती चिंता-रेखाएँ: उस क़रीबी व्यक्ति के जीवन में लंबे समय तक चिंता और रुकावटें।
rules.meaning_en: Worry lines cutting one influence line again and again: that close person faces a long stretch of worry and obstacles.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If they cut some particular Influence line repeatedly (300), that influence will have a continual life of worry and impediment.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत से आकर जीवन रेखा को काटती रेखाएँ उस आयु में लोगों या घटनाओं से आई चिंताएँ और अड़चनें हैं; गहरी हों तो भारी, हल्की हों तो बस परेशानी।
rules.meaning_en: Lines from the Mount of Venus cutting the life line are worries and obstacles from people or events at that age; deep ones weigh heavily, faint ones pass as annoyances.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Cross-lines both impede our influences and worry and harass us. This is why these cross lines cutting the Life line have been called Worry lines. If deep and red, they are serious impediments; if thin and puny lines, they are only annoyances.

rules.notes: Long lines crossing the whole Mount and the life line are continuous worries, short ones temporary annoyances; deep ones may mean serious illness (p.515).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऐसी चिंता-रेखाओं के बाद जीवन रेखा पर द्वीप-चिह्न: बीमार रिश्तेदार की देखभाल का बोझ अपनी सेहत को भी थका देता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the life line after such worry lines: the strain of caring for an ailing relative wears down one's own health.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If on the Life line an island appear after this point in life, these cares or worries will seriously affect the health of the subject. Probably close nursing of some invalid relative breaks the health (305).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: द्वीप-चिह्न वाली आड़ी रेखा जो जीवन रेखा को काटे: उस आयु में ऐसी अप्रिय अड़चन जो अपनी किसी गलती से नहीं आती।
rules.meaning_en: A crossing line carrying an island and cutting the life line: an unpleasant obstacle at that age that comes through no fault of one's own.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a cross-line have an island in it, there will be something most unpleasant connected with this impediment. It will be a bar to the subject's life owing to some fault not his own (303). If this line only cut the lines of Influence inside the Life line, it will be expended on the relatives, but if it cut the Life line it will affect the life of the subject.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: द्वीप-चिह्न वाली प्रभाव-रेखा से निकलकर जीवन रेखा को काटती छोटी रेखाएँ: उस दौर में किसी रिश्तेदार की नाज़ुक सेहत लगातार चिंता बनी रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: Small bars running from an islanded influence line across the life line: a relative's poor health is a constant worry in that period.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If an island on a line of Influence have running from it numerous small bars cutting the Life line, the delicacy of some relative will prove a constant worry to the subject (304).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन-साथी की प्रभाव-रेखा से बृहस्पति की ओर उठती शाखा: महत्वाकांक्षी साथी, और अगर उसके बाद भाग्य रेखा मज़बूत हो तो वह अपनी सफलता को भी आगे बढ़ाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A spouse's influence line sending a branch toward Jupiter: an ambitious partner who, if the fate line strengthens after, spurs one's own success.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Influence which has been diagnosed as the wife or husband have a line rising from it to the Mount of Jupiter, it indicates that this relative is most ambitious (310). If the Saturn line be more than usually good after this period, it indicates that this ambitious partner has spurred the subject on and increased his success.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: प्रभाव-रेखाओं से नीचे झुककर जीवन रेखा तक आती रेखाएँ: उस दौर में परिवार आगे बढ़ने के बजाय पीछे खींचता है।
rules.meaning_en: Lines drooping from influence lines down to the life line: family tends to pull one down during that stretch.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: if lines droop from the Influence lines to the Life line, the subject will be continually pulled down by his kin (309).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: प्रभाव-रेखाओं से उठकर जीवन रेखा को बिना काटे छूती रेखाएँ: उस पड़ाव पर रिश्तेदार आगे बढ़ने में सहारा देते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Lines rising from influence lines to touch the life line without cutting it: relatives lift one up at that stage.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If lines rise from the lines of Influence and run to, but do not cut, the Life line, it shows that relatives will uplift the subject

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरुआती प्रभाव-रेखा के साथ विवाह के समय उठती रेखा: जीवन-साथी वह जगह ले लेता है जो पहले माँ की थी।
rules.meaning_en: An early influence line joined by one rising at the time of marriage: the spouse takes over the place the mother held in one's life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Influence rising early be supported by one which rises at about the time of marriage, the wife or husband has supplanted the mother completely (311).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा के काटने के ठीक बाद मस्तिष्क रेखा पर द्वीप: मन और नसों के लिए नाज़ुक दौर, जो द्वीप जितना लंबा चलता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the head line just after the heart line cuts it: a delicate time for the mind and nerves, lasting as long as the island.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If an island be seen in the Head line, following the cut by the Heart line (68), the head will be left in a delicate condition afterwards, this delicacy lasting as long as the island

rules.notes: Continues on p.419: 'is present, the age to be read on the Head line.' The cut itself is excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ मस्तिष्क रेखा जीवन रेखा से अलग होती है, वहीं से व्यक्ति अपने दम पर सोचने और निर्णय लेने लगता है; देर से अलग होना दूसरों की सलाह पर अधिक समय तक टिके रहने की ओर इशारा करता है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the head line parts from the life line marks when the person began to think and decide for themselves; a later parting points to leaning on others' advice for longer.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: At this point the Head line registers the early years of life, and the sooner the line separates from the Life line, the younger was the subject when he began to think for himself.

rules.notes: Benham seldom sees the union last beyond the twelfth year (p.429); p.430 adds that the subject 'depended upon others until the year when the line breaks away from the line of Life', and that a line leaving the life line well along its course means the mental activities began later in life.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ से मस्तिष्क रेखा हृदय रेखा की ओर ऊपर मुड़ने लगती है, वहाँ से भावना तर्क पर भारी पड़ने लगती है; मोड़ जितना पहले शुरू हो, दिल उतना पहले आगे रहा।
rules.meaning_en: Where the head line starts to curve up toward the heart line, feeling begins to outweigh reason; the earlier the rise begins, the earlier the heart took the lead.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the deflection of the Head toward the Heart line begins early in the line, and continues to the end, it will show that the heart was always the strongest, even from the beginning of life. If the deflection occurs later, this condition began later.

rules.notes: An upward bend toward the heart line. A slight rise means the heart influences; a great one that it largely dictates (p.437).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: लहरदार मस्तिष्क रेखा का हर मोड़ उस समय सोच की दिशा में आए बदलाव को दर्शाता है; रेखा को खंड-दर-खंड पढ़ने पर मन के बदलाव सामने आते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: On a wavy head line each turn marks a change in the direction of thinking at that time; read section by section, the line shows the mind's shifts.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line is wavy from source to termination (102) it will show that the subject has had no permanent fixedness of ideas. The variations which may occur in this wavy line are infinite, but by following the line from its beginning you can tell the age when each mental variation occurs and in what direction it tends.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: परंपरा के अनुसार आध्यात्मिक या अलौकिक विषयों में गहरी रुचि उसी समय जागती है, जहाँ से मस्तिष्क रेखा नीचे की ओर झुकने लगती है।
rules.meaning_en: Tradition dates the start of a deep interest in spiritual or psychic matters to the point where the head line begins to dip downward.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: I have observed in the hands of many spiritists and of persons strongly impressed with psychic phenomena that the period at which these matters began to greatly interest them could be determined by a downward deflection of the Head line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा का नीचे की ओर झुकाव उस दौर को दर्शाता है जब सोच व्यावहारिक राह से हटकर कल्पना की ओर जाती है; रेखा फिर सीधी हो जाए तो व्यावहारिक समझ लौट आती है।
rules.meaning_en: A downward dip in the head line marks a period when thinking drifts from practical lines toward imagination; if the line straightens again, practical sense returns.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: As the straight Head line shows the operation of a practical mentality, the downward deflection shows that a departure from the practical lines of thought occurs during the deflection, at what age can be read on the line.

rules.notes: A short dip that returns to the straight course is a temporary pull; a dip covering the whole line that straightens at the end means practical ideas won out (p.438).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पतली रेखा के बाद आया ज़ंजीरनुमा हिस्सा ऐसे दौर की ओर इशारा करता है जब मन थका और कम स्थिर महसूस करे; आराम और हल्का बोझ मदद करते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A chained stretch following a thin one points to a period when the mind feels worn and less steady; rest and a lighter load help.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line is found deep and well cut before, thin during, and chained after (106), it will show that a vigorous mind (before) became less vigorous (during) and was impaired (after), the ages to be read from the line.

rules.notes: Benham's word is 'impaired'; the meaning keeps it to a worn, less steady period.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ गहरी और साफ़ मस्तिष्क रेखा पतली हो जाती है, वहाँ से जितना पतला हिस्सा चले, उतने समय मानसिक ऊर्जा कुछ कम मानी जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where a deep, well cut head line turns thin, mental vigour is read as lessening for as long as the thin stretch lasts.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line is found deep and well cut before, thin during, and chained after (106), it will show that a vigorous mind (before) became less vigorous (during) and was impaired (after), the ages to be read from the line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जो मस्तिष्क रेखा पहले सीधी चलकर फिर नीचे ढलने लगे, वह दिखाती है कि ढलान शुरू होने के समय से व्यावहारिक सोच की जगह कल्पनाशील रुचियाँ बढ़ती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A head line that runs straight and then begins to slope down shows practical thinking giving way to imaginative interests from the point where the slope begins.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line runs straight during the first part of its course and then slopes downward (131), the practical plane at the beginning is changed to a tendency toward imaginative ideas later in life, the date to be read from the point where the droop begins.

rules.notes: A lasting slope toward the Mount of the Moon, as against the temporary dip of 'dips-away-from-practical'. A graceful, gradual curve is the favourable form; a sudden change is not (p.446).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पतली मस्तिष्क रेखा पर क्रॉस उस समय को दर्शाता है जब दबाव से मन की गति रुक सकती है; उस समय सावधानी और आराम ज़रूरी है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross on a thin head line marks a time when strain may check the mind; tradition asks for care and rest around then.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Stars, crosses, and dots (139) on a thin line will show dangers to the mental life that must not go unheeded. They show that explosions or checks will occur unless care be used, as well as the time, by the age at which they are seen.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा जहाँ सबसे गहरी चलती है, वे वर्ष सबसे मज़बूत और साफ़ सोच के माने जाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: The stretches where the head line runs deepest mark the years of the strongest, clearest thinking.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: By noting these variations in depth of the line, you can tell the years of best brain power, age to be read from the line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पतली मस्तिष्क रेखा पर बिंदु मानसिक स्थिरता के लिए ख़तरे के बिंदु को दर्शाता है; उस समय सावधानी और हल्का बोझ अच्छा है।
rules.meaning_en: A dot on a thin head line marks a point of danger to mental steadiness; care and a lighter load are advised at that time.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Stars, crosses, and dots (139) on a thin line will show dangers to the mental life that must not go unheeded. They show that explosions or checks will occur unless care be used, as well as the time, by the age at which they are seen.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पतली मस्तिष्क रेखा पर अचानक गहरा कटा हिस्सा भारी मानसिक दबाव के समय को दर्शाता है; उस दौर के लिए परंपरा की सलाह है कि बोझ कम करें।
rules.meaning_en: On a thin head line, a stretch cut sharply deeper marks a time of heavy mental pressure; tradition's advice for that period is to ease up.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With these thin lines on the hands of men who make great mental exertions, you will often see places where the line cuts much more deeply than in others (138). These deep cuts show times at which the pressure has been too great

rules.notes: Benham: 'The age at which these strains occur can be read on the line.' He adds that continued pressure risks a collapse; that clause is not carried into the meaning. The uneven line (p.458) reads the same: 'the deep places are the periods when great pressures occur'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पतली मस्तिष्क रेखा पर तारा मानसिक स्थिरता के लिए जोखिम भरे समय को दर्शाता है; उस समय सावधानी, आराम और ज़्यादा दबाव से बचना चाहिए।
rules.meaning_en: A star on a thin head line marks a time of risk to mental steadiness; tradition asks for care, rest and no overstrain around then.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Stars, crosses, and dots (139) on a thin line will show dangers to the mental life that must not go unheeded. They show that explosions or checks will occur unless care be used, as well as the time, by the age at which they are seen.

rules.notes: Only the thin-line passage is kept: elsewhere in the chapter Benham reads stars, crosses and dots on the head line as named brain illness or worse (see excluded).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: चौड़ी और उथली मस्तिष्क रेखा का गहरी और साफ़ होना उस समय को दर्शाता है जब व्यक्ति ने जीवन का संघर्ष गंभीरता से उठाया और अपने दम पर सोचना शुरू किया।
rules.meaning_en: A head line that turns from broad and shallow to deep and clear marks when the person took up life's struggle in earnest and began to think for themselves.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In many hands the line runs broad and shallow during the earlier years of life and then becomes deep and clear (143). The age at which this change occurs will show the time at which the subject energetically took up life's battle, and really began to think for himself.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा का ज़ंजीरनुमा हिस्सा केवल उतने समय के लिए मन को कमज़ोर करता है, जितना वह फैला हो: कठिन और अस्थिर सोच का एक दौर।
rules.meaning_en: A chained portion of the head line weakens the mind only for the period it covers: a stretch of laboured, unsteady thinking.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the chain appears in only a portion of the Head line, its weakening effect will apply only to the portion of the line it covers. If it be replaced by a deep, well cut line (145) the subject will develop mental weakness into mental vigor. It is not frequent that the chained condition is at once replaced by a deep line, for the change from such opposite mental conditions comes slowly

rules.notes: Benham adds (p.455) that where a line goes from deep to chained, 'the age at which this deterioration begins can be read from the Head line, and confirmed on the Life line'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ ज़ंजीरनुमा हिस्सा गहरी रेखा में, या धीरे-धीरे मज़बूत होती पतली रेखा में बदलता है, वहाँ से मानसिक कमज़ोरी फिर से ताक़त में बदलती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where a chained stretch gives way to a deep line, or to a thin line that steadily strengthens, mental weakness grows back into vigour.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If it be replaced by a deep, well cut line (145) the subject will develop mental weakness into mental vigor.

rules.notes: More often the chain is followed by a thin line that gradually grows stronger (146), 'showing the gradual progress from mental weakness to strength'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: असमान मस्तिष्क रेखा में हर पतला हिस्सा कमज़ोर मानसिक शक्ति का दौर माना जाता है, जो मोटे हिस्सों वाले मज़बूत दौरों के साथ बारी-बारी आता है।
rules.meaning_en: On an uneven head line, each thin stretch is read as a period of weaker mental strength, alternating with stronger periods where the line thickens.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: They show that the mentality of the subject changes, now weak for a period of years, then strong, then weak, then strong, as many changes being indicated as there are uneven places on the line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से किसी पर्वत की ओर उठती शाखा अगर तारे पर ख़त्म हो, तो उस समय की महत्वाकांक्षा सफलता से पुरस्कृत मानी जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising from the head line toward a mount and ending in a star shows the ambition of that time rewarded with success.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: These splits show the pulling force of some attraction which is not strong enough to deflect the entire line, but is powerful enough to split a part from it ; thus they show the attracting force of the place to which the split goes. If in either of the above cases the split line should end in a star (153) it will show that success rewards these ambitions or desires.

rules.notes: Benham's cases are splits rising under Jupiter and Saturn; 'the same construction applies to all the other Mounts'. The continuation on p.460 (a split to Apollo ending in a dot, cross or island: small chance of success) has no text layer in this scan and is not cited.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा को काटती बारीक छोटी आड़ी रेखाएँ मानसिक चिंता के समय को दर्शाती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Fine little bars crossing the head line mark times of mental worry.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If these cross-bars are merely little fine lines which cross the Head line they show mental worries

rules.notes: The sentence continues 'and predisposition to severe headaches, but do not go so far as brain fever'; the medical clause is not carried into the meaning. Deep red bars are excluded (a named disorder).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा पर द्वीप ऐसे दौर को दर्शाता है जब मानसिक शक्ति कम ज़ोर से काम करती है; जब तक वह चले, भारी दबाव से बचना बेहतर है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the head line marks a period when mental strength works at reduced force; heavy strain is best avoided while it lasts.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Islands on the line (161) show that at the time they occur the mental strength operates with diminished force.

rules.notes: p.462: 'during the period covered by an island, the mind is not in full health and power'; spirit mediums told Benham they were 'developed' at the age the island appeared. The size of the island gives the degree. Deep, red islands are excluded (named fevers).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से हृदय रेखा की ओर उठकर भाग्य रेखा को काटने वाली शाखा इशारा करती है कि उस समय से भावनाएँ सांसारिक सफलता में आड़े आती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising from the head line toward the heart line and cutting the fate line points to feelings interfering with worldly success from that time.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If split lines rise from the line of Head and merge into the line of Heart the head has been powerfully guided by heart. Often these lines are seen cutting the line of Saturn (159) ; in this case sentiment has interfered with business success.

rules.notes: The passage does not say on which line the age is read; the departure from the head line is used. The branch also cuts the fate line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: द्वीप से ठीक पहले मस्तिष्क रेखा में गहरा कटाव दिखाता है कि मन पर ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा ज़ोर डाला गया, जिससे आगे कमज़ोर दौर आया।
rules.meaning_en: A deep cut in the head line just before an island shows the mind being pushed too hard, bringing on the weaker period that follows.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With every island watch for a deep cut in the Head line preceding it (162). This will show that the brain was forced too much, and this produced the mental disturbance shown by the island.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा में टूटन उस समय सोच की स्थिरता में आए झटके को दर्शाती है: एकाग्रता और आत्म-संयम डगमगाते हैं, कभी-कभी सेहत भी ढीली रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: A break in the head line marks a jolt to steady thinking at that time: concentration and self-control waver, sometimes with a spell of poor health.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Breaks in the line (171) show the interruption of the Current, its unsteady flow, producing irregular action and consequent lack of concentration, firmness, and self-control.

rules.notes: Benham: 'there is illness present at each time the line breaks. The age at which all of these illnesses occur can be read from the line' (pp.464-465). The condition of the line after the break shows whether the effect lasts (p.466).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जो टूटन आपस में चढ़े सिरों, सहायक रेखा, जोड़ने वाली रेखाओं या वर्ग से जुड़ी हो, वह भी उस समय मानसिक झटका दिखाती है, पर जुड़ाव जितना अच्छा, असर उतना हल्का।
rules.meaning_en: A break mended by overlapping ends, a sister line, joining bars or a square still marks a mental jolt at that time, eased by how well it is mended.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With every break in the Head line note whether it is repaired by sister lines, by the overlapping ends, connecting bars, squares, or any other repair signs. If so the subject will have a mental jar at the time of the break which will be more or less severe according to the size of the break and to how well it is repaired.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा की टूटन पर बना वर्ग उसे जोड़ देता है: उस समय का झटका महसूस होता है, पर बात संभल जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: A square over a break in the head line mends it: the jolt of that time is felt but held together.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With every break in the Head line note whether it is repaired by sister lines, by the overlapping ends, connecting bars, squares, or any other repair signs. If so the subject will have a mental jar at the time of the break which will be more or less severe according to the size of the break and to how well it is repaired.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ हृदय रेखा मस्तिष्क रेखा से निकलती है, परंपरा उसी पड़ाव से बुद्धि को भावनाओं पर हावी मानती है — तब से विवेक ही भावना को राह दिखाने लगता है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the heart line springs from the head line, tradition dates the head taking charge of the heart to that point in life; from then on reason tends to lead feeling.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In this case the time at which the Head line obtained control of the Heart line can be read by the point on the Head line from which the Heart line starts; the age at which it occurred being read from the line of Head according to the rules laid down in Chapter IV

rules.notes: Benham reads this age on the head line, at the point the heart line leaves it (his head and heart lines share one scale, Ch.IV).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बीच में ही रुकी हृदय रेखा उस आयु के आसपास एक गंभीर कठिनाई का संकेत देती है — या तो सेहत पर ध्यान देने का समय, या दूसरों के प्रति स्नेह का सूखना।
rules.meaning_en: A heart line that stops short marks a serious difficulty around the age where it ends: a time when vitality needs care, or when warmth toward others runs thin.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: a short distance and stops (32), it indicates that the subject will have serious difficulty at the time at which it ends, even if all the other lines go on to their normal length.

rules.notes: Softened: Benham's first alternative is that 'the heart will stop beating' (excluded); the rule keeps the difficulty and his second alternative, little affection for others.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से किसी पर्वत की ओर जाती महीन रेखा उस आयु में उस पर्वत के स्वभाव वाले व्यक्ति के प्रति आकर्षण का संकेत देती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fine line leaving the heart line for a mount marks an attraction at that age toward the kind of person that mount stands for.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the subject has attractions at other ages, they will be shown by a chance line leaving the Heart line, or some other line, at the age at which the attraction occurs, and running to the Mount to which it is attracted.

rules.notes: The mount-specific readings are the split-line rules (figs. 49-52); fig. 61 is this rule for Apollo.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जो हृदय रेखा किसी पर्वत में जाकर वहीं समाप्त हो जाए, उस आयु से वह आकर्षण भावनाओं पर पूरी तरह हावी माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A heart line that rises into a mount and ends there: from that age the attraction tends to master the affections completely.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line in so rising loses itself in the Mount to which it deflects and ends there instead of at its usual stopping place, it shows that the attraction has overcome the affections and that the heart has surrendered completely.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ हृदय रेखा किसी पर्वत की ओर उठती है, उस आयु में जीवन का सबसे गहरा आकर्षण उसी पर्वत के गुणों वाले लोगों की ओर माना जाता है; रेखा लौट आए तो आकर्षण हावी नहीं होता।
rules.meaning_en: Where the heart line rises toward a mount, the strongest attraction of the life tends to come at that age, toward people and qualities of that mount; if the line returns to its course, the pull passes without ruling.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: the line rise to more than one Mount, and if it so rises under a Mount it indicates the age at which the strongest attraction did or will occur in this direction.

rules.notes: How long the line stays deflected gives the period the attraction covers; how far it is pulled, how serious it was (p.395).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ हृदय रेखा मस्तिष्क रेखा की ओर झुकती है, उस आयु से विवेक भावनाओं पर भारी पड़ता है — झुकाव रहने तक दूसरों के प्रति रूखापन और सावधानी का दौर।
rules.meaning_en: Where the heart line dips toward the head line, reason presses hard on feeling from that age: a cooler, more guarded time toward others while the dip lasts.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line dips downward in its course (35) it shows that at the time of this deflection the head has exerted a powerful influence over the heart; and reason and head dominate sentiment and heart.

rules.notes: Softened: Benham calls the subject 'indifferent to others, avaricious, selfish, and cold-hearted' during the dip. 'The point at which it begins will tell the age at which this tendency begins.'

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जो हृदय रेखा झुककर मस्तिष्क रेखा में खो जाए, उस आयु से आगे बुद्धि का भावनाओं पर स्थायी शासन माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A heart line that dips and is lost in the head line: from that age the head tends to rule the heart for good.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If it is lost in the Head line (36), it shows that these qualities have swallowed all further independent action

rules.notes: Continues on p.396: 'of the affections. These subjects are henceforth dominated by head.'

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: यदि हृदय रेखा झुककर फिर अपने मार्ग पर लौट आए, तो उस दौर के बाद भी पुराना स्नेह कुछ बचा रहता है; दुनियादारी भावनाओं को पूरी तरह नहीं दबा पाती।
rules.meaning_en: If the heart line dips and then regains its course, some of the old warmth survives that period; worldly concerns do not wholly overcome feeling.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line of Heart after such a serious deflection regains its former course (37), it shows there is still left a portion of the former affectionate disposition, and that head and worldly interests have not entirely overcome heart and sentiment.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शनि के नीचे समाप्त होती हृदय रेखा: जो स्नेह गर्मजोशी से शुरू हुआ, वह जीवन में जल्दी ही ठंडा और उदासीन होने लगता है।
rules.meaning_en: A heart line that ends under Saturn: affections that began warm tend to turn cool early in life and grow indifferent.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line rises under Jupiter and ends under Saturn (39) it shows that the heart which began with the right sort of affections soon changed, and the coldness and dislike of mankind peculiar to the Saturnian quickly changed the nature, which was warm in the beginning, to one which has little heart left.

rules.notes: The life-span reading attached to this ending is excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ हृदय रेखा गहरी और साफ़ चलती है, जीवन के उस हिस्से में स्नेह स्थिर, वफ़ादार और मज़बूत रहता है, भले ही उसका दिखावा कम हो।
rules.meaning_en: Where the heart line runs deep and clear, the affections of that stretch of years tend to be steady, loyal and strong, even if quietly shown.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The qualities of the lines just described apply to the line only during the time the line shows these formations, and when the character of the line changes the qualities of the subject change. For every change in the character of the line there will be a change in the subject.

rules.notes: The deep, well-cut line's reading is on p.402; p.405 dates each formation to the stretch of the line it occupies.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ से हृदय रेखा चौड़ी और उथली हो जाती है, वहाँ से स्नेह चंचल और अस्थिर होने लगता है — जब तक रेखा ऐसी रहे।
rules.meaning_en: From the point where the heart line turns broad and shallow, affections tend to become changeable and inconstant, for as long as the line stays so.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: at the age of twenty-four he changed in these respects, and became weak, changeable, and inconstant

rules.notes: Benham's worked example (fig. 48): deep to Saturn, broad and shallow to Apollo, thin to Mercury, chained to the end. This rule is the broad-and-shallow stretch; turns-thin is the thin stretch.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ से हृदय रेखा जंजीरनुमा हो जाती है, वहाँ से स्नेह डगमगाने लगता है और ऊर्जा घटती है — जंजीर वाले पूरे हिस्से तक।
rules.meaning_en: From the point where the heart line turns chained, affections tend to waver and grow unreliable, and energy runs lower, for the rest of the chained stretch.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: when he grew weak, had poor circulation, became vacillating, cowardly, and unreliable in his affections, and these conditions lasted until the end of his life.

rules.notes: Softened: 'cowardly'. Same worked example.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ से हृदय रेखा पतली हो जाती है, वहाँ से दूसरों की परवाह घटती है और अपना हित आगे आने लगता है — जब तक रेखा पतली रहे।
rules.meaning_en: From the point where the heart line turns thin, care for others tends to narrow and self-interest to lead, for as long as it stays thin.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: at forty-three he grew very selfish, cold-hearted, and sought only to further his own ends, which condition lasted until sixty

rules.notes: Softened: 'very selfish, cold-hearted'. Same worked example as turns-broad-shallow.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से गुरु पर्वत की ओर उठती शाखा: उस आयु में महत्वाकांक्षा प्रेम को दिशा देती है, और आकर्षण किसी प्रतिष्ठित या आगे बढ़ते व्यक्ति की ओर होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising from the heart line toward Jupiter: at that age ambition tends to guide love, and the one who attracts is prominent or on the rise.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Thus a split rising from the Heart line under Jupiter (49) will show that ambition will guide love, and the person who will attract this subject will be someone on the Jupiterian order.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शनि की ओर उठती शाखा: उस आयु में मन गंभीर, सावधान और समझदार गुणों — या ऐसे व्यक्ति — की ओर खिंचता है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising toward Saturn: at that age the heart is drawn to sober, cautious, wise qualities, or to someone who has them.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In every case this subject will like best one who has the soberness, caution, and wisdom that belong to the Saturnian type.

rules.notes: The rule opens on p.410: 'A split line rising under Saturn (50) will indicate that the subject is attracted by some of the Saturnian qualities.'

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य पर्वत की ओर उठती शाखा: उस आयु में मन किसी कलात्मक, उजले व्यक्ति — या सुंदरता और चमक-दमक — की ओर खिंचता है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising toward Apollo: at that age the heart is drawn to an artistic, bright person, or to beauty and display.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
