citation.quote: A split line rising under Apollo (51) must be reasoned as in the previous case, and your subject will be drawn toward Apollonians.

rules.notes: Fig. 61 (p.416): an earlier attraction to an Apollonian shows as a chance line from the heart line to Apollo at that earlier age.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से निकलकर मस्तिष्क रेखा में मिलती बड़ी शाखा: जहाँ वह निकलती है वहाँ से भावना बुद्धि के आगे झुकने लगती है, और जहाँ मिलती है वहाँ पूरी तरह झुक जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: A large branch falling from the heart line into the head line: the heart begins yielding to the head where it leaves, and has given way where it joins.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: and gradually fall to the Head line, merging itself in it (54); this will show that heart has surrendered to head and is thereafter ruled by it. The age at which it begins is shown by the point at which the line splits away, and the complete surrender by the point at which the line loses itself in the line of Head.

rules.notes: Two dates: the start where the branch leaves the heart line, the complete surrender where it joins the head line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से नीचे गिरती शाखा: उस आयु में हिसाब-किताब भावनाओं पर दबाव डालता है; पुरानी परंपरा इसे प्रेम में दुख या निराशा पढ़ती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch falling from the heart line: at that age calculation presses on feeling; the old reading is a sorrow or disappointment in love.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Split lines which fall from the Heart line (53) show a part of the conflict between heart and head, and at the time these lines fall, the head is exerting a very strong influence.

rules.notes: Fine lines falling all along the line: a lifelong contest of heart and head. The old palmists' 'love-sorrows and disappointments' is Benham's gloss on it.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बुध की ओर उठती शाखा: उस आयु में मन किसी चतुर, वाक्पटु या कमाऊ व्यक्ति की ओर खिंचता है; प्रेम में साथी की आर्थिक स्थिति भी तौली जा सकती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising toward Mercury: at that age the heart is drawn to a clever, eloquent or money-making person; love may weigh a partner's means.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the split line rises to Mercury (52) your subject will love Mercurian qualities; which side will be shown by the world which rules in his hand — the oratory and eloquence of the upper world of Mercury, the scientific side shown by the middle, or the money-making side shown by the lower world.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा को काटती छोटी रेखाएँ, जब वे सेहत का संकेत न हों: जिन आयुओं पर वे काटती हैं, उन पर स्नेह-संबंधों में झटके; अधिक रेखाएँ — लंबा उलझा दौर।
rules.meaning_en: Bars cutting the heart line, when they are not a health sign: jolts to the affections at the ages where they cut; many bars mean a troubled stretch.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Cross-bars cutting the line (55) are constant heart irritations, either illness, or worries in the affections.

rules.notes: Dated: 'constant jars to the affections will be indicated at the age at which these bars show on the line' (p.413). The illness reading is excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा पर बिंदु: उस आयु में सेहत में क्षणिक गड़बड़ी का संकेत; छोटा बिंदु, जिसकी कहीं और पुष्टि न हो, गंभीर नहीं माना जाता।
rules.meaning_en: A dot on the heart line: a passing disturbance of health at that age; a small one, with nothing else to confirm it, is not serious.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Dots on the Heart line (57) are generally health defects, and their degree of seriousness is gauged by their size. When seen, always examine for heart disease. If no indication is seen anywhere else, and the dot is small, the case is not serious.

rules.notes: Kept as a general health-care period without naming a disease; p.414 also calls mere dots 'not more than temporary disturbances'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा पर द्वीप, जब वह सेहत का संकेत न हो: द्वीप जितने वर्षों तक फैला हो, उतने समय स्नेह में निराशा का दौर।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the heart line, when it is not a health sign: a disappointment in the affections over the years the island covers.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When an island is seen, search must be made to ascertain whether it is a health defect, and generally this will be the case. If not, look to location, chance, and other lines for information bearing on some disappointment to the affections.

rules.notes: Benham's first reading of a heart-line island is physical; that reading is excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा में टूटन, जब वह सेहत का संकेत न हो: उस आयु में स्नेह-संबंध में रुकावट; टूटन के बाद रेखा कैसी चलती है, उसी से पता चलता है कि घाव भरता है या नहीं।
rules.meaning_en: A break in the heart line, when it is not a health sign: an interruption in the affections at that age; the line after the break shows whether it heals.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With breaks examine in the usual manner to see if they are health defects, and if found to be so, read the break as denoting illness; if it is not a health indication read it as an interruption in the affections.

rules.notes: After the break: a deep line means it is overcome; thin, chained or defective means continuing difficulty, each change dated on the line (p.415).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन जिसका सिरा गुरु की ओर उठता है: उस आयु में स्नेह किसी अभिमानी या महत्वाकांक्षी व्यक्ति के कारण — या अपने ही अहं और महत्वाकांक्षा से — टूटता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break whose end runs up toward Jupiter: the affections are broken at that age by a proud or ambitious person, or by one's own pride and ambition.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the break be not a health indication, it will show that one of the Jupiterian type has caused the break, or that it has been caused by too much ambition or pride (Jupiterian qualities).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन जिसका सिरा शनि की ओर उठता है: उस आयु में स्नेह किसी गंभीर, उदास व्यक्ति के कारण — या अपनी ही सावधानी और उदासी से — टूटता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break whose end rises toward Saturn: the affections are broken at that age by a sober, gloomy person, or by one's own caution and gloom.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this break is not a health indication it will show that either a Saturnian subject, or that Saturnian qualities have caused the break in the line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य पर्वत के नीचे टूटन, जब वह सेहत का संकेत न हो: उस आयु में स्नेह किसी चमकदार, कलात्मक व्यक्ति या सुंदरता के मोह से प्रभावित होकर टूटता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break under Apollo that is not a health sign: the affections at that age are swayed and broken by a bright, artistic person or by love of beauty and show.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If it is not a health indication it will tell of the affections having been influenced by Apollonian qualities, or by one of this type. This break occurring in the line under Apollo is at age forty-three.

rules.notes: Benham's own date for this position: forty-three, consistent with his Ch.IV axis.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन जिनके सिरे मस्तिष्क रेखा की ओर नीचे मुड़ते हैं: उन आयुओं पर ठंडा विवेक गर्म भावना से लड़ता है।
rules.meaning_en: Breaks whose ends turn down toward the head line: at those ages cold reason fights warm feeling.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the ends of these broken lines turn down instead of rising to the Mounts (64) then the head strongly influences the subject at the times the breaks occur, and cold reason fights against warm sentiment.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटी हृदय रेखा जिसका सिरा मस्तिष्क रेखा में मिल जाए: उस आयु में विवेक भावना पर जीतता है; चौड़ी टूटन पूरी तरह नहीं भरती, संकरी भर जाती है, भले उस समय दुख दे।
rules.meaning_en: A broken heart line whose end merges into the head line: reason wins over feeling at that age; a wide break is never quite got over, a narrow one heals though it hurts.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the broken ends are short, head does not rule completely, but if the line merges into the Head line, reason obtains the mastery over sentiment (65). If the break is wide at this time, the subject never entirely gets over it; if it is narrow he does, though unhappy at the time.

rules.notes: 'By noting each break it can be told at what age these events occur' (p.417).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा में कई टूटन, जब वे सेहत के संकेत न हों: हर टूटन की आयु पर एक टूटा रिश्ता — टूटे लगावों की शृंखला।
rules.meaning_en: Many breaks along the heart line, when they are not health signs: a run of broken attachments, one at each break's age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If many breaks are seen in the line (63) your client has either had a constant recurrence of weakness in the heart's action or of broken love affairs.

rules.notes: The physical alternative and the close-together reading are excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन के बाद जंजीरनुमा होती हृदय रेखा: उस आयु में जो टूटा, वह पूरी तरह कभी नहीं भरता।
rules.meaning_en: A heart line that turns chained after a break: what broke it at that age tends never to heal fully.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If after a break in a Heart line, the line is chained (69), it shows that the heart never fully recovers from whatever caused the break.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा में टूटन के बाद द्वीप: जितने समय द्वीप रहें, उतने समय सेहत का नाज़ुक दौर।
rules.meaning_en: Islands following a break in the heart line: a delicate stretch for health, for as long as the islands last.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If after a break the line has an island or islands (70) it will be delicate during the time occupied by these islands.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा की टूटन को जोड़ती सहायक रेखा: उस आयु में कठिन समय, पर रेखा फिर अपने मार्ग पर लौट आती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sister line bridging a break in the heart line: a hard time at that age, from which the line is led back to its course.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: latter case the best repair would be a sister line joining the ends of the cross-bars (74). In this case there would be great danger at the time of the break, but the Current could be led back by the sister line to its channel again.

rules.notes: Softened: the break it repairs (fig. 73) is one Benham reads as fatal, and he calls the time 'great danger'; only the repair is kept.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा की टूटन को घेरता अच्छा वर्ग: उस आयु का गंभीर दबाव उसके भीतर थमा रहता है, और रेखा फिर अपने मार्ग पर आ सकती है।
rules.meaning_en: A good square around a break in the heart line: a serious strain at that age is held within it, and the line is likely to find its way again.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: This serious defect is also well repaired by a square (75) in which case the Current gets into the box, and though it is a serious impediment to the heart during the time this break occurs,

rules.notes: Continues: 'it will likely find its way into the Heart line again if the square be a good one.' Kept as protection; the defect it repairs is excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा पर तारा, जब वह सेहत का संकेत न हो, उस आयु में स्नेह-जीवन में किसी चमकदार मोड़ का संकेत हो सकता है।
rules.meaning_en: A star on the heart line, when it is not a health sign, can mark a brilliant turn in the affections at that age.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The star is either a brilliant sign when seen on the line, or is an explosion. First locate whether it denotes illness or affection.

rules.notes: Benham does not elaborate the favourable reading; every health reading of the star is excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से उठने वाली भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि सफलता में विपरीत लिंग के किसी व्यक्ति की सलाह या सहारा मदद करता है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line rising from the Mount of the Moon points to success helped along by someone of the opposite sex, through advice or support.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When the line rises from the Mount of Moon and runs on to the Mount of Saturn (347) the subject's success in life will be materially assisted by one of the opposite sex. This may either be by good advice or by rendering financial aid.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के भीतर से उठकर शनि पर्वत तक जाती भाग्य रेखा भौतिक सफलता की ओर इशारा करती है, जिसमें नज़दीकी परिवार की बड़ी मदद रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line rising inside the life line and running to the Mount of Saturn points to material success, with strong help from close family.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When the Saturn line rises inside the Life line and runs on to the Mount of Saturn (345) it indicates that the subject will have material success in life, and that near relatives will assist him greatly.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हथेली के बीच से उठने वाली भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि सफलता ज़्यादातर अपनी मेहनत से मिलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line rising from the centre of the palm points to success won largely by one's own effort.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When the line rises from the centre of the palm (346) and runs into the Mount of Saturn, the subject will achieve success in life largely by his own efforts.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा शुरुआत में न हो और उन्हीं वर्षों में जीवन रेखा नाज़ुक सेहत दिखाए, तो धीमी शुरुआत उसी कमज़ोरी से जुड़ी है; भाग्य रेखा जहाँ शुरू होती है, वहीं से फलदायी दौर खुलता है।
rules.meaning_en: When the fate line is missing at first and the life line shows delicate health over the same years, the slow start follows that frailty; a productive period opens where the fate line begins.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Thus you will know that the subject did little during the earlier years because he was delicate. As the Saturn line begins at the time this delicacy ends on the Life line, he will at that time begin a period which he may make productive.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हथेली में ऊपर से शुरू होने वाली भाग्य रेखा कठिन शुरुआती वर्षों की ओर इशारा करती है; अच्छा दौर वहीं से शुरू होता है जहाँ रेखा शुरू होती है — रेखा जितनी ऊपर, आसान दौर उतनी देर से।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that starts high in the hand suggests harder early years; the best period begins where the line begins, and the higher its start, the later the easy stretch.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The higher in the hand the line starts, the later in life will be the period of easiest sailing.

rules.notes: Same paragraph: a line starting higher up (348) means 'a more negative existence for the first part of the life' and 'His best period will begin at the time the line starts' (p.536).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कमज़ोरी से उबरती जीवन रेखा के साथ भाग्य रेखा भी मोटी होती जाए, तो ताक़त लौटने के साथ काम-काज और आर्थिक हालत भी सुधरती जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: If the fate line grows thicker as a weak life line recovers, work and money affairs keep improving as strength returns.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Life line be thin when it begins to recover, and grows thicker as it progresses, and if the Saturn line does the same, the subject will continue to do better in a business way as his strength increases.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा जहाँ से शुरू होनी चाहिए वहाँ न हो, तो यह अक्सर बचपन में माता-पिता से जुड़ी परिस्थितियाँ दिखाता है; धीमी शुरुआत व्यक्ति की अपनी ग़लती नहीं होती।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line missing where it should begin often reflects circumstances around the parents in childhood; the slow start is not the person's own doing.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The absence of a Saturn line where it should normally begin will often be explained by some accident to the parents. As this early period of the line covers the childhood of the subject, it will not be through his own fault that the start in life is not as good as it should be.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा जहाँ सबसे गहरी हो, वही सबसे अनुकूल और फलदायी दौर है; अगर वह केवल बचपन वाले हिस्से में गहरी हो, तो अच्छे साल तब आते हैं जब उनका लाभ उठाने की उम्र नहीं होती।
rules.meaning_en: Where the fate line runs deepest marks the most favourable, productive stretch; deep only in childhood, the best years come before one is old enough to use them.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this deepness of the line be early in life, the subject will have his best period during childhood (354). This is an unfortunate marking, for at this age the subject is seldom old enough to take advantage of opportunities.

rules.notes: Benham calls the propitious stretches of the line the 'harvest periods' of a life (pp.532-533).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: गहरी भाग्य रेखा के फ़ायदे वहीं तक रहते हैं जहाँ तक वह चलती है; जहाँ वह रुकती है, वहाँ आसान दौर ख़त्म होता है और आगे का रास्ता अपनी मेहनत से बनता है।
rules.meaning_en: A deep fate line carries its advantages only as far as it runs; where it stops, that easier period ends and what follows is shaped by one's own effort.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this deep line extend up on to the Mount of Saturn, these favorable conditions will continue during the entire life. If the line be short, they will be present only during the length of the line, the age to be read from the line.

rules.notes: The same reading recurs at p.545 ('After the age at which a line of Saturn stops, the subject will have to exert great effort') and p.557 ('the future is as they make it').

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा का जंजीरनुमा हिस्सा बार-बार आने वाली रुकावटों के दौर का संकेत है, जो उतना ही चलता है जितनी दूर जंजीर है।
rules.meaning_en: A stretch where the fate line is chained marks a period of repeated obstructions that lasts as long as the chaining.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: A chained line of Saturn indicates that the career will be a hard one. If the line be chained, during its entire length, the subject will have continuous obstructions and the life will be a labored one, full of disappointments (357). If chained only part of the way, the difficulties will last during this condition.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा की शुरुआत में कोई भी दोष शुरुआती वर्षों की रुकावटों का संकेत है — अक्सर सेहत या परिवार की ऐसी परिस्थितियों से जो बच्चे के बस में नहीं होतीं।
rules.meaning_en: Any defect at the beginning of the fate line points to hindrances in the early years, usually from health or family circumstances beyond a child's control.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: It makes no difference as to the character of the defect which appears in the beginning of a Saturn line, the general rule is the same. It indicates an impediment to the early years of the subject.

rules.notes: Chain, island, break or thinness at the start all read the same way (p.540): 'All defects found in the beginning of the line refer to the childhood of the subject'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरुआत में दोषपूर्ण पर आगे गहरी और साफ़ होती भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि शुरुआती बाधाएँ पार हो गईं — कारण हटे या व्यक्ति ख़ुद उनसे ऊपर उठा।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line defective at its start that grows deep and clear shows early setbacks overcome, whether the causes lifted or the person rose above them.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: So, when we see a Saturn line defective at the start, but growing deep and well cut (358). we know that, whatever the cause of the trouble at the beginning, it has been overcome.

rules.notes: p.551: lines defective at the start generally improve, the subject having learned early to do for himself.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा में द्वीप आर्थिक तंगी के ऐसे दौर का संकेत है जो द्वीप की लंबाई जितना चलता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island in the fate line marks a period of financial strain lasting as long as the island.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: After careful study of the subject, I can say that an island in the Saturn line indicates a period of financial difficulty, lasting the length of the island, and that the marking is not per se an indication of infidelity.

rules.notes: Benham rejects the older reading of this island as infidelity (pp.541-542).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा की शुरुआत में द्वीप और जीवन रेखा की कमज़ोर शुरुआत साथ हों, तो लंबे समय की नाज़ुक सेहत से शुरुआती कठिनाइयाँ दिखती हैं, जो भाग्य रेखा के सुधरने तक रहती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: An island at the start of the fate line with a weak start to the life line points to early difficulties from long delicate health, lasting until the fate line improves.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Life line be defective at the beginning, either broad and shallow, chained, islanded, split or broken, and if this continue past the period covered by the delicacy of childhood usually seen in this line, and if an island be also seen in the beginning of the Saturn line, the prolonged delicacy of the subject's health will cause difficulty in early life, and will last until the Saturn line grows better (363).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा की शुरुआत में द्वीप बचपन की आर्थिक परेशानी का संकेत है जो माता-पिता की कठिनाइयों से आती है; अक्सर शुक्र पर्वत से चिंता-रेखाएँ उस द्वीप तक जाती दिखती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: An island at the very start of the fate line points to money troubles in childhood coming through the parents' difficulties, often with worry lines running to it from the Mount of Venus.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Financial difficulty might be present in his life through a difficulty of his parents. If such be the case, Worry lines will often be seen running from Influence lines on the Mount of Venus, to the island in Saturn line (362).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा को आर-पार काटती आड़ी रेखाएँ करियर की रुकावटें हैं — हर एक अपनी जगह पर अलग अड़चन; कटाव जितना गहरा, अड़चन उतनी गंभीर।
rules.meaning_en: Bars that cut through the fate line are obstacles to the career, each a separate check at its own point; the deeper the cut, the more serious.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Cross-bars cutting the Saturn line (367) are obstructions to the career of the subject. Each one of the bars is a separate obstruction, and by noting the depth of each you can tell how serious it is.

rules.notes: 'The age at which each of these interferences occurs can be read from the Saturn line' (p.543).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा के ऊपर से गुज़रती हल्की रेखाएँ, जो उसे काटती नहीं, बड़ी रुकावट नहीं बल्कि लगातार छोटी परेशानियों का संकेत हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Faint lines that pass over the fate line without cutting it mark continual small annoyances and hindrances rather than real checks.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If only faint lines which do not cut through the Saturn line but pass over it, they indicate continual annoying interferences and impediments. If they cut the line in two, they are serious checks which threaten to destroy the success of the subject. The age at which each of these interferences occurs can be read from the Saturn line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत से आती चिंता-रेखाएँ भाग्य रेखा की शुरुआत के द्वीप तक पहुँचें, तो बचपन में परिवार से जुड़ी लगातार परेशानियाँ करियर की शुरुआत को रोकती दिखती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Worry lines from the Mount of Venus running to an island at the start of the fate line point to constant family annoyances in early life that check the career.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If Worry lines run from Influence lines on Mount of Venus to an island at the beginning of the Saturn line, constant annoyances in the early life of the subject bring about a check to his career (366).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा में टूटन उस मोड़ पर करियर में बड़ी रुकावट का संकेत है; अगर रेखा नई दिशा या नए रूप में फिर शुरू हो, तो जीवन के काम में पूरा बदलाव दिखता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break in the fate line marks a strong check to the career at that point; if the line resumes in a new direction or character, it points to a complete change in one's life-work.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Breaks in the line (368) are most serious. At the time they occur some force has been sufficiently strong to check the career entirely, and if the line takes a new character, starts in a new direction, or does not start at all, these breaks indicate an entire change in the course of a subject's life-work.

rules.notes: 'The age of each break can be read from the Saturn line' (p.544); a wide or unrepaired break is more serious.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कई जगह टूटी पर जुड़ती हुई भाग्य रेखा संघर्ष भरी राह दिखाती है: बार-बार की निराशाओं के बाद लगन से सफलता मिलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line broken in many places but repaired points to a hard-fought path: after repeated disappointments, success is reached through persistence.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line be broken in many places but is repaired (369), the subject after numerous disappointments will fight his way eventually to success.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऊबड़-खाबड़ भाग्य रेखा जहाँ गहरी हो, वहाँ समृद्धि के दौर हैं; उस समय की कमाई को पतले हिस्सों वाले दौर में संभालकर रखना ज़रूरी है।
rules.meaning_en: Where an uneven fate line runs deep marks spells of prosperity; what is gained then needs guarding through the thinner stretches.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Saturn be uneven (370), alternately deep and thin in character, the subject will have intermittent periods of prosperity, and one with such a line must use continual watchfulness in order that, during the periods indicated by the thinness of the line, all which was gained while the line was deep may not be lost.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऊबड़-खाबड़ भाग्य रेखा जहाँ पतली हो, वहाँ तंगी के दौर हैं, जब गहरे हिस्सों वाले समय की कमाई लापरवाही से हाथ से निकल सकती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where an uneven fate line runs thin marks leaner spells, when gains made in the deep stretches can slip away without care.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Saturn be uneven (370), alternately deep and thin in character, the subject will have intermittent periods of prosperity, and one with such a line must use continual watchfulness in order that, during the periods indicated by the thinness of the line, all which was gained while the line was deep may not be lost.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से नीचे जाती शाखाएँ कठिन दौर का संकेत हैं — निराशा और धीमी प्रगति; कारण अक्सर हथेली में कहीं और दिखता है।
rules.meaning_en: Downward branches from the fate line mark a harder stretch, with discouragement and slow progress; the cause usually shows elsewhere in the hand.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: During the time when downward branches are seen, the life will be harder, more filled with discouragements, and progress will be difficult.

rules.notes: Benham finds these branches follow the subject's health closely (p.546).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से ऊपर उठती बारीक रेखाएँ उम्मीद और महत्वाकांक्षा भरे दौर का संकेत हैं — जहाँ वे दिखें, वह हिस्सा सबसे सफल रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines rising from the fate line mark a hopeful, ambitious stretch, the most successful part of the line wherever they appear.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Rising lines will indicate the upward tendency of the life, and will add strength to the line on which they are seen. During whatever portion of the line these branches appear, that part of the line will be filled with hope and ambition and will be more successful than any other period.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: गहरी शुरू होकर मस्तिष्क रेखा पर रुकने वाली भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि तब तक करियर अनुकूल रहता है, फिर निर्णय की ग़लतियों से राह कठिन होती है और आगे का फल मेहनत से ही मिलता है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that begins deep and stops at the head line points to a favourable career until then, after which errors of judgement make the going harder and results come only by effort.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Saturn begins deep at the base, and runs to the line of Head and there stops (372), the career of the subject will be favorable up to thirty, when errors of judgment will interfere, and from that time he will have a harder time to get along

rules.notes: Benham's example age (thirty) is where his scale puts the head line; the rule is dated by where this line stops. Same passage: 'After the age at which a line of Saturn stops, the subject will have to exert great effort in order to accomplish much' (p.545).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा पर नीचे जाती शाखाएँ और उसी दौर में जीवन रेखा पर द्वीप हों, तो उस कठिन समय की जड़ नाज़ुक सेहत में दिखती है।
rules.meaning_en: Downward branches on the fate line with an island in the life line over the same stretch trace the harder period to delicate health.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With downward branches on the Saturn line and an island in the Life line, the unfavorable condition of the Saturn line is to be accounted for by delicacy of health (374).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत की चिंता-रेखाएँ जीवन रेखा को काटकर भाग्य रेखा की ऊपर उठती शाखाओं को भी काटें, तो उभरते दौर में लगातार दख़ल और अड़चनें दिखती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Worry lines from the Mount of Venus that cut the life line and then the fate line's rising branches point to constant interference hampering an otherwise rising period.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With upward branches from the Saturn line, if Worry lines from Mount of Venus cut the Life line and in turn cut these upward branches, the course of the subject, which is upward, will be constantly interfered with (377). While these interferences may not be able to destroy the effect of his favorable period, they will materially hamper and annoy him.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा को काटने वाली कोई भी रेखा उसे कमज़ोर करती है और कटाव की जगह पर प्रगति रोकती है; काटने वाली रेखा कहाँ से आती है, उससे असर का स्रोत पता चलता है।
rules.meaning_en: Any line that cuts the fate line weakens it and holds back progress at the point of the cut; where the cutting line starts tells what the influence is.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: As a general proposition, all lines which cut the Saturn line weaken it, and impede the progress of the subject at the age indicated by the cut (379).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बृहस्पति पर्वत के तारे से आती रेखा भाग्य रेखा को काटे, तो ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा महत्वाकांक्षा और बड़े लोगों के बीच जगह पाने की चाह से आई रुकावट का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A chance line from a star on the Mount of Jupiter cutting the fate line points to a setback brought on by overreaching ambition and the wish to move among the prominent.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a chance line from a star on Mount of Jupiter cuts the Saturn line, the subject will suffer a severe check from too much ambition. His endeavor to know distinguished people will lead him to do foolish things which injure his prospects (380).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: अगर बृहस्पति से आती वह रेखा भाग्य रेखा के किसी द्वीप तक पहुँचे, तो आगे रहने की चाह फ़िज़ूलख़र्ची और आर्थिक तंगी के दौर की ओर ले जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: If that line from Jupiter runs to an island in the fate line, the urge to rank among the leading few leads to overspending and a spell of money trouble.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this chance line runs to an island in the Saturn line, his ambition to move in the front rank will cause him to be extravagant, and financial difficulties will result (381).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत की किसी प्रभाव-रेखा से आती रेखा भाग्य रेखा को काटे और उसके बाद भाग्य रेखा टूटी रहे, तो किसी व्यक्ति के असर से आई बड़ी रुकावट का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A line from an influence line on the Mount of Venus cutting the fate line, with the fate line broken after it, points to a person's influence bringing a serious setback.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Saturn be cut by a line running from an Influence line on Mount of Venus, and the Saturn line be broken for the rest of its course, an influence will cause a serious disaster (383).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: काटने वाली प्रभाव-रेखा जीवनसाथी की मानी जाए और उससे बृहस्पति तक रेखा जाए, तो साथी की महत्वाकांक्षा व्यक्ति को हैसियत से ज़्यादा ख़र्च में खींचती है; बाद में रेखा कमज़ोर रहे तो संभलना धीमा होता है।
rules.meaning_en: If the cutting influence line is read as the spouse's and sends a line to Jupiter, a partner's ambitions draw the person into spending beyond means; a weak line afterwards makes recovery slow.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If you correctly judge the Influence line from which this cutting line starts to be the wife or husband, and if from it a chance line run to Mount of Jupiter, the ambitions of the wife or husband have led the subject to extravagances which he could not afford

rules.notes: Benham ends: 'and if the Saturn line be defective for the balance of its course, he will never recover from the reverses' - softened to a slow recovery.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कमज़ोर जीवन रेखा से आती चिंता-रेखाएँ भाग्य रेखा को काटें, तो ख़राब सेहत संभावनाओं के आड़े आती दिखती है; कटाव के बाद रेखा कमज़ोर रहे तो उबरने में लंबा समय लगता है।
rules.meaning_en: Worry lines from a weak life line cutting the fate line point to ill health standing in the way of prospects; a weak line after the cut suggests a long road back.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line be cut by Worry lines from the Life line which is defective, ill health will be a bar to the prospects of the subject, and if the Saturn line be defective after the cut the subject will never be able to get over it (385).

rules.notes: 'Will never be able to get over it' softened to a long road back.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरुआत में जंजीरदार या कमज़ोर भाग्य रेखा में कोई रेखा मिले और उसके बाद वह गहरी हो जाए, तो उसी जगह से किसी असर ने हालात सुधारे।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line chained or weak at the start that turns deep after a line merges into it shows an influence that improved one's condition from that point.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If, in the beginning, a Saturn line be chained or otherwise defective, and a chance line merges into it, after which it becomes deep, the influence which has come into the life has improved the subject's condition.

rules.notes: If the line only thins out or improves a little after the merge, the benefit is small; if it becomes deep, great (p.550).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से आकर भाग्य रेखा में मिलती रेखा किसी बाहरी व्यक्ति का, और शुक्र पर्वत से आती रेखा किसी नज़दीकी रिश्तेदार का असर दिखाती है; अच्छा असर वहीं से शुरू होता है जहाँ रेखा मिलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A line merging into the fate line from the Mount of the Moon brings an outside influence, one from the Mount of Venus a close relative's; its good effect begins where it merges.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this chance line comes from the Mount of Moon it will be some outside influence (388), if it comes from Mount of Venus it will be the influence of close relatives (389). At whatever point these chance lines merge into the Saturn line, the good effect of the influence will be exerted at the age indicated

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कोई रेखा भाग्य रेखा में बिना काटे मिल जाए, तो कोई घटना या व्यक्ति जीवन का हिस्सा बनता है पर करियर नहीं रुकता; मज़बूत मिलती रेखाएँ कमज़ोर भाग्य रेखा को सहारा देती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A chance line that merges into the fate line without cutting it marks an event or person becoming part of one's life without checking the career; strong merging lines support a weak fate line.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Some chance lines merge into the Saturn line (387). These lines represent events or influences which have come into and become a part of the life of the subject, but as they do not cut the line the career is not checked.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा की टूटन के पास मस्तिष्क रेखा से आती रेखा साथ-साथ चले, तो अच्छी समझ-बूझ उस कठिनाई से पार निकालती है।
rules.meaning_en: A chance line from the head line running beside a break in the fate line points to good judgement carrying one over that difficulty.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a Saturn line be broken, and a chance line from the Head line run alongside of it, the subject's good judgment will come to his relief and will carry him over his difficulty (391).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कमज़ोर भाग्य रेखा के साथ-साथ ऊपरी मंगल पर्वत से आती साफ़ रेखा चले, तो दृढ़ता व्यक्ति को निराशा से हारने नहीं देती।
rules.meaning_en: A line from a smooth, good Upper Mars running beside a weak fate line points to determination that keeps discouragement from overthrowing the person.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a defective Saturn line have a chance line from a smooth and good Upper Mars running by its side, the resistance of the Mount will not permit discouragements to overthrow the subject, and this determination will save him from trouble (392).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा के साथ-साथ बिना छुए चलती रेखाएँ सहायक बहन-रेखाओं का काम करती हैं — जब तक वे चलती हैं, करियर को सहारा मिलता है; वे कहाँ से शुरू होती हैं, उससे मदद का स्रोत पता चलता है।
rules.meaning_en: Chance lines running alongside the fate line without touching it act as sister lines, supporting the career while they run; where they start shows the source of help.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Other chance lines which do not touch the Saturn line, but run alongside of it (390), are lines exerting a strong influence on the subject's career, for by helping and supporting they act as sister lines.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरुआत में गहरी और मज़बूत भाग्य रेखा जीवन की आसान शुरुआत का संकेत है; पर ऐसी शुरुआत वाले कभी-कभी बाद में ठोकर खाते हैं, क्योंकि कठिनाई का अनुभव नहीं होता।
rules.meaning_en: A deep, strong fate line at its start points to an easy start in life, though those with the easiest start can stumble later, unused to adversity.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line at this period be deep and strong, he will have little difficulty in getting started in life. It is a noticeable fact that those subjects who have the best kind of a start often fall into trouble later on, because, never having experienced it, they do not know how to act under adversity

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क और हृदय रेखा के बीच भाग्य रेखा पर आड़ी रेखाएँ करियर की अड़चनें हैं; भाग्य रेखा उन्हें काटकर निकले तो कठिनाई पार होती है, वे उसे काटें तो पार पाना मुश्किल।
rules.meaning_en: Bars across the fate line between the head and heart lines are obstacles to the career; where the fate line cuts through them they are overcome, where they cut the line they are hard to pass.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this portion of the Saturn line be cut with cross-bars, the subject will meet with obstacles to his career (398). If the line cuts through these bars and severs them, the subject will overcome the difficulties; but if these bars cut the Saturn line he will have great difficulty in doing so.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क और हृदय रेखा के बीच भाग्य रेखा पर क्रॉस बार-बार के झटकों का संकेत हैं; रेखा उसके आगे जारी रहे तो व्यक्ति उन्हें झेल लेता है।
rules.meaning_en: Crosses on the fate line between the head and heart lines point to repeated reverses, withstood if the line continues beyond that stretch.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn lines between Head and Heart line be covered with crosses, the subject will have repeated reverses which he will withstand if the line continues after this period, but which will overcome him if it does not (397).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क और हृदय रेखा के बीच भाग्य रेखा का पूरा हिस्सा द्वीप से भरा हो, तो कामकाजी जीवन के उन अहम वर्षों में लगातार आर्थिक कठिनाई का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: An island filling the whole stretch of the fate line between the head and heart lines points to continuous money difficulty through those formative working years.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: When the entire space between the Head and Heart lines is filled with an island, there will be continuous financial difficulty during all of these years (394).

rules.notes: Benham: the stretch between the head and heart lines (thirty to forty-five on his scale) is the critical, formative financial period and the most often defective (pp.551-552).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा की टूटन को वर्ग जोड़ दे, तो उस मोड़ पर बड़ा झटका आता है, पर व्यक्ति उससे पार निकल जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break in the fate line repaired by a square points to a serious reverse at that point that one gets through.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If in this portion of the line a break should be repaired by a square, one side of which continues, the subject will have a serious reverse at the age indicated, but will be able to get through it (396).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: उस हिस्से में मस्तिष्क रेखा से आती रेखाएँ भाग्य रेखा को काटें, तो कठिनाइयों की जड़ निर्णय की ग़लतियों में दिखती है।
rules.meaning_en: Chance lines from the head line cutting the fate line in that stretch trace the difficulties to errors of judgement.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this portion of the Saturn line be cut by chance lines from the Head line, the difficulties will arise from errors of judgment (399).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: उस हिस्से में हृदय रेखा से आती रेखाएँ भाग्य रेखा को काटें, तो भावनाएँ कारोबारी समझ पर हावी होकर नुक़सान कराती दिखती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Chance lines from the heart line cutting the fate line in that stretch point to feelings getting the better of business sense, at a cost.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line during this period be cut by chance lines from the Heart line, the subject permits his affections to get the better of him, and sentiment in business is disastrous (400).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कमज़ोर जीवन रेखा से आती रेखाएँ उस हिस्से में भाग्य रेखा को काटें, तो आर्थिक रूप से अहम वर्षों में ख़राब सेहत करियर में बाधा बनती दिखती है।
rules.meaning_en: With a weak life line, lines from it cutting the fate line in that stretch point to ill health obstructing the career in the formative money years.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Life line be defective, and chance lines from it cut the Saturn line at the period between thirty and forty-five, ill health has obstructed the career during the financial formative period (401).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के भीतर से उठी भाग्य रेखा कुछ दूर गहरी चलकर कमज़ोर हो जाए, तो परिवार की मदद और महत्वाकांक्षा कुछ समय साथ देती हैं पर स्थायी सफलता नहीं; कारण वहीं है जहाँ से गिरावट शुरू होती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line rising inside the life line that runs deep for a while and then weakens points to family help and ambition carrying one for a time but not to lasting success; the cause lies where the decline begins.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line rises inside the Life line runs deep for a while and then becomes defective, the assistance of relatives and ambition help for a while, but do not bring ultimate success (406). At the point where the ill success begins, look for a cause.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: अपने सामान्य रास्ते से चलकर बृहस्पति पर्वत पर ख़त्म होने वाली भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि सफलता बड़ी महत्वाकांक्षा से मिलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that runs its usual course and ends on the Mount of Jupiter points to success won through great ambition.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line runs through its usual course in the centre of the hand and ends on the Mount of Jupiter, the success of the subject will be the result of great ambition (404).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के भीतर से उठकर बृहस्पति पर ख़त्म होने वाली गहरी भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि परिवार का साथ और बड़ी महत्वाकांक्षा मिलकर करियर को सफल बनाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A deep fate line rising inside the life line and ending on Jupiter points to family influence and great ambition together making the career a success.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line be deep and rises from inside the Life line ending on the Mount of Jupiter, the influence of relatives and great ambition unite to make the career of the subject a success (405).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऐसी कमज़ोर पड़ती भाग्य रेखा के साथ कोई चिंता-रेखा जीवन रेखा की उठती शाखा और दो-मुँही स्नेह-रेखा को काटे, तो दुखी विवाह को संभावनाएँ बिगाड़ने वाला कारण माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: When such a declining fate line goes with a worry line that cuts a rising branch of the life line and a forked affection line, an unhappy marriage is read as what injured one's prospects.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If such a Saturn line be seen, and a Worry line, cutting a rising line from the Life line, crosses the hand and cuts a forked line of Affection, an unhappy marriage has injured the prospects of the subject (407).

rules.notes: Dated where the fate line starts to fail (the decline of 406); the worry line does not cut the fate line itself.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऊपरी मंगल पर ख़त्म होने वाली भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि सफलता नेतृत्व, टिके रहने की ताक़त और हिम्मत न हारने से मिलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that turns to end on Upper Mars points to success through leadership, staying power and refusing to be discouraged.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If such a Saturn line ends on Upper Mars, the subject will achieve success from his leadership, power of resistance, and because he does not become discouraged (410).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से उठकर गहराई से बृहस्पति तक जाती भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि विपरीत लिंग के किसी व्यक्ति — अक्सर जीवनसाथी — का सहारा और अपनी महत्वाकांक्षा मिलकर समृद्धि लाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line rising on the Mount of the Moon and running deep to Jupiter points to prosperity from the support of someone of the opposite sex, often a spouse, joined to one's own ambition.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a Saturn line rises on the Mount of the Moon and runs deep and strong to the Mount of Jupiter, the influence of one of the opposite sex together with the great ambition of the subject cause his prosperity (408). If the confirmations of marriage be present, the influence will be husband or wife.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से उठकर मस्तिष्क रेखा से बिना काटे मिलती शाखा बताती है कि अच्छी समझ करियर को आकार देने में मदद करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the fate line rising to join the head line without cutting it points to sound judgement helping to shape the career.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a Saturn line have a branch rising and joining but not cutting the Head line, the subject will have the assistance of a good head in the shaping of his career (415).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से सूर्य पर्वत तक उठती शाखा कला, व्यापार या मंच में सफलता की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the fate line rising to the Mount of Apollo points to success in art, business or the stage.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a Saturn line which runs to the Mount of Saturn have a branch rising to the Mount of Apollo, the subject will win success in art, business, or as an actor, according to which phalanx of the Apollo finger rules (412).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से बृहस्पति पर्वत तक जाती शाखा बताती है कि जहाँ से शाखा निकलती है, वहाँ से महत्वाकांक्षा, नेतृत्व और लोगों का साथ पाने की क्षमता सफलता दिलाती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the fate line to the Mount of Jupiter points to success through ambition and the ability to lead and win support, from where the branch leaves.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line runs in its usual course, but a line branches from it to Mount of Jupiter, the subject's success will be largely their due to ambition and ability to command men and obtain support. Such a line is a fine one for a politician (411).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से बुध पर्वत तक उठती शाखा बताती है कि चतुराई, कारोबारी समझ और अच्छी अभिव्यक्ति सफलता में मदद करती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the fate line rising to Mercury points to shrewdness, business sense and clear expression helping one's success.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Saturn line have a branch rising to Mercury, the subject will have the assistance of shrewdness, business ability, good power of expression, and a scientific turn of mind to assist in his success (414).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से बृहस्पति और सूर्य — दोनों पर्वतों तक जाती शाखाएँ सबसे अनुकूल योग मानी जाती हैं: आगे धन और प्रतिष्ठा का संकेत।
rules.meaning_en: Branches from the fate line to both Jupiter and Apollo are read as the most favourable combination, pointing to wealth and recognition ahead.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a Saturn line have one branch rising to Jupiter, and one to Apollo, the subject will have an assured future of wealth and fame, for ambition and the Jupiterian attributes, the wisdom of Saturn, with brilliancy, art, and business from Apollo, are all united to assist him to a rich harvest (413).

rules.notes: Two branches: one to Jupiter and one to Apollo.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत पर गहरी भाग्य रेखा आरामदेह और सुरक्षित बाद के जीवन की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A deep fate line on the Mount of Saturn points to a comfortable, well-provided later life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: On some Mounts a deep line is seen, and this is a strong indication of well-to-do old age.

rules.notes: The same claim at p.534: 'the success in old age which comes to one with a strong line on the Mount'.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: अच्छे शुरुआती रास्ते के बाद शनि पर्वत से नीचे रुक जाने वाली भाग्य रेखा बताती है कि पीछे एक फलदायी जीवन है, जिसका फल बाद के वर्षों में मिलता है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that stops below the Mount of Saturn after a good early course points to a productive life behind one, its fruits enjoyed in the later years.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The presence of a Mount without a line shows at least that no forces are working against the subject, and if the line be good in its early course it shows that a productive life is behind him, and it will be found that he is enjoying in old age the result of his early labors.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कुछ दूर गहरी चलकर लहरदार होकर ख़त्म होने वाली भाग्य रेखा बाद के वर्षों में अनिश्चित करियर और चिंताओं की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that runs deep for part of its way and ends in a wavy stretch points to an uncertain career in the later years, with worries late in life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line runs deep for part of the way and terminates in a wavy line (416), the career during the latter years will be uncertain, and there will be worries in old age.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पहले गहरी रही भाग्य रेखा में बाद के हिस्से की टूटन जीवन के उत्तरार्ध की कठिनाइयों का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: Breaks late in a hitherto deep fate line point to trials in later life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: I mention this in order to warn against reading defective terminations as necessarily meaning poverty when the Saturn line has previously been deep for its entire course. Breaks in the line, bars cutting it, crosses or dots following a hitherto deep line, will indicate trials and crosses in old age.

rules.notes: 'If the line terminate in these signs at any age the reading will be the same, except that it applies to the age indicated on the line at the time at which it occurs' (pp.558-559).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पहले गहरी रही भाग्य रेखा पर बाद के हिस्से में बिंदु जीवन के उत्तरार्ध की कठिनाइयों का संकेत हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Dots appearing late in a hitherto deep fate line point to trials in later life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: I mention this in order to warn against reading defective terminations as necessarily meaning poverty when the Saturn line has previously been deep for its entire course. Breaks in the line, bars cutting it, crosses or dots following a hitherto deep line, will indicate trials and crosses in old age.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत पर भाग्य रेखा को काटती आड़ी रेखाएँ जीवन के उत्तरार्ध में नुक़सान और कठिनाइयों का संकेत हैं; न काटने वाली हल्की रेखाएँ केवल चिंताओं का।
rules.meaning_en: Bars cutting the fate line on the Mount of Saturn point to losses and trials in later life; faint bars that do not cut it, to worries.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line be crossed by bars which cut it on the Mount, the subject will suffer losses and trials in old age (419). If the bars be faint and do not cut the line they are troubles and worries.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत पर भाग्य रेखा पर क्रॉस जीवन के उत्तरार्ध में भारी कठिनाइयों और झटकों का संकेत हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Crosses on the fate line on the Mount of Saturn point to heavy trials and setbacks in later life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line has crosses on the Mount, great trials and misfortunes will harass the latter years of the subject (420).

rules.notes: All these terminations read the same at any age, applied 'to the age indicated on the line at the time at which it occurs' (pp.558-559).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: ऊँचाई से शुरू होकर केवल मस्तिष्क और हृदय रेखा के बीच फैली सूर्य रेखा बताती है कि जीवन के उस निर्माणकारी दौर में विशेष प्रतिभा काम करती है और उसे आसानी से पार कराती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line that starts high and spans only the space between the head and heart lines shows a special brilliance at work in that formative stretch of life, easing its passage.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line rises higher and covers the space between the Head and Heart lines, the special brilliancy of the subject will operate

rules.notes: The sentence runs over the page turn; p.564 continues: 'during the formative period of life, and will be of assistance in aiding him to pass this critical period with greater ease (425)'. The line runs from the head line to the heart line; the talent works over that span (the years between the two crossings on the Apollo scale).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कलाई से उठकर अपने पर्वत तक जाती सूर्य रेखा बड़ी प्रतिभा का संकेत है, जो जीवन भर विकसित होती रहती है और बहुत कुछ हासिल कराती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line rising from the wrist and running up to its mount points to a large talent that keeps developing through life and achieves much.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: A line of Apollo reaching from the wrist to the Mount indicates the possession of great talent, so great that it will continue to develop during the life of the subject, and he will achieve much (423).

rules.notes: Benham reads the line's length as the extent of its influence; a start at the wrist sits at the bottom of his Apollo scale.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ सूर्य रेखा गायब होकर आगे फिर शुरू होती है, उस अंतराल के समय में प्रतिभा सोई रहती है और बाद में फिर जागती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the sun line vanishes and later begins again, the person's talents lie dormant for the period the gap covers, then return.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line of Apollo be present, then disappears, and afterwards begins again, the talents of the subject during the period covered by the break in the line are simply latent (428). The period of life covered by this break can be read according to the scale laid down in Chapter IV.

rules.notes: Benham points to the Chapter IV scale for dating the gap; he adds that ill health or other defects in the hand may explain why the line vanishes.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंतराल वाली आयु पर यदि मस्तिष्क रेखा में दोष हो, तो कुछ समय मन की ऊर्जा घटती है और कामकाज पर पूरा ध्यान नहीं दिया जा पाता।
rules.meaning_en: If the head line is flawed at the same age as a gap in the sun line, the mind's energy runs low for a while and affairs lack the attention they need.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If at the age indicated by this space in the Apollo line, the Head line be defective, the mental power of the subject is weakened, and he cannot give the attention necessary to make his affairs successful (430).

rules.notes: A combination: the gap in the Apollo line and a defect in the head line at the same age. Benham's 'mental power ... weakened' is rendered as low mental energy, not as illness.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंतराल वाले वर्षों में यदि जीवन रेखा भी कमज़ोर हो, तो उस समय कमज़ोर सेहत प्रतिभा को काम करने से रोकती है।
rules.meaning_en: If the life line is also weak over the years of a gap in the sun line, low health is what holds the talents back for that time.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If during this period the Life line be in any way defective, delicate health is against the operation of the subject's talents (429).

rules.notes: A combination: the gap in the Apollo line and a defect in the life line at the same age.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ भाग्य रेखा कमज़ोर पड़ती है, वहाँ सूर्य रेखा का मज़बूत हिस्सा बहन-रेखा की तरह सहारा देता है और उस दौर में करियर को संभाले रखता है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the fate line weakens, a strong stretch of the sun line beside it acts as its sister line and carries the career through that period.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Frequently the lines of Saturn and Apollo are interdependent, and in many cases one will be strong at a time when the other is weak. In such an instance they operate upon each other as sister lines, and one repairs the damage to the other (427).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: गहरी और पतली होती सूर्य रेखा के गहरे हिस्से ऐसे दौर बताते हैं जब प्रयास तेज़ होते हैं और धन व प्रतिष्ठा दिलाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Deep stretches of a sun line that alternates deep and thin mark bursts of effort that bring money and reputation.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line be alternating deep and thin (439) the subject will have a series of successes and failures, but there will be no even, steady operation of a strong line. These subjects make some efforts which bring money and reputation, and then relapse into a state of inaction, which is periodically replaced by other series of efforts followed by stagnation.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: गहरी और पतली होती सूर्य रेखा के पतले हिस्से सफलता के बाद के ठहराव के दौर बताते हैं, जब कुछ समय प्रयास ढीले पड़ जाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Thin stretches of a sun line that alternates deep and thin mark lulls after a success, when effort slackens into inaction for a while.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line be alternating deep and thin (439) the subject will have a series of successes and failures, but there will be no even, steady operation of a strong line. These subjects make some efforts which bring money and reputation, and then relapse into a state of inaction, which is periodically replaced by other series of efforts followed by stagnation.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: अपने पर्वत पर समाप्त होते समय मज़बूत सूर्य रेखा बताती है कि जीवन का अंतिम दौर भी अच्छे प्रयासों, सफलता और प्रतिष्ठा वाला होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line that is strong where it ends on its mount points to a final period of life that is among its best efforts, with success and reputation.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this line be strong when it terminates on the Mount, it is a much more favorable indication of final success and reputation, as the last period of the life will be one of its better efforts.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा पर द्वीप ऐसे समय का संकेत है जब धन और ख्याति रुकती है और पैसा व प्रतिष्ठा खोने का ख़तरा रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the sun line marks a period when wealth and fame are held back, with a risk of losing money and standing.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If islands be seen in the line (442) they will prove serious obstructions. Islands appearing in a deep line will show that the realization of wealth and fame will be impeded, and the subject stands in danger of a positive loss of reputation and of money.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में तारा बताता है कि डगमगाती राह के बाद भी बाद के वर्ष सफलता और व्यापक ख्याति से भरे होते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A star ending the sun line points to later years crowned with success and wide reputation, even after an unsteady course.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this line should end in a star (441) the life will end brilliantly, the subject will have achieved wide reputation, and an unsteady though talented subject will have his work finally crowned with success.

rules.notes: Said of a wavy line; 'the life will end brilliantly' is read as the later years, not as a prediction about death.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: लहरदार सूर्य रेखा यदि अपने पर्वत पर जाकर मज़बूत हो जाए, तो डगमगाता करियर आख़िरकार किसी एक दिशा में ज़ोर पकड़ता है और नाम कमाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A wavy sun line that grows strong on its mount shows an unsettled career that finally gathers force in one direction and earns a name.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this line becomes strong on the Mount of Apollo, the subject will finally round up with force in some direction. It may be that he becomes a great wanderer, very erratic, or a crank, but he will earn reputation for something.

rules.notes: Said of a wavy line (fig. 440).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा को काटती आड़ी रेखाएँ उस दौर में सफलता की राह में रुकावटें दिखाती हैं; जहाँ वे रेखा को काटें, करियर पर उनका असर गहरा होता है।
rules.meaning_en: Bars cutting the sun line mark impediments to success at that period; where the bars cut the line, they weigh seriously on the career.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Bars cutting the line of Apollo (443) will show constant impediments to the success of the subject.

rules.notes: Benham: 'If the bars cut the line, the impediments will seriously affect the career.' Causes are located by chance lines, mounts and influence lines.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा में टूटन महत्वाकांक्षा और तरक्की में झटका दिखाती है; उस अंतराल में रेखा के शुभ प्रभाव रुक जाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A break in the sun line marks a setback to ambition and upward progress; the line's good influences stop working across the gap.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Breaks in the Apollo line (445) indicate setbacks to the ambition and upward course of the subject, and are impediments which destroy the usefulness of the line

rules.notes: The sentence ends on p.573: '... and render inoperative all of its beneficial influences.' Benham adds that with breaks one cannot see more than ordinary success, and many failures.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा पर बिंदु उस दौर में प्रतिष्ठा पर ख़तरे का संकेत है: छोटा बिंदु पीठ पीछे की बातें, बड़ा और गहरा बिंदु नेकनामी का वास्तविक नुकसान।
rules.meaning_en: A dot on the sun line threatens reputation at that period: a small one, whispers against the person; a large, deep one, a real loss of good name.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Dots on the Apollo line (444) are a menace to the reputation of the subject. If they be small they only indicate the whisperings of enemies, but if they be large and deep, they indicate the actual loss of good name.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के ऊपर से गुज़रती महीन रेखाएँ परेशान करने वाली दख़लअंदाज़ी दिखाती हैं, जो कुछ समय चिंता बनाए रखती है और प्रगति धीमी करती है।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines running over the top of the sun line mark annoying interferences that keep the person worried and slow progress for a while.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If these bars are little fine lines which seem only to run over the top of the Apollo line, they are annoying interferences, which keep the subject constantly worried and by disturbing his mental peace impede his progress.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ सूर्य रेखा अपने ऊपर की आड़ी रेखाओं को काटकर आगे बढ़ती है, वहाँ उस दौर की बाधाएँ पार हो जाती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Where the sun line runs through the bars that cross it, the obstacles of that period are overcome.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Apollo line cuts through these bars, the subject will overcome the obstacles.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरू में गहरी और फिर पतली होकर मिटती सूर्य रेखा बताती है कि सबसे अच्छा दौर वही है जब रेखा गहरी है; आगे चलकर कमाई की क्षमता घटती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line deep at its start that thins and fades away shows the best period while it is deep, with earning power waning as life goes on.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If it be a deep line at the start and grows thin until it gradually fades away, the best period of the life will be during the time when the line is deep, and the wealth-producing capacity will diminish as the life progresses.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में बिंदु बताता है कि समृद्ध जीवन के बाद आख़िरी वर्षों में प्रतिष्ठा को ठेस लग सकती है।
rules.meaning_en: A dot ending the sun line points to a blow to reputation in later years, after a life of prosperity.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Apollo ends in a dot (448) the subject will after a life of prosperity lose his reputation in the end.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में तारा बाद के वर्षों में शानदार सफलता का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A star at the end of the sun line is a sign of brilliant success in the later years.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line of Apollo ends in a star (449) it will be an indication of brilliant success. A star on the Mount of Apollo is an electric light ending a good line, and intensifies the entire combination.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा की टूटन पर मरम्मत का चिह्न, जैसे वर्ग, उस दौर की बाधाओं से उबरने और हालात सुधारने में मदद करता है।
rules.meaning_en: A repair sign at a break in the sun line, such as a square, helps overcome that period's obstacles and bring better conditions.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: With all breaks seen in the line, look for repair signs which will tend to overcome the obstacles and bring about better conditions.

rules.notes: Benham's 'usual repair signs' (fig. 446) include squares and overlapping or sister lines; square is the closest single feature. He adds that a repaired line is no better in grade than a broad and shallow one.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा पर दो तारे हों तो पहला तारा बताता है कि बड़ी सफलता पहली बार कब आती है, और अंत का तारा बताता है कि वह ख्याति अंत तक बनी रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: Of two stars on the sun line, the first marks when great success first arrives, and the one at the end shows that renown lasting to the end.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In these cases the first star will indicate the age at which the subject will first achieve great success, and the star at the end of the line will indicate that this prosperity and renown will continue to the end of life.

rules.notes: Benham states outright that the first star's position gives the age of the first great success.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में गहरी आड़ी रेखा जीवन के आख़िरी दौर में करियर पर ऐसी गंभीर रुकावट दिखाती है जिसे पार करना कठिन होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A deep bar ending the sun line marks a serious check to the career late in life, one that is hard to get past.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line of Apollo ends in a deep bar the life will meet some obstruction near the close which will be insurmountable (452). This will be a decided check to the career

rules.notes: Benham's 'insurmountable' softened to 'hard to get past'. The health combination that follows (life line defective near fifty) is excluded.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: तारे से शुरू होकर तारे पर ही समाप्त होती सूर्य रेखा जीवन की शुरुआत से अंत तक प्रतिभा और सफलता का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line that begins with a star and ends with one points to brilliance and success from the very start of life through all of it.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the Apollo line begins with a star and ends with one, the subject will be brilliant and successful from the time of birth, throughout the entire life (451).

rules.notes: The star at the line's start dates the beginning of the success.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में क्रॉस आड़ी रेखा से भी बड़ी रुकावट है: प्रतिष्ठा पर दाग़ और निर्णय की भूलें, जो बाद की राह बिगाड़ देती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A cross at the end of the sun line is a heavier obstruction than a bar: a blemish on reputation and mistakes of judgement that sour the later course.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: A cross on the end of the line of Apollo (456) is a worse obstruction than a bar. It means an absolute blemish to the reputation of the subject. It also indicates poor judgment, and the subject will make many mistakes in the course of his life, which consequently terminates unfavorably.

rules.notes: 'Terminates unfavorably' is read as the career's later course, not as a prediction about death.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में द्वीप, रेखा कितनी भी अच्छी हो, बाद के वर्षों पर धन और प्रतिष्ठा के नुकसान की छाया डालता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island at the end of the sun line clouds the later years with a loss of money and reputation, however good the line is otherwise.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
