citation.quote: An island on the end of the line of Apollo (458) is a most unfavorable indication. No matter how good the line may be, this marking will cloud the latter days of the subject, for it will indicate the loss of money and reputation.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में वर्ग हर तरह की हानि से रक्षा देता है, जिसका असर केवल बाद के वर्षों में नहीं बल्कि पूरे जीवन में रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: A square at the end of the sun line gives protection from harm of every kind, felt not only in later years but throughout life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: A square on the end of a line of Apollo (457) will indicate protection from evils of all sorts. It will exert its influence not only on the end of the life, but during the whole of it.

rules.notes: Benham adds that a square surrounding any unfavourable termination largely mitigates it.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के अंत में साफ़ त्रिशूल लगभग तारे जितना शुभ है: मानसिक प्रयास से मिली प्रसिद्धि और धन।
rules.meaning_en: A well-marked trident at the end of the sun line is nearly as good as a star: celebrity and wealth won through mental effort.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: A well marked trident on the end of the line of Apollo (460) is nearly as good a marking as a star. It indicates celebrity and wealth from mental efforts.

rules.notes: A trident is a three-pronged fork; the two-pronged fork at the end (fig. 459, diffused talent) is a character reading and is not extracted.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पर्वत पर सूर्य रेखा के दोनों ओर चलती बहन-रेखाएँ उसे और बल देती हैं और उस दौर में सबसे बड़ी सफलता का संकेत देती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Sister lines running on the mount on either side of the sun line add their strength to it, pointing to the greatest success in that stretch.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If two parallel sister lines are seen on the Mount one on each side of the Apollo line (461) they give their added strength to an already fine indication.

rules.notes: Benham: 'when supported on both sides by strong sister lines, the subject will have the greatest success'; older palmists called them lines of reputation.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा से नीचे गिरती महीन रेखाएँ चढ़ाई भरी राह दिखाती हैं: सफलता के लिए ज़्यादा और लगातार मेहनत चाहिए, और कुछ समय बोझ बहुत भारी लगता है।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines falling from the sun line mark an uphill pull: success needs greater, steadier effort, and there are times when the load feels very heavy.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Fine lines falling from the line indicate that the subject will need greater and more constant effort to achieve success. He will have an up-hill pull

rules.notes: The sentence continues on p.578: 'and there will be times when the load gets very heavy. He does not overcome obstacles easily'. The scan's text layer garbles 'falling' on p.577.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा से ऊपर उठती शाखाएँ उसके शुभ प्रभाव को बढ़ाती हैं और सफलता को अधिक निश्चित बनाती हैं; जीवन बाधाओं के ऊपर से तैर जाने जितना हल्का लगता है।
rules.meaning_en: Branches rising from the sun line add to its good effect and make success more certain; life seems buoyant enough to float over obstacles.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Branches or fine lines rising from the line of Apollo (465) will increase the good effect of the line, and when seen on a good line will make the success of the subject more certain.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: अंत में दो शाखाओं में बँटती सूर्य रेखा, एक शनि पर्वत और एक बुध पर्वत की ओर, विवेक, प्रतिभा और चतुराई को जोड़कर धन और ख्याति की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line ending in two branches, one to the Mount of Saturn and one to Mercury, joins wisdom, brilliance and shrewdness and points to wealth and renown.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If on the end of the Apollo line, one branch goes to the Mount of Saturn, and one to the Mount of Mercury (464), the subject will have combined wisdom (Saturn), brilliancy (Apollo), and shrewdness (Mercury), and with this combination he will reap wealth and renown.

rules.notes: The fork's two prongs run to the Mounts of Saturn and Mercury.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा से गुरु पर्वत की ओर उठती शाखा प्रतिभा के साथ महत्वाकांक्षा और नेतृत्व जोड़ती है; सफलता मिलती है, और धन न भी मिले तो ख्याति मिलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising from the sun line to the Mount of Jupiter joins talent with ambition and leadership; success follows, and fame if not wealth.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: A rising branch going to the Mount of Jupiter will show that, coupled with great talent, the subject has strong ambition and the power of leadership. With this combination he will be successful, and is sure to win fame if he does not secure wealth.

rules.notes: Benham: a branch's meaning is read from where it ends; its date from where it leaves the line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा से शनि पर्वत की ओर जाती शाखा विवेक, संयम और संतुलन जोड़ती है, जिससे सफलता बढ़ती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the sun line to the Mount of Saturn adds wisdom, sobriety and balance, which increase success.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a branch from the Apollo line rises to the Mount of Saturn, wisdom, soberness, frugality, a scientific turn of mind, and the balancing qualities of Saturn will increase the success of the subject.

rules.notes: Crosses, bars or dots ending such branches turn the reading to loss of reputation (p.579).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा से बुध पर्वत की ओर जाती शाखा प्रतिभा के साथ चतुराई, व्यापारिक समझ और अभिव्यक्ति की शक्ति जोड़ती है और विशिष्ट सफलता की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the sun line to the Mount of Mercury brings shrewdness, business sense and powers of expression to the aid of talent, pointing to distinguished success.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a branch from the line of Apollo rises to the Mount of Mercury the qualities of that Mount will come to the assistance of the subject. He will have shrewdness, business ability, a scientific turn of mind, and great powers of expression, in addition to all the train of Apollonian brilliancies, and will achieve distinguished success in some direction.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा से मंगल पर्वत की ओर जाती शाखा आत्मनिर्भरता और टिके रहने की ताक़त जोड़ती है: व्यक्ति जल्दी हिम्मत नहीं हारता और अपना रास्ता बना लेता है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the sun line to the Mount of Mars adds self-reliance and staying power: the person is not easily discouraged and pushes a way through.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a branch from the Apollo line rises to the Mount of Mars (471), the subject will have added to his Apollonian character the sterling qualities of Mars. Thus he will be self-reliant, able to defend himself, not easily discouraged, and if necessary will force his way through the world.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से आकर सूर्य रेखा से मिलती शाखा कल्पना और सजीव अभिव्यक्ति जोड़ती है; यह लेखक के रूप में सफलता की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch joining the sun line from the Mount of Moon adds imagination and vivid expression; it points to success as a writer.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a branch from the Apollo line comes from the Mount of Moon (472) the subject will have the power of imagination, the ability to paint word pictures, and a good power of expression. As an author he will be successful.

rules.notes: Benham calls it a branch of the Apollo line that 'comes from' the Mount of Moon; it runs between the line and the Moon, below the line.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा से निकलकर मस्तिष्क रेखा में मिलती शाखा बताती है कि सफलता को बुद्धि के विवेक और आत्मसंयम का सहारा मिलता है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the sun line merging into the head line shows success supported by the mind's judgement and self-control.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: A branch from the line of Apollo merging into the Head line (474) will indicate that the subject will receive support from his mental powers.

rules.notes: Benham does not say whether the branch runs up or down to the head line; falling is assumed because the Apollo line proper lies mostly above it. A triangle where the branch meets the head line shows unusual mental power.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से आकर सूर्य रेखा में मिलती रेखा बताती है कि स्नेही और सहानुभूति भरा स्वभाव ऐसे मित्र दिलाता है जो आगे बढ़ने में मदद करते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A line from the heart line merging into the sun line shows a warm, sympathetic nature winning friends who help the person's interests.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line from the line of Heart merges into the Apollo line (475) the subject will be much assisted by goodness of heart.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत से आकर सूर्य रेखा के साथ चलती प्रभाव रेखाएँ बताती हैं कि रिश्तेदार सहानुभूति, सलाह और सहारे से, कभी पैसों से भी, सफलता में मदद करते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Influence lines from the Mount of Venus running beside the sun line show relatives helping success with sympathy, counsel and support, sometimes money too.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: Influence lines from the Mount of Venus which run along the side of the line of Apollo show the assistance of relatives to the success of the subject (476). These have often been read as legacies from relatives, but they do not necessarily indicate this particular form of help. They are sympathy, counsel, and support, as well as financial aid.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से निकलकर सूर्य रेखा को काटती शाखा बताती है कि उस समय भावनात्मक लगाव सफलता की राह में आड़े आता है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the heart line cutting the sun line shows the affections standing in the way of success at that time.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line branching from the Heart line cuts the line of Apollo, the affections will stand in the way of the subject's success (477).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुरुआत में दो शाखाओं वाली स्नेह-रेखा असाधारण रूप से गहरे लगाव की ओर इशारा करती है — मानो दो धाराएँ मिलकर एक हो गई हों।
rules.meaning_en: An affection line that begins with a fork marks an attachment of unusual strength, two currents joined into one.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Affection begin with a fork (315) it shows that the affection is of unusual strength, the two lines of the fork having united to form a single line, producing the effect of two Currents turned into one, which thus takes on double strength.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: हर स्नेह-रेखा एक गहरे लगाव का संकेत है; पर्वत पर उसकी ऊँचाई बताती है कि वह जीवन में कब आया, लंबाई बताती है कि कितना चला, और सबसे गहरी रेखा सबसे मज़बूत लगाव की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: Each affection line marks a deep attachment, placed in life by where it sits on the mount; its length shows how long the bond lasts, and the deepest line the strongest.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: The age at which each occurs is read from the Mount subdivided, and the duration from the length of the line. By this method read the number of strong attachments the subject has had and how long each one lasts, and by the longest and deepest line determine which one has been deeper than the rest (318).

rules.notes: The highest line is the most recent and lower lines record former affections (p.524). Benham qualifies reading an affection line as marriage by hand type (p.521): on a Jupiterian a line early in life is most often marriage; on a Saturnian it must be very strong and well toward middle life. That type condition cannot be expressed in this vocabulary.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: कई रेखाओं में अगर शुरुआती रेखा अपने अंत तक गहरी बनी रहे, तो पहला प्रेम कभी पूरी तरह मिटता नहीं — बाद के लगावों के बाद भी।
rules.meaning_en: Among several lines, an early one that stays deep to its end suggests a first love that never fully faded, even after later attachments.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: one a deep line, but one of the early lines deep at the end, it indicates that the early love has never entirely disappeared (320).

rules.notes: The sentence opens 'If a number of lines be seen, the upper one a deep line'; the scan prints the captions of figs. 317-319 between 'the upper' and 'one', so the quote starts after them.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: सबसे ऊपरी रेखा पतली हो पर वही विवाह-रेखा निकले, और ठीक नीचे एक मज़बूत रेखा हो, तो परंपरा इसे गहरे प्रेम से ज़्यादा सुविधा या सुरक्षा के लिए हुए विवाह का संकेत मानती है।
rules.meaning_en: When the latest line is thin yet proves to be the union, and a stronger line lies close beneath it, tradition reads a marriage made more for security or convenience than for the strongest love.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: and also determine by the character of the lines how completely this attachment has passed away. If the last line be a thin one, and yet by its length and confirmatory signs proves to be the Marriage line, and if a stronger line lie close under it (321) the subject has married for convenience, or money, but not from strongest love.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बराबर गहराई की दो स्नेह-रेखाएँ साथ-साथ चलें, तो एक ही समय में दो लोगों से बराबर लगाव का संकेत माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: Two affection lines of equal depth running side by side point to two people loved equally at the same time.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If two lines run alongside of each other and are of the same depth (319) the subject has loved two persons equally well at the same time.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: गहरी शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे पतली होती स्नेह-रेखा ऐसे लगाव की ओर इशारा करती है जो समय के साथ अपनी ताक़त खोता जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An affection line that starts deep and slowly thins points to an attachment that gradually loses its strength.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line start deep and gradually grow thin the subject will gradually lose the strength of his attachment (322).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा पर द्वीप रिश्ते में कुछ समय की उदासी या तनाव का संकेत है, जो द्वीप जितना ही चलता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the affection line marks a stretch of unhappiness within the relationship, lasting as long as the island.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If an island appear on the line of Affection, there will be some unhappiness during the course of the affection (324).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पतली शुरू होकर मज़बूत होती स्नेह-रेखा ऐसे लगाव का संकेत है जो समय के साथ और गहरा होता जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An affection line that starts thin and grows stronger points to an attachment that deepens with time.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line start thin and gradually become stronger the subject will grow stronger in his attachment (323).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा से सूर्य पर्वत तक जाती शाखा तारे पर ख़त्म हो, तो किसी प्रतिभाशाली या प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति से लगाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the affection line into the Mount of Apollo, ending in a star, points to an attachment to someone gifted or well known.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line of Affection send a branch into the Mount of Apollo which ends in a star, the subject will have an affection for someone brilliant and famous (328).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा पर क्रॉस रिश्ते की राह में किसी गंभीर रुकावट की ओर इशारा करता है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross on the affection line points to a serious obstacle in the course of the relationship.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a cross be seen on the line of Affection there will be a serious impediment to the affection (326).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा के अंत में दो-मुँही शाखा बताती है कि साथी धीरे-धीरे दूर हो सकते हैं और लगाव कमज़ोर पड़ सकता है; यह वैवाहिक जीवन में दख़ल का संकेत है, हमेशा अलगाव का नहीं।
rules.meaning_en: A fork at the end of the affection line points to the pair drifting apart and the bond weakening; tradition reads interference in married life, not necessarily a final split.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line of Affection fork at its termination (329), the affection will separate and become less strong. This has been used by the older palmists as an indication of divorce. It is a likelihood of interference in the married life, but not always divorce.

rules.notes: A fork that is not wide (330, p.527) shows a less serious estrangement than a wide one.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: तारे पर ख़त्म होती स्नेह-रेखा बताती है कि रिश्ता धीरे-धीरे नहीं, किसी अचानक टकराव के साथ टूट सकता है।
rules.meaning_en: An affection line ending in a star suggests the bond ends abruptly, in an outburst rather than a slow fading.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If this line end in a star the affection will terminate in an explosion (327).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा में टूटन उस दौर में रिश्ते में खलल या रुकावट का संकेत है; पास में मरम्मत के चिह्न हों तो असर हल्का होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A break in the affection line points to the relationship being disturbed or interrupted at that stage; signs of repair beside it soften the reading.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line be broken it will indicate that the affection is interfered with or broken in some way (334). Look for repair signs.

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा पर बिंदु रिश्ते की राह में किसी अड़चन का संकेत है; रेखा का अंत बताता है कि आगे क्या होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A dot on the affection line marks an obstacle in the course of the relationship; how the line ends shows the outcome.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a dot be seen on a line of Affection, it indicates an impediment to the course of the affections (337), the termination of the line showing the outcome, for if the line end in a fork, trident, or tassel the affection will be dissipated (338)

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा से नीचे झुकती शाखाएँ वैवाहिक जीवन में दुख और निराशा के दौर की ओर इशारा करती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Branches drooping from the affection line mark stretches of sorrow and disappointment in married life.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If branches droop from the line of Affection the married life will be full of sorrows and disappointments (332).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: पर्वत पर हुक की तरह मुड़ती स्नेह-रेखा ऐसे लगाव का संकेत है जो छूट जाता है और फिर नहीं लौटता।
rules.meaning_en: An affection line that hooks on the mount points to an attachment that is lost and not regained.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line make a hook on the Mount, the subject will lose his affection, which will not be regained (336).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा से ऊपर उठती शाखाएँ ऐसे रिश्ते का संकेत हैं जो व्यक्ति को ऊपर उठाता है और उसके लिए फ़ायदेमंद रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: Branches rising from the affection line point to a relationship that uplifts and benefits the person.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If branches rise from the line of Affection, the subject will be uplifted and the affection will be a benefit to him (333).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा की टूटन को घेरता वर्ग बताता है कि बिगड़ा हुआ रिश्ता फिर संभल जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A square enclosing a break in the affection line suggests the disturbed bond is recovered.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the break be enclosed in a square the subject will recover the disturbed affection (335).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: त्रिशूल या झब्बे जैसी शाखाओं में ख़त्म होती स्नेह-रेखा लगाव के बिखरकर घुल जाने की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: An affection line ending in a trident or tassel points to the attachment scattering and dissolving.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If the line end in a trident or a tassel, it shows the utter dissipation and scattering of the affection (331).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत की किसी नज़दीकी प्रभाव-रेखा से निकली रेखा दो-मुँही स्नेह-रेखा को काटे, तो किसी क़रीबी रिश्तेदार का दख़ल विवाह की ख़ुशी कम करता दिखता है।
rules.meaning_en: A line from a close influence line on the Mount of Venus cutting a forked affection line points to a near relative's interference taking some of the joy out of the marriage.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If a line from a close line of Influence cut a forked line of Affection, the married life of the subject will be interfered with by a near relative (341). The forked line shows that the subject loses some enjoyment of the marriage relation through this interference.

rules.notes: If the affection line also ends in a tassel, the reading is intensified (342).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: बिंदु के बाद स्नेह-रेखा पतली होती जाए, तो वहाँ से लगाव धीरे-धीरे फीका पड़ता जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: If the affection line grows thin after a dot, the attachment fades away gradually from that point.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If after the dot the line grows thin, the affection disappears gradually (339).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत से आती चिंता-रेखाएँ स्नेह-रेखा को काटें, तो जहाँ काटें उस दौर में वैवाहिक जीवन में रिश्तेदारों के दख़ल का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: Worry lines from the Mount of Venus cutting the affection line point to relatives interfering in married life, at the stage where they cut.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: If Worry lines run from the Mount of Venus to the lines of Affection, and cut these lines, it shows that relatives are interfering with the married life of the subject (340).

rules.author: Benham
rules.work: The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
rules.meaning_hi: स्नेह-रेखा के किसी दोष से हथेली में कहीं और की कमी तक जाती रेखा बताती है कि वहाँ की परेशानी — कभी सेहत पर असर भी — इसी रिश्ते की खलल से जुड़ी है।
rules.meaning_en: A chance line from a blemish on the affection line to a flaw elsewhere in the hand ties that later trouble, sometimes a strain on health, to this disturbance in the relationship.

citation.text: Benham — The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading
citation.quote: In this manner chance lines will be seen running from obstructions in the line of Affection to various parts of the hand, sometimes to defective Life lines, or health defects of the Mounts. In all these cases the trouble pointed to will be brought on by an interference or blemish seen in the line of Affection.

rules.notes: Benham adds that each defect in the line of Affection indicates an event in the life of the subject (p.529), which is the basis for dating marks along the line by its course scale.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के साथ चलती सहायक (बहन) रेखा उसे मज़बूत करती है: मुख्य रेखा की टूटन पर पुल-सा बन जाता है और उस बिंदु का ख़तरा घटता है।
rules.meaning_en: A sister line running beside the life line strengthens it: a break in the main line is bridged over and the danger at that point lessened.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.III, p.75, Plate XVI (a-a)
citation.quote: When an important line, such as the line of head or of life, is found with what is called a sister line (a-a, Plate XVI.), namely, a fine line running by its side, it is a sign that the main line is thus strengthened; consequently any break in the main line will be, as it were, bridged over by this mark, and the danger lessened or prevented.

rules.notes: Cheiro says it is found more often with the life line than any other; the head-line reading is head-sister-line-bridges-break.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: गुरु पर्वत के नीचे रेखा की शुरुआत में ज़ंजीर जैसा हिस्सा बचपन या शुरुआती वर्षों में कमज़ोर सेहत का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A chained start under the Jupiter mount points to poor health in the early years of life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line is chained at the commencement under Jupiter, bad health in early life is foreshadowed.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा का ज़ंजीर जैसा हिस्सा कमज़ोर सेहत और घटी हुई ऊर्जा का दौर दिखाता है; नरम हाथ पर इसका असर ज़्यादा माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A chained stretch of the life line marks a period of poor health and low vitality, felt more on a soft hand.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.80, Plate XIV fig. 10
citation.quote: When the line is linked (Fig. 10, Plate XIV.) or made up of little pieces like a chain, it is a sure sign of bad health, and particularly so on a soft hand.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: कमज़ोर हिस्से के बाद जहाँ रेखा फिर से साफ़ और अटूट हो जाती है, वहाँ से सेहत लौटने लगती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the line becomes even and unbroken again after a weak stretch, health tends to return from that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line recovers its evenness and continuity, health also is regained.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जो जीवन रेखा हाथ के किनारे के बजाय गुरु पर्वत की जड़ से शुरू हो, वह बचपन से ही जीवन में महत्वाकांक्षा का संकेत देती है।
rules.meaning_en: A life line that starts from the base of the Jupiter mount rather than the side of the hand points to ambition shaping life from its earliest years.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line starts from the base of the Mount of Jupiter, instead of the side of the hand, it denotes that from the earliest the life has been one of ambition.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से नीचे गिरती या उससे चिपकी बारीक रेखाएँ उस बिंदु पर कमज़ोरी और ऊर्जा घटने का संकेत देती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Fine hair-lines dropping from or clinging to the life line mark weakness and a loss of vitality at the point where they appear.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When little hair-lines are found dropping from or clinging to the line of life, they tell of weakness and loss of vitality at the date when they appear.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से ऊपर उठती हर रेखा बढ़ी हुई ताक़त, लाभ और सफलता का संकेत है, जिसका समय वहीं से पढ़ा जाता है जहाँ वह रेखा से निकलती है।
rules.meaning_en: Every line rising from the life line marks added strength, gains and success, dated where it leaves the line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: All lines that rise from the line of life are marks of increased power, gains, and successes.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: गुरु पर्वत की ओर उठती शाखा पद में उन्नति और अधिकार में एक क़दम ऊपर जाने का संकेत देती है, उस बिंदु से जहाँ वह जीवन रेखा से निकलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising to the Jupiter mount marks a rise in position, a step up in power, from the point where it leaves the life line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.81, Plate XVIII (c-c)
citation.quote: If such a line ascend toward or run into the Mount of Jupiter (c-c, Plate XVIII.), it will denote a rise in position or step higher at the date it leaves the line of life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से बुध पर्वत तक जाती शाखा व्यापार या विज्ञान में सफलता का संकेत देती है, हाथ के प्रकार के अनुसार।
rules.meaning_en: A branch crossing from the life line to the Mercury mount points to success in business or science, shaped by the type of hand.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If it leave the line of life and cross to Mercury, it promises great success in business or science, again in accordance with the class of hand

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शनि की ओर उठकर भाग्य रेखा के साथ चलती शाखा अपने परिश्रम और दृढ़ता से बढ़ते धन और सांसारिक लाभ का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising toward Saturn and running beside the fate line points to growing wealth and worldly gain, won by one's own energy and resolve.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.81, Plate XVIII (d-d)
citation.quote: If the line, on the contrary, rise to Saturn and follow by the side of the line of fate, it denotes the increase of wealth and worldly things, but resulting from the subject's own energy and determination

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से निकलकर सूर्य पर्वत तक जाती शाखा प्रतिष्ठा और पहचान का संकेत है, जिसका रूप हाथ के प्रकार पर निर्भर करता है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch leaving the life line for the Sun mount marks distinction, of a kind that depends on the type of hand.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the line leave the line of life and ascend to the Mount of the Sun, it denotes distinction according to the class of hand.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत की ओर से आकर केवल जीवन रेखा को काटती रेखा घरेलू जीवन में रिश्तेदारों के दख़ल का संकेत है; समय वहीं से पढ़ा जाता है जहाँ वह काटती है।
rules.meaning_en: A line from the Venus side that cuts only the life line points to interference by relatives, usually in home life, dated where it cuts.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.82, Plate XVII (g-g)
citation.quote: When they cut the line of life only (g-g, Plate XVII.), they denote the interference of relatives — generally in the home life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के साथ-साथ चलती साफ़ और समान रेखाएँ जीवन पर दूसरे लोगों के अनुकूल प्रभाव दिखाती हैं, जब तक वे साथ चलती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Even, well-formed lines running along with the life line mark favourable influences of other people over the life, for as long as they run.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.82, Plate XVII (f-f)
citation.quote: that all even, well-formed lines following the line of life indicate favorable influences over the life (f-f, Plate XVII.),

rules.notes: p.83 restates it: ray-lines running parallel to attend the life line 'denote the most important influences of our lives'.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा की बिल्कुल शुरुआत में साफ़ द्वीप जन्म की परिस्थितियों से जुड़े किसी रहस्य या अनजानी बात का संकेत माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A clear island at the very start of the life line is read as something unusual or unknown about the circumstances of one's birth.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: but a clearly formed island at the commencement of the line of life denotes some mystery connected with the subject's birth.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा पर द्वीप उतने समय तक बीमारी या कमज़ोर सेहत का दौर दिखाता है, जितना लंबा वह द्वीप है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the life line marks a spell of illness or lowered health that lasts as long as the island does.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.82, Plate XIX (b)
citation.quote: An island on the line of life means an illness or loss of health while the island lasts (b, Plate XIX.),

rules.notes: Repeated in Ch.XXI, p.129: 'When on the line of life, it denotes illness and delicacy at that particular point.'

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा पर वर्ग सुरक्षा का चिह्न है: उस बिंदु पर आने वाला ख़तरा टल जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A square on the life line marks protection: a danger met at that point is warded off.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.82, Plate XIX (c)
citation.quote: A square, whenever found on the line of life, is a mark of preservation.

rules.notes: Ch.XX, p.127 adds that the square protects even where the line is broken at that point.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: उलटी दिशा से उठकर जीवन रेखा को काटने वाली रेखाएँ दूसरों के विरोध और दख़ल से आई चिंताओं और रुकावटों का संकेत हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Lines rising against the life line and cutting it mark worries and obstacles caused by other people's opposition and interference.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.82, Plate XVII (g-g)
citation.quote: but that all those rising in the opposite direction and cutting the life-line show worries and obstacles caused by the opposition and interference of others

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मंगल पर्वत से उठकर जीवन रेखा को छूने या काटने वाली प्रभाव रेखा किसी दुखद लगाव का संकेत है, अक्सर जीवन के शुरुआती दौर में, जो बहुत परेशानी लाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line rising on the Mars mount that touches or strikes the life line points to an unhappy attachment, often early in life, that brings much trouble.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.83, Plate XVIII (e-e)
citation.quote: if the ray-line rise on the Mount of Mars (e-e, Plate XVIII.), and lower down touch or attack the life-line in any way, it denotes on a woman's hand some unfavorable attachment in her early life which will cause her much trouble and annoyance.

rules.notes: Cheiro reads the ray-lines of this Hindu system on a woman's hand.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: अगर वह रेखा जीवन रेखा तक केवल शाखाएँ भेजे, तो वही परेशान करने वाला प्रभाव बीच-बीच में लौटता है; हर शाखा एक वापसी का समय दिखाती है।
rules.meaning_en: If that line only sends offshoots to the life line, the same troubling influence returns at intervals, each offshoot marking a return.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, pp.83-84, Plate XVIII (f-f)
citation.quote: If the same line, however, only send offshoots or rays to the line of life (f-f, Plate XVIII.), it denotes a similar influence, but one that will continue

rules.notes: The sentence ends on p.84 ('to persecute her at different intervals'); the quote stops at the page turn because the running head between the pages would break the match.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: किसी कटी रेखा से मिलकर हाथ पार करने वाली प्रभाव रेखा किसी तीसरे के कारण प्रेम के शत्रुता में बदलने का संकेत है, जो जीवन रेखा को छूने के बिंदु पर नुक़सान करती है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that joins a cross-line and runs over the hand marks an affection turned hostile through a third person, doing harm where it touches the life line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.84, Plate XIX (e-e)
citation.quote: When one of these attendant lines joins a cross-line and runs over the hand with it, it foretells that through the instrumentality of another the affection of the person influencing the life will change to hate, and that this will cause injury at whatever point it touch the life, the fate, the head, or the line of heart (e-e, Plate XIX.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के पास से उठकर साथ चलने वाली प्रभाव रेखा जीवन में एक कोमल स्वभाव वाले व्यक्ति के आने का संकेत है, जिस पर आपका गहरा असर रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that rises beside the life line and travels with it marks a gentler person entering the life, over whom one has strong influence.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.84, Plate XVII (f-f)
citation.quote: If, however, the ray-line should rise by the side of the line of life and travel by the side of it (f-f, Plate XVII.), it shows, on the woman's hand, that the man who enters into her life has the gentler nature, and that she will strongly influence him.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से दूर शुक्र पर्वत की ओर हटती प्रभाव रेखा किसी क़रीबी की घटती सहानुभूति और धीरे-धीरे जीवन से दूर हो जाने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that drifts away from the life line into the Venus mount marks a close person losing sympathy and gradually passing out of one's life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.84, Plate XVI (m-m)
citation.quote: If the ray-line, rising at any point, in traveling with the life-line, retreats farther in on the Mount of Venus, thus away from the life, it indicates that the person with whom the woman is connected will more and more lose sympathy with her, and will eventually drift out of her life altogether

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के पास धुँधली होकर फिर उभरने वाली सहायक रेखा ऐसे प्रभाव का संकेत है जो उस बिंदु पर रुकता है और बाद में फिर लौटता है।
rules.meaning_en: An attendant line that fades beside the life line and then reappears marks an influence that stops at that point and later returns.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the attendant line fades out by the side of the life-line, but renews itself later, it tells that the person influencing the life will cease his influence at that particular point, but that it will be renewed again.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: द्वीप में बदलती प्रभाव रेखा ऐसे प्रभाव का संकेत है जो उस बिंदु से बदनामी या कलंक की ओर मुड़ जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that runs into an island marks an influence that turns toward disgrace or scandal from that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the ray-line, however, runs into an island or becomes one itself, it foretells that the influence over her life will run into disgrace, and that something scandalous will result.

rules.notes: Restated in Ch.XXI, p.129, for an attendant line on the Mount of Venus.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: लंबे पतले हाथ पर मंगल रेखा जीवन रेखा को सहारा देती है और उसे ख़तरनाक टूटनों के पार ले जाती है: वहाँ का कठिन दौर अतिरिक्त जीवन-शक्ति से पार होता है।
rules.meaning_en: On a long narrow hand the line of Mars supports the life line and carries it past its dangerous breaks: a hard patch there is weathered with extra vitality.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Its characteristics in such a hand are that it supports the life-line, carrying it past any dangerous breaks, and giving vitality to the nature.

rules.notes: The next sentence reads the break itself as 'closeness to death' before recovery; that clause is excluded.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जब तक मंगल रेखा जीवन रेखा के पास चलती है, वह कई झगड़ों और परेशानियों का दौर दिखाती है जो व्यक्ति के संघर्षशील स्वभाव को जगाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: While the line of Mars runs close beside the life line, tradition reads a period of many quarrels and annoyances that call out one's fighting spirit.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: It also denotes that while it runs close to the life-line the individual will be engaged in many quarrels, and will be subject to a great deal of annoyance which will bring all his martial or fighting qualities into play.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ स्वास्थ्य रेखा हाथ पार करके जीवन रेखा को छूती है, वहाँ से धीरे-धीरे सेहत को कमज़ोर करने वाली किसी भीतरी नाज़ुकता का संकेत माना जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the health line crosses the hand and touches the life line, tradition reads a hidden delicacy wearing down health, dated where they meet.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XIII, p.109, Plate XVII
citation.quote: When crossing the hand and touching the line of life at any point, it tells that there is some delicacy at work, undermining the health and constitution.

rules.notes: The chapter's claims that the meeting point is the climax of a disease, or the point of death, are excluded.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा के पास शुक्र की ओर छोटा क्रॉस उस समय के आसपास क़रीबी रिश्तेदारों से परेशानियों और झगड़ों का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A small cross on the Venus side lying close to the life line points to troubles and quarrels with close relatives around that time.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: but when very small and lying close to the line of life, it tells of troubles and quarrels with near relatives.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ जीवन रेखा दो भागों में बँटे, एक शुक्र के चारों ओर और दूसरा चंद्र पर्वत की जड़ की ओर, वहाँ जन्मभूमि छोड़कर दूसरे देश जाने जैसे बड़े बदलाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the life line divides, one branch round Venus and one to the base of the Moon mount, tradition reads a great move from one's native land to another.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: This indication is similar to that of the line of life dividing in the hand: if one branch goes around Venus, the other proceeding to the base of the Mount of Luna, it foretells that the subject will make some great change from his native land to another.

rules.notes: Ch.V, p.81 reads the same division at about the centre of the hand as a restless life with a great desire for travel, with no date.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से निकलकर उसके साथ-साथ चलने वाली बारीक रेखाएँ यात्राओं का संकेत देती हैं; समय वहीं से पढ़ा जाता है जहाँ वे निकलती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines that leave the life line and run on beside it mark journeys and voyages, dated where they leave.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XXV, p.139, Plate XXII (j)
citation.quote: There are two distinct ways of telling travels and voyages. One is from the heavy lines on the face of the Mount of Luna; the other, from the little hair-lines that leave the line of life but travel on with it (j, Plate XXII.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत से उतरकर जीवन रेखा तक आती रेखा अगर छोटे क्रॉस पर ख़त्म हो, तो उस बिंदु पर किसी गंभीर दुर्घटना से बाल-बाल बचने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A line falling from the Saturn mount to the life line and ending in a small cross marks a narrow escape from a serious accident at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XXV, pp.140-141, Plate XXII
citation.quote: it tells that the subject will have some narrow escape from serious accident.

rules.notes: The sentence begins on p.140 ('When such a line ends by a small cross, either on the line of life or without it'); quoted from p.141 because the running head between the pages would break the match.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत से जीवन रेखा तक आती सीधी रेखा उस बिंदु पर किसी तरह के ख़तरे का संकेत है, जहाँ सावधानी की ज़रूरत है।
rules.meaning_en: A straight line running from the Saturn mount to the life line marks a period of some danger, calling for care, dated where it meets the line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Any straight line from Saturn to the life-line means danger of some kind, but not so serious as from a line possessing the island either on Saturn or lower down.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा के साथ चलती सहायक रेखा उसे मज़बूत करती है; किसी टूटन पर पुल बनाकर उस बिंदु का ख़तरा घटाती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sister line beside the head line strengthens it, bridging any break so that the danger at that point is lessened.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.III, p.75, Plate XVI (a-a)
citation.quote: When an important line, such as the line of head or of life, is found with what is called a sister line (a-a, Plate XVI.), namely, a fine line running by its side, it is a sign that the main line is thus strengthened; consequently any break in the main line will be, as it were, bridged over by this mark, and the danger lessened or prevented.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र की ओर से आती कटी रेखा जब मस्तिष्क रेखा तक पहुँचे, तो वह ऐसे लोगों का संकेत है जो सोच को प्रभावित करते हैं और विचारों में दख़ल देते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A cross-line from the Venus side that reaches the head line points to people who sway one's thinking and interfere with one's ideas.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.83, Plate XVI (f-f)
citation.quote: When they reach the line of head (f-f, Plate XVI.), they indicate persons who will influence our thoughts and interfere with our ideas.

rules.notes: Dated on the life line: Cheiro gives the date of these cross-lines where they cut the life line (stated for the heart-line case on the same page).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: किसी कटी रेखा से मिलकर हाथ पार करने वाली प्रभाव रेखा किसी तीसरे के कारण प्रेम के शत्रुता में बदलने का संकेत है, जो मस्तिष्क रेखा को छूने के बिंदु पर मन को परेशान करती है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that joins a cross-line and runs over the hand marks an affection turned hostile through a third person, troubling the mind where it touches the head line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.84, Plate XIX (e-e)
citation.quote: When one of these attendant lines joins a cross-line and runs over the hand with it, it foretells that through the instrumentality of another the affection of the person influencing the life will change to hate, and that this will cause injury at whatever point it touch the life, the fate, the head, or the line of heart (e-e, Plate XIX.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से उठकर हृदय रेखा से मिलने वाली शाखा किसी गहरे आकर्षण या प्रेम का संकेत है, ऐसा समय जब तर्क और सावधानी पीछे छूट जाते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A branch rising from the head line to join the heart line marks a great fascination or affection, a time when reason and caution are set aside.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If a branch from the line of head rises up and joins the line of heart, it foreshadows some great fascination or affection, at which moment the subject will be blind to reason and danger.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: वर्ग में जाती या उससे गुज़रती मस्तिष्क रेखा उस बिंदु पर अपनी हिम्मत और सूझबूझ से दुर्घटना या हमले से बचाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A head line running into or through a square marks protection from an accident or attack at that point, through one's own courage and presence of mind.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line of head runs into or through a square, it indicates preservation from accident or violence by the subject's own courage and presence of mind.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा के ठीक ऊपर उसे छूता क्रॉस उस समय के आसपास सिर पर चोट के जोखिम का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross just above and touching the head line marks a risk of a knock or injury to the head around that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Above and touching the line of head, it foretells some wound or accident to the head.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत के नीचे मस्तिष्क रेखा के ऊपर उठता वर्ग उस बिंदु पर सिर को होने वाले किसी ख़तरे से बचाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A square rising above the head line under the Saturn mount marks protection from some danger to the head at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When rising above the line of head under Saturn, it foretells a preservation from some danger to the head.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: अच्छे बने वर्ग से गुज़रती मस्तिष्क रेखा काम या चिंता के भारी दबाव वाले समय का संकेत है, जिसमें मन सुरक्षित रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: A head line passing through a well-formed square marks a time of very heavy strain, of work or anxiety, through which the mind is kept safe.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line of head runs through a well-formed square, it is a sign of strength and preservation to the brain itself, and tells of some terrible strain of work or of anxiety at that particular moment.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र की ओर से आई द्वीप वाली रेखा जब मस्तिष्क रेखा तक पहुँचे, तो वह ऐसे प्रभाव का संकेत है जो प्रतिभा और इरादों को ग़लत दिशा में ले जाए।
rules.meaning_en: An island-bearing line from the Venus side that reaches the head line marks an influence steering one's talents and intentions the wrong way.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: when it runs to the line of head, some influence will direct the talents and intentions into some disgraceful channel;

rules.notes: Dated where the line crosses the life line (same passage).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा पर चमकीला लाल धब्बा उस समय के आसपास किसी चोट या गिरने से लगे झटके का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A bright red spot on the head line marks a shock or injury from a blow or fall around that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: A bright-red spot on the line of head indicates a shock or injury from some blow or fall.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा में मिलकर उस पर धब्बा, द्वीप या टूटन बनाने वाली यात्रा रेखा ऐसी यात्रा का संकेत है जिससे सेहत को जोखिम हो।
rules.meaning_en: A travel line that runs into the head line and marks it with a spot, island or break points to a journey that brings a risk to health, dated where they meet.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XXV, p.140, Plate XXII (h-h)
citation.quote: If the travel-line runs into the line of head and causes a spot, island, or break, it foretells some danger to the head, or some malady arising from such a journey

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत से मस्तिष्क रेखा तक आती रेखा किसी डर या झटके का संकेत है जिसे पहले से भाँपा जा सके; मस्तिष्क रेखा न टूटे तो कोई गहरा असर नहीं।
rules.meaning_en: A line from the Saturn mount reaching the head line marks a fright or shock seen coming in time, with no lasting harm unless the head line itself is broken.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: it denotes, as it were, that the person has time to foresee the dangers that approach, and such a mark indicates a fright and shock to the brain, but no serious results unless the line is injured or broken.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा को काटती रेखा सबसे क़रीबी रिश्तों में दख़ल का संकेत है; इसका समय वहाँ पढ़ा जाता है जहाँ वह जीवन रेखा को काटती है, हृदय रेखा पर नहीं।
rules.meaning_en: A cross-line that cuts the heart line points to interference in one's closest affections; the date is read where it cuts the life line, not the heart line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.83, Plate XVI (g-g)
citation.quote: When they reach and cut the line of heart (g-g, Plate XVI.), they denote interference in our closest affections, and here the date of such interference is given where the line cuts the life-line, and not where it touches the line of heart.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: किसी कटी रेखा से मिलकर हाथ पार करने वाली प्रभाव रेखा किसी तीसरे के कारण प्रेम के शत्रुता में बदलने का संकेत है, जो हृदय रेखा को छूने के बिंदु पर दिल को चोट पहुँचाती है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that joins a cross-line and runs over the hand marks an affection turned hostile through a third person, wounding the heart where it touches the heart line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.84, Plate XIX (e-e)
citation.quote: When one of these attendant lines joins a cross-line and runs over the hand with it, it foretells that through the instrumentality of another the affection of the person influencing the life will change to hate, and that this will cause injury at whatever point it touch the life, the fate, the head, or the line of heart (e-e, Plate XIX.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा में टूटन प्रेम में निराशा का संकेत है; उसकी जगह कारण बताती है: मध्यमा के नीचे भाग्य, अनामिका के नीचे अहंकार, कनिष्ठा के नीचे नासमझी।
rules.meaning_en: A break in the heart line marks a disappointment in love; its place tells the cause: fate under the middle finger, pride under the ring finger, folly under the little finger.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Breaks in the line tell of disappointment in affection — under Saturn, brought about by fatality; under the Sun, through pride; and under Mercury, through folly and caprice.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: इतनी नीचे कि मस्तिष्क रेखा की ओर झुक जाए, ऐसी हृदय रेखा जीवन के शुरुआती हिस्से में प्रेम में दुख का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A heart line lying so low that it droops toward the head line points to unhappiness in love during the early part of life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: The line lying so low that it droops down toward the line of head is a sure sign of unhappiness in affections during the early portion of the life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से हृदय रेखा तक उठती बारीक रेखाएँ उन लोगों का संकेत हैं जो प्रेम के मामलों में सोच को प्रभावित करते हैं; कटी हों तो परेशानी, साफ़ हों तो सहजता।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines rising from the head line to the heart line mark people who sway one's thoughts in love; crossed ones mark trouble, clear ones a smooth course.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Fine lines rising up to the line of heart from the line of head denote those who influence our thoughts in affairs of the heart, and by being crossed or uncrossed denote if the affection has brought trouble or has been smooth and fortunate.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ पहले रही हृदय रेखा धुँधली होकर मिट जाए, वहाँ प्रेम में गहरी निराशाओं का संकेत है जिनसे दिल सतर्क और ठंडा हो गया।
rules.meaning_en: Where a heart line that was once there has faded out, tradition reads deep disappointments in love that left the heart guarded and cool.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When, however, the line has been there, but has faded out, it is a sign that the subject has had such terrible disappointments in affection that he has become cold, heartless, and indifferent.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: वर्ग से गुज़रती हृदय रेखा उस बिंदु पर प्रेम या लगाव से आई किसी भारी परेशानी का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A heart line running through a square marks a heavy trouble brought on by love or attachment at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XX, p.127, Plate XXI (j)
citation.quote: When the line of heart runs through a square, it denotes some heavy trouble brought on by the affections.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र की ओर से आई द्वीप वाली रेखा जब हृदय रेखा तक पहुँचे, तो वह किसी बुरे प्रभाव का संकेत है जो रिश्तों में परेशानी और बदनामी लाए।
rules.meaning_en: An island-bearing line from the Venus side that reaches the heart line marks a harmful influence bringing trouble and shame into one's affections.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the same kind of line run to the line of heart, some bad influence will bring trouble and disgrace to the affections;

rules.notes: Dated where the line crosses the life line, as the preceding sentence says ('at that particular point will cross the life').

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से ऊपर उठती शाखाएँ जीवन के उस बिंदु पर शुरू किए गए कामों में सफलता का संकेत हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Branches rising from the fate line mark success in whatever is undertaken at that point in life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.III, p.76, Plate XVI (c-c)
citation.quote: and on the line of fate they show success in all undertakings made at that particular point,

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जो रेखा जीवन रेखा पार करके भाग्य रेखा से टकराए, वह काम या सांसारिक हितों में विरोध करने वालों का संकेत है; समय वहीं पढ़ा जाता है जहाँ वह भाग्य रेखा को काटती है।
rules.meaning_en: A line that crosses the life line and strikes the fate line points to people opposing one's work or worldly interests; the date is read where it cuts the fate line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.82, Plate XVI (e-e)
citation.quote: When they cross the life-line and attack the line of fate (e-e, Plate XVI.), they denote people who will oppose us in business or worldly interests, and where they cut the fate-line the point of junction gives the date.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: किसी कटी रेखा से मिलकर हाथ पार करने वाली प्रभाव रेखा किसी तीसरे के कारण प्रेम के शत्रुता में बदलने का संकेत है, जो भाग्य रेखा को छूने के बिंदु पर कामकाज को नुक़सान पहुँचाती है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that joins a cross-line and runs over the hand marks an affection turned hostile through a third person, harming one's affairs where it touches the fate line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.84, Plate XIX (e-e)
citation.quote: When one of these attendant lines joins a cross-line and runs over the hand with it, it foretells that through the instrumentality of another the affection of the person influencing the life will change to hate, and that this will cause injury at whatever point it touch the life, the fate, the head, or the line of heart (e-e, Plate XIX.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से आकर सीधी भाग्य रेखा से मिलने वाली शाखा किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति की कृपा का संकेत है, जो जुड़ने के बिंदु से करियर में मदद करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch from the Moon mount joining a straight fate line marks another person's favour, given out of fancy, helping the career from where it joins.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the line of fate be straight and a branch run in and join it from the Mount of Luna, it is somewhat similar in its meaning — it signifies that the strong influence of some other person out of fancy or caprice will assist the subject in his or her career.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से आई प्रभाव रेखा जब भाग्य रेखा के साथ आगे चले, तो उस बिंदु से धनी विवाह या साथ देने वाले प्रभाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line from the Moon mount that goes on beside the fate line marks a wealthy marriage or a supporting influence from that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XI, p.103, Plate XX (h-h)
citation.quote: On a woman's hand, if this ray-line from Luna travel on afterward by the side of the line of fate, it denotes a wealthy marriage or influence which accompanies and assists her

rules.notes: Cheiro reads it on a woman's hand.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से उठकर वहाँ से मज़बूत चलती भाग्य रेखा उस बिंदु से अपनी योग्यता के बल पर सफलता और धन का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line rising from the life line and strong from there on marks success and wealth won by one's own merit from that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the fate-line rise from the line of life and from that point on is strong, success and riches will be won by personal merit;

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: कलाई के पास नीचे से शुरू होकर जीवन रेखा से सटी भाग्य रेखा शुरुआती वर्षों को माता-पिता या रिश्तेदारों की इच्छाओं के अनुसार बिताने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line starting low near the wrist and held close beside the life line points to early years given over to the wishes of parents or relatives.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XI, p.103, Plate XX (g-g)
citation.quote: but if the line be marked low down near the wrist and tied down, as it were, by the side of the life-line, it tells that the early portion of the subject's life will be sacrificed to the wishes of parents or relatives

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से गुरु पर्वत की ओर जाती शाखा जीवन के उस पड़ाव पर असाधारण सफलता का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A branch thrown from the fate line toward the Jupiter mount marks unusual success at that stage of life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the line of fate should at any point throw a branch in that direction, namely, toward Jupiter, it shows more than usual success at that particular stage of life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जो भाग्य रेखा अपने पर्वत को पार करके गुरु पर्वत पर ख़त्म हो, वह जीवन के बाद के हिस्से में बड़ी सफलता का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that crosses its own mount to end on Jupiter points to success that grows great in the later part of life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the line of fate terminate by crossing its own mount and reaching Jupiter, success will be so great in the end that it will go far toward satisfying even the ambition of such a subject.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से मिलकर उसके साथ गुरु पर्वत तक जाती भाग्य रेखा प्रेम के माध्यम से सबसे बड़ी महत्वाकांक्षा पूरी होने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that joins the heart line and rises with it to Jupiter points to one's highest ambition fulfilled through love, from that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XI, p.104, Plate XIX (h-h)
citation.quote: when, however, it joins the line of heart and they together ascend Jupiter, the subject will have his or her highest ambition gratified through the affections

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जो भाग्य रेखा हथेली के बीच में देर से शुरू हो, वह जीवन के पहले हिस्से में कठिनाई का संकेत है; अगर आगे अच्छी चले, तो बाद का जीवन सहज होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that only begins high in the middle of the palm points to a hard, troubled first half of life; if it runs on well, the later years are smooth.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the line of fate does not rise until late in the Plain of Mars, it denotes a very difficult, hard, and troubled life; but if it goes on well up the hand, all difficulties will be surmounted, and once over the first half of the life all the rest will be smooth.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से उठती भाग्य रेखा लंबे संघर्ष के बाद अपनी प्रतिभा से देर से मिलने वाली सफलता का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that rises from the head line points to success won late in life, after hard struggle, through one's own talents.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: If the line of fate rise from the line of head, and that line be well marked, then success will be won late in life, after a hard struggle and through the subject's talents.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से उठती भाग्य रेखा कठिन संघर्ष के बाद बहुत देर से आने वाली सफलता का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that rises only from the heart line points to success that comes very late, after a difficult struggle.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When it rises from the line of heart extremely late in life, after a difficult struggle success will be won.

rules.notes: This sentence is in the fate-line chapter ('it' is the line of fate). The sun-line equivalent is sun-rise-from-heart-late (p.107).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा पर रुकी भाग्य रेखा जीवन के उस बिंदु पर किसी ग़लत फ़ैसले या भूल से सफलता रुकने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line stopped by the head line points to success blocked by a misjudgement or blunder at that point in life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When stopped by the line of head, it foretells that success will be thwarted by some stupidity or blunder of the head.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा पर अचानक रुकी भाग्य रेखा जीवन के उस बिंदु पर प्रेम या भावनाओं के कारण सफलता बिगड़ने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line stopped short by the heart line points to success spoiled through matters of the heart, at that point in life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line of fate is abruptly stopped by the line of heart, success will be ruined through the affections;

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा में साफ़ टूटन जीवन के उस बिंदु पर दुर्भाग्य और नुक़सान का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A clean break in the fate line marks misfortune and loss at that point in life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When there is a break in the line, it is a sure sign of misfortune and loss;

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ भाग्य रेखा का नया हिस्सा पुराने के ख़त्म होने से पहले शुरू हो जाए, वह जीवन में पूरे बदलाव का संकेत है, अक्सर मनचाही स्थिति की ओर।
rules.meaning_en: A break where the new piece of the fate line starts before the old one ends marks a complete change of life, often toward the position one wants.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XI, p.105, Plate XXI (a-a)
citation.quote: but if the second portion of the line begin before the other leaves off, it denotes a complete change in life, and if very decided it will mean a change more in accordance with the subject's own wishes in the way of position and success

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा पर क्रॉस उस बिंदु पर परेशानी का संकेत है, जिसे वर्ग जैसे ही स्थान-नियमों से पढ़ा जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross on the fate line marks trouble at that point, read by the same rules of place as the square.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: A cross is a sign of trouble and follows the same rules as the square,

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा पर द्वीप जितना लंबा हो, उतने समय तक दुर्भाग्य, नुक़सान और कठिनाई का दौर दिखाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the fate line marks a stretch of misfortune, loss and adversity for as long as it lasts.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XI, p.105, Plate XXI (d)
citation.quote: but an island in the line of fate is a mark of misfortune, loss, and adversity (d, Plate XXI.).

rules.notes: Restated in Ch.XXI, p.129: 'some heavy loss in worldly matters'.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से आई प्रभाव रेखा से जुड़ा भाग्य रेखा का द्वीप उस समय विवाह या किसी और रिश्ते जैसे प्रभाव से होने वाले नुक़सान का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the fate line joined by an influence line from the Moon mount marks loss caused by that influence, a marriage or another tie, at that date.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XI, p.105, Plate XXI (c)
citation.quote: It is sometimes marked with the line of influence from Luna, and in such a case means loss and misfortune caused by the influence, be it marriage or otherwise, which affects the life at that date (c, Plate XXI.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हथेली के बीच में भाग्य रेखा को छूता वर्ग उस समय दुर्घटना के जोखिम का संकेत है: जीवन रेखा की ओर हो तो घर में, चंद्र की ओर हो तो यात्रा में।
rules.meaning_en: A square touching the fate line in the middle of the palm marks a risk of accident around that time: at home on the life-line side, in travel on the Moon side.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XI, p.105, Plate XXI (b)
citation.quote: A square touching the line in the Plain of Mars (b, Plate XXI.) foretells danger from accident in relation to home life if on the side of the fate-line next the line of life; from accident in travel if on the side of the fate-line next the Mount of Luna.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा पर वर्ग उस बिंदु पर धन या व्यापार में नुक़सान से सुरक्षा का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A square on the fate line marks protection from loss in money or business at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: A square on the line of fate protects the subject from loss through money, business, or financial matters.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र की ओर से उठकर भाग्य रेखा में मिलने वाली मज़बूत रेखा, साफ़ विवाह रेखा के साथ, जुड़ने के बिंदु पर समृद्ध विवाह का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A strong line from the Moon side that runs up to join the fate line, with a clear marriage line, points to a wealthy union at the point where it joins.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XVI, p.115, Plate XX (h-h)
citation.quote: A wealthy union is shown by a strong, well-marked line from the side of the line of fate next Luna (h-h, Plate XX.), running up and joining the line of fate, when the marriage-line on Mercury is also well marked.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा के पास उसके साथ बराबर चलती प्रभाव रेखा विवाह का सबसे सुखद संकेत है, जुड़ने के बिंदु से।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line lying close to the fate line and running evenly with it is the happiest sign of marriage, from the point where it joins.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XVI, p.116, Plate XX (l-l)
citation.quote: The happiest mark of marriage on the line of fate is when the influence-line lies close to the fate-line and runs evenly with it

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से सीधी उठकर फिर भाग्य रेखा में मिलने वाली प्रभाव रेखा ऐसे विवाह का संकेत है जो गहरे प्रेम से ज़्यादा क्षणिक आकर्षण पर टिका हो।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that starts on the Moon mount and then runs into the fate line points to a marriage of passing fancy more than deep affection.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Luna and then runs up and into the fate-line, the marriage will be more the capricious fancy than real affection.

rules.notes: The sentence begins on p.115 ('When, however, the line of influence rises first straight on the Mount of'); the quote starts at the page turn because the running head between the pages would break the match.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से ज़्यादा मज़बूत प्रभाव रेखा ऐसे जीवनसाथी का संकेत है जो ज़्यादा शक्तिशाली और दृढ़ व्यक्तित्व वाला हो।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line stronger than the fate line it joins points to a partner of greater power and stronger individuality.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line of influence is stronger than the subject's line of fate, then the person the subject marries will have greater power and more individuality than the subject.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा के पास, उसके और जीवन रेखा के बीच क्रॉस करियर में रिश्तेदारों के विरोध और उससे आने वाले बदलाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross beside the fate line, between it and the life line, points to relatives opposing one's career and a resulting change of course.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: A cross by the side of the line of fate, and between it and the life-line in the Plain of Mars, denotes opposition in one's career by relatives, and means a change in the destiny;

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा के पास चंद्र की ओर क्रॉस उस समय किसी निराशाजनक यात्रा का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross beside the fate line on the Moon side points to a disappointing journey around that time.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: but lying on the other side of the hand next to Luna it relates to a disappointment in a journey.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा में मिलता क्रॉस उस बिंदु पर धन से जुड़ी निराशा का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross running into the fate line points to a disappointment in money at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Running into the line of fate, disappointment in money;

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: वर्ग से होकर गुज़रती भाग्य रेखा जीवन के किसी बड़े सांसारिक संकट, जैसे आर्थिक झटके, का संकेत है, जिससे रेखा आगे बढ़ने पर व्यक्ति उबर जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line running through a square marks one of life's great worldly crises, a financial blow, which one comes through if the line runs on.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line of fate runs through a well-formed square, it denotes one of the greatest crises in the subject's life in a worldly sense, connected with financial disaster or loss, but if the line goes right on through the square all danger will be averted.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शनि पर्वत के ठीक नीचे भाग्य रेखा को बाहर से छूता वर्ग उस बिंदु पर दुर्घटना से बचाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A square just touching the fate line directly under the Saturn mount marks protection from an accident at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When outside the line, but only touching it, and directly under the Mount of Saturn, it denotes preservation from accident.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र की ओर से आई द्वीप वाली रेखा जब भाग्य रेखा को रोक दे, तो जुड़ने के समय कोई बुरा प्रभाव सफलता में बाधा बनता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island-bearing line from the Venus side that runs into and bars the fate line marks a harmful influence blocking success at the date the lines join.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: and when it runs into and bars the line of fate, some evil influence will be a barrier to the success of the subject at the date at which the lines join each other.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ किसी लंबी यात्रा रेखा के स्तर पर भाग्य रेखा साफ़ तौर पर बेहतर हो जाए, वहाँ वह यात्रा या बदलाव समृद्धि लाता है।
