rules.meaning_en: Where the fate line changes clearly for the better at the same level as a long travel line, the move or journey brings prosperity.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line of fate shows a considerable and beneficial change at the same point, then these lines are prosperous and fortunate.

rules.notes: The travel lines here rise from the rascette into the Mount of Luna; the date is the fate line's own change 'at the same point'.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा में मिलकर उसके साथ ऊपर जाती यात्रा रेखाएँ ऐसी यात्राओं का संकेत हैं जो वास्तविक आर्थिक लाभ लाती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Travel lines that enter the fate line and rise with it mark journeys that bring real material benefit.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When they enter the line of fate and ascend with it, they denote travels that will materially benefit the subject.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत की यात्रा रेखाएँ जब भाग्य रेखा तक पहुँचें, तो वे लंबी और ज़्यादा महत्वपूर्ण यात्राओं का संकेत हैं, मिलने के बिंदु से।
rules.meaning_en: Travel lines from the Moon mount that reach the fate line mark longer and more important journeys, dated where they meet it.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XXV, p.140, Plate XXII (g-g)
citation.quote: When the horizontal lines on Luna cross the face of the mount and reach the line of fate, the journeys will be longer and more important than those indicated by the short, heavy lines also on that mount

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा को काटकर तोड़ने वाली रेखा दूसरों के दख़ल से प्रतिष्ठा को नुक़सान का संकेत है, अक्सर अफ़वाह या बदनामी के ज़रिए, उसी बिंदु पर जहाँ वे मिलती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A cross-line that cuts and breaks the sun line points to others harming one's standing, through gossip or scandal, at the point where they meet.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.83, Plate XVI (h-h)
citation.quote: When they cut and break the line of sun (h-h, Plate XVI.), they denote that others will interfere and spoil our position in life, and that the mischief will be caused by scandal or disgrace at the point of junction.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से उठती सूर्य रेखा उसकी सफलता बढ़ाती है और जिस समय से शुरू होती है तब से प्रतिष्ठा देती है; उसके बाद हालात बहुत सुधरते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line rising from the fate line adds to its success and brings distinction from the time it begins; from then on things improve greatly.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Rising from the line of fate, it increases the success promised by the line of fate, and gives more distinction from whatever date it is marked — from that time on things will greatly improve.

rules.notes: Cheiro dates on the life and fate lines; read at the junction on the fate line, and on the sun line's own scale where one exists.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से उठती सूर्य रेखा केवल अपनी प्रतिभा से मिलने वाली सफलता का संकेत है, जो जीवन के दूसरे हिस्से में आती है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line rising from the head line points to success earned by one's own talent alone, arriving in the second half of life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Rising from the line of head, there is no caprice of other people in connection with success, the talents of the subject alone being its factor, but not until the second half of life is reached.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से उठती सूर्य रेखा कला के प्रति गहरी रुचि और व्यावहारिक रूप से जीवन के बाद के हिस्से में ज़्यादा प्रतिष्ठा और प्रभाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line rising from the heart line points to a love of art and, in practical terms, more standing and influence late in life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Rising from the line of heart it merely denotes a great taste for art and artistic things, and looking at it from the purely practical standpoint it denotes more distinction and influence in the world at that late date in life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हथेली के बीच से शुरू होती सूर्य रेखा आँसुओं के बाद धूप, यानी कठिन दौर के बाद आने वाली सफलता का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line that begins in the middle of the palm points to sunshine after tears: success that follows a difficult time.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: Rising upon the Plain of Mars, it promises sunshine after tears, success after difficulty.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा पर द्वीप उतने समय तक पद और नाम की हानि का संकेत है जितना वह द्वीप लंबा है, अक्सर अफ़वाह या बदनामी से।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the sun line marks a loss of standing and good name for as long as the island lasts, often through gossip or scandal.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XII, p.108, Plate XXI (h)
citation.quote: An island on this line means loss of position and name for the length of time that the island lasts, and generally such will occur through scandal (h, Plate XXI.).

rules.notes: Restated in Ch.XXI, p.129.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा पर वर्ग उस बिंदु पर विरोधियों के हमलों से नाम और पद की सुरक्षा का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A square on the sun line marks protection of one's name and position against attacks by rivals at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XII, p.108, Plate XXI (g)
citation.quote: A square on the line of sun is a sign of preservation against the attacks of enemies in reference to one's name and position (g, Plate XXI.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा पर तारा सबसे शुभ चिह्नों में गिना जाता है: उस बिंदु से शानदार और स्थायी सफलता।
rules.meaning_en: A star on the sun line is counted among the finest signs: brilliant and lasting success from that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: A star on this line is perhaps the very finest sign that can be found.

rules.notes: Ch.XVIII, p.122 adds that a star formed by the sun line gives fame through talent and work in art, best placed a little above the middle of the line.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा के पास क्रॉस उस बिंदु पर पद या प्रतिष्ठा से जुड़ी निराशा का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross beside the sun line points to a disappointment in position or standing at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: By the side of the line of sun, disappointment in position.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हाथ पार करके विवाह रेखा को छूने वाली कटी रेखा वैवाहिक जीवन में गंभीर दरार, यहाँ तक कि अलगाव, का संकेत मानी जाती है; समय जीवन रेखा पर पढ़ा जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A cross-line that runs over the hand to touch the marriage line is read as a serious rift in marriage, even a parting, dated where it cuts the life line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.V, p.83, Plate XVII (h-h)
citation.quote: When the line crosses the hand and touches the line of marriage (h-h, Plate XVII.), it signifies divorce, and will occur to the person on whose hand it appears.

rules.notes: The book says 'divorce'; softened to a rift or parting. Dated on the life line by the rule Cheiro states for cross-lines on the same page.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: साफ़ विवाह रेखा विवाह का संकेत है, जिसका समय इस बात से पढ़ा जाता है कि रेखा हृदय रेखा और कनिष्ठा की जड़ के बीच कहाँ है।
rules.meaning_en: A clear marriage line marks a marriage, dated by where the line sits between the heart line and the base of the little finger.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: From the position of the marriage-line on the Mount of Mercury a very fair idea of the age at the time of marriage may also be obtained.

rules.notes: Cheiro adds that the fate or life line gives 'almost the exact date' (same page); the position ages are in S.cheiro-1897.marriage.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: बुध पर्वत पर छोटी रेखाएँ गहरे लगाव या ऐसे विवाह का संकेत हैं जिस पर विचार हुआ पर हुआ नहीं; विवाह केवल लंबी रेखाएँ दिखाती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Short marks on the Mercury mount mark a deep affection or a marriage considered but not entered into; only long lines mark marriages.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XVI, p.115, Plate XVIII (g, h)
citation.quote: Only the long lines relate to marriages (g, Plate XVIII.); the short ones to deep affection or marriage contemplated (h, Plate XVIII.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: दो टुकड़ों में टूटी विवाह रेखा उस बिंदु पर वैवाहिक जीवन में अचानक आए विच्छेद का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A marriage line broken in two marks a sudden break in married life at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line breaks in two, it denotes a sudden break in the married life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: हथेली के बीच की ओर झुके दोफाड़ पर ख़त्म होती विवाह रेखा उस विवाह में आगे चलकर अलगाव का संकेत मानी जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: A marriage line that ends in a drooping fork toward the middle of the palm is read as a parting of ways, a formal separation, late in that marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XVI, p.116, Plate XIX (j)
citation.quote: When the line divides at the end into a drooping fork sloping toward the center of the hand, it tells of divorce or a judicial separation (j, Plate XIX.).

rules.notes: The book says 'divorce or a judicial separation'; softened to a separation.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: साफ़ विवाह रेखा से हृदय रेखा की ओर गिरती बारीक रेखाएँ जीवनसाथी की ख़राब सेहत से आने वाली परेशानी का संकेत हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Fine hair-lines dropping from a clear marriage line toward the heart line mark trouble brought by a partner's poor health during that marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line of marriage is distinct, but with fine hair-lines dropping from it toward the line of heart, it foretells trouble brought on by the illness and bad health of the person the subject marries.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: विवाह रेखा पर द्वीप वैवाहिक जीवन में बड़ी परेशानी और उतने समय तक अलग रहने का संकेत है जितना वह द्वीप लंबा है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the marriage line marks a period of great trouble in married life, with time apart for as long as the island lasts.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When the line has an island in the center or at any portion, it denotes some very great trouble in married life, and a separation while the island lasts.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य पर्वत और सूर्य रेखा तक शाखा भेजने वाली विवाह रेखा किसी प्रतिष्ठित या प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति से विवाह का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A marriage line that sends an offshoot onto the Sun mount and into the sun line points to marrying someone of distinction.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: into the line of sun, it tells that its possessor will marry some one of distinction, and generally a person in some way famous.

rules.notes: The sentence begins on p.116 ('When the line of marriage sends an offshoot on to the Mount of Sun and'); quoted from the page turn.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: पर्वत के ऊपर से नीचे आकर विवाह रेखा को काटने वाली गहरी रेखा उस विवाह में बड़ी रुकावट और विरोध का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A deep line growing down from the top of the mount to cut the marriage line points to great obstacles and opposition to that marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XVI, p.117, Plate XVIII (i)
citation.quote: When a deep line from the top of the mount grows downward and cuts the line of marriage, there will be a great obstacle and opposition to such marriage (i, Plate XVIII.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: नीचे मुड़कर सूर्य रेखा को काटने वाली विवाह रेखा उस विवाह के कारण पद या प्रतिष्ठा में कमी का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A marriage line that bends down and cuts the sun line points to a loss of position through that marriage, also dated where it cuts the sun line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XVI, p.117, Plate XXI (i-i)
citation.quote: When, on the contrary, it goes down toward and cuts the line of sun, the person on whose hand it appears will lose position through marriage (i-i, Plate XXI.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: विवाह रेखा के साथ-साथ लगभग उसे छूती बारीक रेखा विवाह के बाद पैदा हुए किसी गहरे लगाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A fine line running beside and almost touching the marriage line marks a deep new affection that arises after marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.quote: When there is a fine line running parallel with and almost touching the marriage-line, it tells of some deep affection after marriage on the side of the person on whose hand it appears.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Cheiro's Language of the Hand
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र की ओर से आई द्वीप वाली रेखा जो जीवन रेखा पार करके विवाह रेखा तक पहुँचे, विवाह में बदनामी लाने वाले बुरे प्रभाव का संकेत है; समय जीवन रेखा पर पढ़ा जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island-bearing line from the Venus side that crosses the life line to the marriage line marks a harmful influence bringing shame to the marriage, dated where it crosses the life line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Language of the Hand
citation.loc: Part II Ch.XXI, p.129, Plate XVIII (r)
citation.quote: A line forming an island and crossing the hand from the Mount of Venus to the line of marriage foretells that an evil influence at that particular point will cross the life and bring disgrace to the marriage (r, Plate XVIII.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से उठती हर रेखा उस समय के लक्ष्य के लिए किए गए विशेष प्रयास का बिंदु है; ऐसी कई रेखाएँ अधिक ऊर्जा वाले जीवन को दिखाती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Each line rising from the life line marks a point of particular effort toward the purpose of that moment; many of them show a life of greater energy.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the Line of Life is found with a number of ascending lines, even if they are small, it denotes a life of greater energy; and the dates at which these lines ascend from the Line of Life may always be considered points at which the subject has made a particular effort towards whatever may have been the special purpose of his destiny at that moment.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: अपना रास्ता खुद बनाने और रोकने वाले लोगों या हालात से मुक्त होने का दृढ़ प्रयास; इसकी तिथि भाग्य रेखा पर उस जगह के सामने पढ़ी जाती है जहाँ यह रेखा जीवन रेखा से निकलती है।
rules.meaning_en: A determined effort to make one's own way and break free of the people or circumstances that hold one back; the date is read on the fate line opposite where the line leaves the life line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.III Ascending Lines, Plate X position 3, p.42
citation.quote: The date of this start towards the Line of Fate will be given on the Line of Fate itself, right opposite where this line begins to grow from the Line of Life. This mark will denote that the subject has made a determined effort at that moment in his career to make his own destiny, and to break free from the circumstances or people that surround him or tie him down.

rules.notes: Cheiro reads a second date on the life line itself and expects a repetition at almost double the age (his example: twenty-six, then fifty-two, pp.42-43).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से गुरु पर्वत की ओर उठती रेखा ऊपर उठने की महत्वाकांक्षा से किए गए प्रयास का संकेत है, विशेषकर दूसरों पर अधिकार पाने की ओर।
rules.meaning_en: A line rising from the life line toward Jupiter marks an effort driven by ambition to rise, especially toward authority over others.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.III Ascending Lines, Plate X position 1, p.42
citation.quote: When these lines are seen ascending towards or on the Mount of Jupiter (1-1, Plate X.), it indicates the desire and ambition to rise in life, especially in some way that would give the subject control or authority over others.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा पर रुकने वाली उठती रेखा: अच्छी शुरुआत वाला प्रयास किसी गलत निर्णय के कारण अधूरा रह जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A rising line stopped at the head line: an effort that began well is cut short by an error of judgement.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.III Ascending Lines, Plate X position 2, p.42
citation.quote: If one of the lines be found partly arrested or stopped at the Line of Head (2-2, Plate X.), it indicates that the subject has by some mental error of judgment or stupidity, broken or prevented the effort, which started well, from reaching a successful termination.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा पर रुकने वाली उठती रेखा: उसके साथ शुरू हुए प्रयास में भावनाएँ और प्रेम-संबंध बाधा डालते हैं।
rules.meaning_en: A rising line that stops at the heart line: the affections interfere with the effort it began.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: If one of these lines reaches and stops at the Line of Heart, it indicates that the affections have, or will, interfere with the subject's special effort in whatever direction this line indicates.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से शनि की ओर अलग चलती रेखा, जो भाग्य रेखा से नहीं मिलती, भाग्य की दूसरी धारा का संकेत है; यह भाग्य रेखा पर सामने पढ़ी तिथि से शुरू होती है और रेखा अच्छी हो तो सफलता तक पहुँचती है।
rules.meaning_en: A line crossing toward Saturn on its own, not joining the fate line, marks a second course of destiny; it begins at the date read opposite on the fate line and, if the line is good, reaches success.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.III Ascending Lines, Plate X position 6, p.43
citation.quote: When the ascending line is seen crossing over towards the Mount of Saturn, and running as an independent line not joined to the Line of Fate (6, Plate X.), it will be found that the subject has carried out a kind of second fate. The date when this line left the Line of Life will give the first date of its commencement, i.e., opposite it on the Fate Line.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: शुक्र पर्वत पर जीवन रेखा के साथ चलती पतली रेखाएँ निकट भावनात्मक प्रभावों को दिखाती हैं; वे जितनी दूर साथ चलें, प्रभाव उतना टिकता है, और उनकी जगह से उसका समय पढ़ा जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines running beside the life line on the Mount of Venus mark close emotional influences; how far they run beside it shows how long the influence lasts, and their place gives its date.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.VIII cont. Influence Lines on the Mount of Venus, Plate XVIII position 11, pp.79-80
citation.quote: As such an Influence Line runs parallel with the Life Line, or turns away from it, so it can be judged how long such an influence will last, and with fair accuracy the date when it will occur (for dates see page 113).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से निकलकर चंद्र पर्वत की ओर मुड़ती पतली रेखाएँ यात्राओं का संकेत हैं; जीवन रेखा पर उनके निकलने की जगह से यात्रा का समय पढ़ा जाता है।
rules.meaning_en: Fine lines leaving the life line and bending toward the Mount of the Moon mark journeys; where they leave the life line gives the time of travel.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.XIV Travels, Voyages and Accidents, Plate XXI position 2, p.97
citation.quote: When these fine lines of travel are seen on the Line of Life, by referring to the map showing dates (Plate XXVI.), it may be possible to obtain a very clear idea of when these travels take place.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से निकली यात्रा रेखा अगर छोटे क्रॉस पर ख़त्म हो तो ऐसी यात्रा का संकेत है जिसका अंत निराशा में होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A travel line from the life line ending in a small cross points to a journey that ends in disappointment.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When a travel Line from the Line of Life ends in a small cross the journey undertaken will end in disappointment (4, Plate XXI).

rules.notes: The mark is at the travel line's far end; the date is where the travel line leaves the life line.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: द्वीप पर ख़त्म होने वाली यात्रा रेखा ऐसी यात्रा का संकेत है जिसका अंत नुकसान में होता है।
rules.meaning_en: A travel line ending in an island points to a journey that ends in loss.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the Line ends in an island, the journey will end in loss (5, Plate XXI.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: वर्ग पर ख़त्म होने वाली यात्रा रेखा उस यात्रा में ख़तरे और उससे बच निकलने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A travel line ending in a square points to danger on that journey, and escape from it.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the Line ends in a square, there will be great danger to the subject on such a journey, but he will escape, as the square is a sign of preservation from danger.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा पर द्वीप उस हिस्से में नाज़ुक सेहत या कमज़ोरी के दौर की ओर इशारा करता है जहाँ वह दिखता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the life line points to a period of delicacy or poor health over the stretch where it appears.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.XV The Island, Plate XXII position 1, p.101
citation.quote: On the Line of Life it shows delicacy or illness at that particular date where it appears (1, Plate XXII.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा पर धब्बा उस बिंदु पर सेहत में अचानक आई, पर अस्थायी रुकावट का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A spot on the life line marks a sudden, passing check to health at that point.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: The Spot is a sign of temporary arrest of the qualities of any Line on which it may be found. On the Line of Head, shock or injury. (9, Plate XXII.) On the Line of Life, sudden illness.

rules.notes: The head-line clause (shock or injury) is excluded; only the life-line reading is kept, framed as a passing check.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा पर वर्ग सुरक्षा का चिह्न है: जिस बिंदु पर वह है, वहाँ किसी गंभीर ख़तरे से बच निकलना।
rules.meaning_en: A square on the life line is a mark of protection: an escape from serious danger at the point where it appears.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.XVI The Square, Plate XXII position 13, p.106
citation.quote: The Square (13, Plate XXII.) is usually called the Mark of Preservation. It shows escape from dangers at that particular moment where it appears. When on the Line of Life it means preservation from death.

rules.notes: The book's 'preservation from death' is kept as protection from danger (safety policy).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा के आरंभ में, पहली उंगली के नीचे द्वीप, ऐसे शुरुआती वर्षों की ओर इशारा करते हैं जब मन नाज़ुक था और पढ़ाई या आगे बढ़ने की इच्छा कम थी।
rules.meaning_en: Islands at the start of the head line, under the first finger, point to early years when the mind was delicate, with little drive or wish to study.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When these islands are found at the commencement of the line under the first finger or Mount of Jupiter (3, Plate IV.), it will be found that the subject in early life was delicate mentally, and displayed no energy of will; no desire to study, was listless and without ambition.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ सीधी मस्तिष्क रेखा नीचे की ओर मुड़ती है, वहाँ व्यक्ति कम व्यावहारिक और अधिक कल्पनाशील होने लगता है; परंपरा इसे अक्सर ऐसा समय मानती है जब सुख-सुविधा ने कलात्मक पक्ष को बढ़ने दिया।
rules.meaning_en: Where a straight head line curves downward, the person tends to grow less practical and more imaginative; tradition often reads it as a time when greater ease let the artistic side grow.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.II Changes in the Line of Head, Plate V position 3, pp.26-27
citation.quote: If one were examining a straight Line of Head and noticed a curve downward or a fine line growing downwards from it (3-3, Plate V.), the natural interpretation of such a mark would be that at that date in the person's career he had become less practical, or for the time being developed the more imaginative qualities of the mentality.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ ढलान वाली मस्तिष्क रेखा ऊपर की ओर मुड़ती है, वहाँ मन पर असामान्य दबाव आता है; साफ़ मोड़ हो तो व्यक्ति अपने स्वभाव के विपरीत भी व्यावहारिक सोच अपनाकर उससे ऊपर उठता है।
rules.meaning_en: Where a sloping head line bends upward, the mind meets an unusual strain; a clear bend shows the person rising to it with a practical, businesslike outlook, even against their nature.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.II Changes in the Line of Head, Plate V position 1, p.26
citation.quote: if a sloping Line of Head at any point in its track seems to curve or slightly bend upwards (1-1, Plate V.), it indicates that about that period of the person's life some unusual strain will be forced upon him.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से ऊपर उठती पतली रेखा ऐसे दौर का संकेत है जो स्वभाव पर स्थायी छाप छोड़ता है — अक्सर एक व्यावहारिक पक्ष, जो बाद में भी बढ़ता रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: A fine line rising from the head line marks a period that leaves a lasting stamp on the character, often a practical side that keeps growing afterwards.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.II Changes in the Line of Head, Plate V position 2, p.26
citation.quote: If, however, instead of the curve or bend a fine line is seen leaving the Head Line in an upward direction (2-2, Plate V.), that period will leave a definite mark on the subject's entire character for the remainder of his life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: सीधी मस्तिष्क रेखा से नीचे की ओर निकलती पतली रेखा ऐसे समय का संकेत है जब व्यक्ति कम व्यावहारिक और अधिक कल्पनाशील हुआ, अक्सर तब जब समृद्धि ने संघर्ष कम कर दिया था।
rules.meaning_en: A fine line growing downward from a straight head line marks a time of becoming less practical and more imaginative, often when prosperity had eased the struggle.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.II Changes in the Line of Head, Plate V position 3, pp.27-28
citation.quote: In this latter case, curiously enough, it often denotes that the person had at that period of his life become more wealthy or prosperous

rules.notes: Cheiro makes the prosperity reading firm only if a sun line appears at about the same date (p.28).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ भाग्य रेखा जीवन रेखा से अलग होकर हथेली में निकलती है, वह स्वतंत्र होने या अपना चुना हुआ काम शुरू करने का वर्ष है — करियर की सबसे अहम तिथियों में से एक।
rules.meaning_en: Where the fate line breaks away from the life line into the palm marks the year of asserting independence or launching into one's chosen work, among the most important dates of the career.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.V Rising from the Line of Life, Plate XI position 2, p.50
citation.quote: Another striking and important point is that the date or years marked on the Line of Fate of such a breaking out into the palm, will be found to coincide with the year in the subject's life in which he asserted his independence or launched out into what he more particularly wanted to do.

rules.notes: The years before the break-out 'will be cramped and difficult' under family plans (p.50).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत से आकर भाग्य रेखा के साथ-साथ चलती, पर उसमें न मिलने वाली प्रभाव रेखा: किसी का प्रभाव जो उतने ही समय रहता है जितनी दूर यह रेखा साथ चलती है; उनका जीवन अलग रहता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line from the Mount of the Moon running beside the fate line without blending: another person's influence that lasts only as long as the line runs alongside, their life staying separate.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When this line of influence from the Mount of the Moon does not, however, blend with the Fate Line (2-2, Plate XII.), it denotes that the other person's life will always remain distinct, and the influence will last only for the length of time that it runs by the side of the subject's Fate.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से गुरु पर्वत की ओर निकलती शाखा: ज़िम्मेदारी, नेतृत्व या ऊँचा पद, जो उस जगह से मिलना शुरू होता है जहाँ से शाखा निकलती है।
rules.meaning_en: An offshoot from the fate line toward Jupiter: responsibility, command or a high position that begins to be realised from where it leaves the line.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: If such a line be seen approaching or going towards Jupiter (6-6, Plate XI.) it denotes responsibility, power of command over others, or some high position which will commence to be realised from the date when the offshoot leaves the Line of Fate.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से बुध पर्वत की ओर निकलती शाखा: जहाँ से यह निकलती है, वहाँ से सफलता विज्ञान या व्यापार में किसी विशेष उपलब्धि की ओर झुकती है।
rules.meaning_en: An offshoot from the fate line toward Mercury: from where it leaves the line, success leans toward a special achievement in science or commerce.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: If the offshoot goes towards the Mount of Mercury (8-8, Plate XI.), the success it indicates will be more in the direction of some special achievement either in science or commerce.

rules.notes: Dated from where the offshoot leaves the fate line, as for the Jupiter offshoot (p.52).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से सूर्य पर्वत की ओर निकलती शाखा: जहाँ से यह निकलती है, वहाँ से सफलता धन और सार्वजनिक जीवन की ओर मुड़ती है, नाम भी मिलता है।
rules.meaning_en: An offshoot from the fate line toward the Mount of the Sun: from where it leaves the line, success turns toward wealth and public life, with renown.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: If this offshoot ascends towards the Mount of the Sun (7-7, Plate XI.) the success will be in the direction of riches and public life, which will give great publicity or renown; this is also a magnificent sign of success.

rules.notes: Dated from where the offshoot leaves the fate line, as Cheiro states for the Jupiter offshoot just before (p.52).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ भाग्य रेखा हृदय रेखा पर रुक जाती है, वहाँ गलत जगह लगी भावनाओं के कारण करियर बिगड़ने की प्रवृत्ति रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the fate line stops at the heart line, the career tends to be spoilt through affections badly placed.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the Line of Fate appears to be stopped by the Line of Heart, the career will always be ruined through or by the affections being badly placed.

rules.notes: An event at a position on the fate line, dated by Cheiro's fate scale (Ch.XIX, Plate XXVI); the book's 'always ruined' is softened to a tendency.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से उठने वाली भाग्य रेखा जीवन में देर से, और अपनी बुद्धि के बल पर, फल देती है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line rising from the head line brings its rewards late in life, and through one's own intellect.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the Line of Fate rises from the Line of Head and when it is well marked, everything will come to the subject late in life and only then by his own brains.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: हथेली के बीच में ऊपर से शुरू होने वाली भाग्य रेखा कठिन शुरुआती जीवन और लक्ष्य के लिए लंबे संघर्ष की ओर इशारा करती है; वहाँ से मज़बूती से उठे तो व्यक्ति अपना भाग्य खुद बनाता है।
rules.meaning_en: A fate line that first appears high in the middle of the palm points to a hard early life and a long fight to gain one's ends; rising strongly from there, one builds one's own fortune.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.V Rising from the Middle of the Palm, p.55
citation.quote: When the Line of Fate only makes its appearance far up in the centre of the palm, in what is called the Plain of Mars, it indicates a hard early life and that the subject must always have a hard fight to gain his ends

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जहाँ भाग्य रेखा मस्तिष्क रेखा पर रुकती है, वहाँ अपनी ही गलत समझ से करियर बिगड़ने की प्रवृत्ति रहती है।
rules.meaning_en: Where the fate line stops at the head line, the career tends to be spoilt by one's own misjudgement.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the Line of Fate appears to be stopped by the Line of Head (4-4, Plate XII.), it foretells that his career will be spoiled by the subject's own stupidity or mental foolishness.

rules.notes: Dated by where the fate line stops on Cheiro's fate scale (Ch.XIX, Plate XXVI).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: टूटन, जहाँ नई रेखा पुरानी के ख़त्म होने से पहले शुरू हो जाए: माहौल और पद में पूरा बदलाव; नई रेखा अच्छी हो तो जहाँ से वह शुरू होती है वहीं से उन्नति।
rules.meaning_en: A break where the new line begins before the old one ends: a complete change of surroundings and position; if the new line is good, an advancement from where it first appears.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: A break in the Fate Line is not always a bad sign to have, provided that one side begins before the other ends; in such a case it foretells a complete change in surroundings and position, and if the new line looks good and straight it will be found to mean that the change will bring about an advancement in position commencing at the date when the second line first makes its appearance.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा के साथ चलकर उसे पार करती हुई मंगल की ओर जाने वाली प्रभाव रेखा ऐसे प्रभाव का संकेत है जो विरोधी बनकर करियर को नुकसान पहुँचाता है।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that runs beside the fate line and then crosses it toward Mars points to an influence that turns hostile and harms the career.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.V Influence Lines, Plate XIV position 1, p.57
citation.quote: When one of these influence lines appears by the side of the Fate Line and crosses through it towards or on to the Mount of Mars, it indicates that the influence thus shown will turn to hate and will injure the career of the person on whose hand it is found (1-1, Plate XIV.).

rules.notes: Dated where it crosses the fate line (Cheiro dates influence lines at their junction with the fate line, p.57).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा से आकर मिलने वाली या उसके साथ आगे चलने वाली छोटी रेखा आमतौर पर मिलने के बिंदु पर विवाह का संकेत देती है; न मिले तो लगाव रहता है, विवाह नहीं।
rules.meaning_en: A small line joining the fate line, or running on with it, usually marks marriage at the point where they join; if they never join, the affection stays without marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.V Influence Lines, Plate XIII position 3, p.57
citation.quote: When any small line joins the Fate Line or goes on with it as an attendant line, such a mark usually indicates marriage at the date when these lines join (3-3, Plate XIII.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: मंगल पर्वत से विवाह रेखा की ओर उठती रेखाएँ विवाह में दूसरों के दख़ल का संकेत हैं; तिथि वहाँ पढ़ी जाती है जहाँ वे भाग्य रेखा को काटती हैं, और मंगल से आने वाली झगड़े लाती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Lines crossing the hand from Mars toward the marriage line mark people interfering with the marriage; the date is where they cross the fate line, and those from Mars bring quarrels.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: All lines that cross the hand from the Mount of Mars (6, Plate XVII.), and rise up towards the Line of Marriage denote the interference of people with the marriage. These lines give the date of the interference when they cross the Line of Destiny; they cause quarrels when they come from Mars

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: जब प्रभाव रेखा भाग्य रेखा से मज़बूती से मिले और लगभग उसी समय साफ़ विवाह रेखा भी हो, तो विवाह की तिथि मिलने के बिंदु से अधिक ठीक पढ़ी जाती है।
rules.meaning_en: When an influence line joins the fate line strongly and a clear marriage line appears at about the same time, the marriage is dated more exactly by where the influence line joins.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.VIII cont., Plate XVIII position 7, p.77
citation.quote: If the Line of Influence is very strong where it joins the Fate Line, and if at about the same date a clear Marriage Line is seen on the Mount of Mercury, the date of marriage may be more accurately predicted by the place on the Fate Line where the Influence Line joins it.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: प्रभाव रेखा के मिलने के बाद भाग्य रेखा कमज़ोर या अनिश्चित दिखे तो वह संबंध भलाई या सफलता नहीं लाया।
rules.meaning_en: If the fate line looks weaker or less certain after an influence line joins it, the union has not brought good or success.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: If the Line of Fate looks weaker or more uncertain after the union is marked, then such a marriage has not brought good or success to the subject.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: प्रभाव रेखा के मिलने के बाद भाग्य रेखा मज़बूत हो तो वह संबंध लाभदायक सिद्ध होता है; उसी समय सूर्य रेखा भी दिखे तो और अधिक।
rules.meaning_en: If the fate line grows stronger after an influence line joins it, the union proves an advantage; more so if a sun line appears at the same time.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: If, on the contrary, the Line of Fate looks better or stronger after the Influence Line has joined it, then this union will prove of advantage to the person whose hand is being examined.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा को काटकर अंगूठे की ओर निकलने वाली प्रभाव रेखा ऐसे लगाव का संकेत है जो कम टिकता है और कम सुखी रहता है; दोनों रेखाएँ जितनी दूर हों, वर्षों के साथ जीवन उतने अलग।
rules.meaning_en: An influence line that cuts through the fate line to the thumb side points to an affection that lasts less long and is less happy; the wider the two lines part, the more the two lives diverge over the years.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.VIII cont., Plate XVIII position 7, p.79
citation.quote: If the Influence Line should cut through the Fate Line, and appear on the thumb side of it, the affection will seldom last as long, or be so happy (7, Plate XVIII.). If a still wider separation of the Influence Line and the Fate Line appear as these two lines ascend the hand together, the separation of interests and destiny of the two persons will be still more marked as the years proceed.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा पर द्वीप भारी सांसारिक नुकसान, चिंता और अपने रास्ते को लेकर बेचैनी के दौर का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the fate line points to a period of heavy worldly loss, worry and anxiety about one's path.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.loc: Ch.XV The Island, Plate XXII position 4, p.101
citation.quote: On the Line of Fate, heavy loss in worldly matters, worry, and anxiety about the subject's destiny (4, Plate XXII.).

rules.notes: Dated by the island's place on the fate line (the chapter dates the life-line island 'at that particular date where it appears'; Ch.XIX dates the fate line).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: भाग्य रेखा पर वर्ग उस बिंदु पर नुकसान से बचाव का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A square on the fate line marks preservation from loss at the point where it appears.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: It shows escape from dangers at that particular moment where it appears. When on the Line of Life it means preservation from death. (13, Plate XXII.) On the Line of Fate, preservation from loss

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा जहाँ से दिखाई देने लगती है, वहाँ से जीवन अधिक उज्ज्वल, समृद्ध और महत्वपूर्ण होने लगता है।
rules.meaning_en: From wherever the sun line appears, life tends to grow brighter, more prosperous and more important.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: From whatever date in the hand the Line of Sun appears, things become brighter, more prosperous and important.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा से उठने वाली सूर्य रेखा बौद्धिक प्रयास से सफलता देती है, पर जीवन का मध्य बीत जाने के बाद।
rules.meaning_en: Rising from the head line, the sun line gives success through mental effort, but only after the middle of life is past.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: Rising from the Line of Head, the Sun Line gives success from the mental efforts and qualities, but not until after the middle of life is past.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा से उठने पर सफलता जीवन में देर से, प्रेम और संबंधों के ज़रिए आती है — अक्सर देर से सुखी विवाह और अंत में सुख-सुविधा।
rules.meaning_en: Rising from the heart line, success comes late in life through the affections, often with a happy marriage late in life and eventual ease and comfort.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: From the Line of Heart, success will come late in life in some way depending on, or through, the affections. In such cases it generally promises a very happy marriage late in life, but it is always a certain sign of eventual ease, happiness, and worldly comfort.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: केवल अपने पर्वत पर बनी सूर्य रेखा सुख और सफलता का वादा करती है, पर जीवन में बहुत देर से।
rules.meaning_en: A sun line marked only on its own mount promises happiness and success, but very late in life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: Marked only on its own Mount, the Line of Sun promises happiness and success, but so late in life as to make it hardly worth having.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: सूर्य रेखा पर द्वीप पद और सफलता को घटाता है, पर केवल उतने हिस्से में जहाँ वह है; परंपरा इसे सार्वजनिक बदनामी के दौर से जोड़ती है।
rules.meaning_en: An island on the sun line takes away position and success, but only for the stretch where it appears; tradition links it with a period of public scandal.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: An "island" on any part of the Line of the Sun destroys the position and success promised, but only during the period where the island appears (5, Plate XV.). In nearly all cases it denotes public scandal,

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा के पास स्थित गहरी विवाह रेखा जीवन में जल्दी विवाह का संकेत देती है।
rules.meaning_en: A deep marriage line lying close to the heart line points to marriage early in life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the deep line is found lying close to the line of Heart, the marriage will take place early in life

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: विवाह रेखा की शुरुआत में द्वीप लंबी देरी और वैवाहिक जीवन के आरंभ में पति-पत्नी के काफ़ी समय दूर रहने का संकेत देता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island at the start of the marriage line points to a long delay, and to the couple being much apart early in the marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the line has an "island" at the beginning, then the marriage will be for a long time delayed, and the two persons will be much separated at the commencement of their married life.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: विवाह रेखा के अंत की ओर द्वीप विवाह के बाद वाले दौर में परेशानी और अलगाव का संकेत देता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island toward the end of the marriage line points to trouble and separation in the later part of the marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the "island" is found towards the end of the line, the marriage will most probably end in trouble and separation one from the other.

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: विवाह रेखा के बीच में द्वीप वैवाहिक जीवन के मध्य में बड़ी परेशानी और अलगाव का संकेत देता है।
rules.meaning_en: An island about the middle of the marriage line points to great trouble and separation around the middle of married life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the "island" is found about the middle of the Marriage Line, some great trouble and separation will take place about the middle of the married life (3, Plate XVIII.).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: अन्यथा अच्छी विवाह रेखा के बीच में टूटन सुखी वैवाहिक जीवन में किसी गंभीर दरार का संकेत देती है।
rules.meaning_en: A break about the centre of an otherwise good marriage line points to a serious rupture in a happy married life.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When the line, which is otherwise well marked, appears about the centre to break in two, it foreshadows a fatality or break-up in an otherwise happy married life.

rules.notes: The book offers 'a fatality or break-up'; only the break-up is kept (safety policy).

rules.author: Cheiro
rules.work: Palmistry for All
rules.meaning_hi: विवाह रेखा के ठीक ऊपर पास में स्थित हल्की रेखा विवाह के बाद जीवन में किसी नए प्रभाव के आने का संकेत है।
rules.meaning_en: A slighter line lying close above the marriage line points to an influence that enters the life after the marriage.

citation.text: Cheiro — Palmistry for All
citation.quote: When there is another line much slighter in appearance lying close to the upper side of the Marriage Line, it foretells some influence that will come into the subject's life after marriage.

rules.author: Dale
rules.work: Indian Palmistry
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से कलाई की ओर जाती छोटी रेखाएँ पैसों की तंगी और भरोसे के लोगों से धोखा मिलने के दौर की ओर इशारा करती हैं।
rules.meaning_en: Little lines leaving the life line toward the wrist point to a period of money trouble and of being let down by those one relies on.

citation.text: Dale — Indian Palmistry
citation.loc: Sec. The Line of Life; Time of Events, p.40
citation.quote: These little lines running the opposite way towards the wrist denote poverty, deceit, unfaithful servants. Little confused hair lines in this line signify diseases.

rules.notes: Dated by Dale's Time of Events (wrist-up). 'Deceit, unfaithful servants' is softened to being let down by those one relies on.

rules.author: Dale
rules.work: Indian Palmistry
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से मस्तिष्क रेखा की ओर उठती छोटी शाखाएँ धन और सम्मान की ओर इशारा करती हैं, उस आयु में जो रेखा पर उनकी जगह बताती है।
rules.meaning_en: Little branches from the life line reaching toward the head line point to riches and honour, at the age their place on the line gives.

citation.text: Dale — Indian Palmistry
citation.loc: Sec. The Line of Life; Time of Events, p.40
citation.quote: Little branches in the upper part branching towards the Liver line signify riches and honour. These little lines running the opposite way towards the wrist denote poverty, deceit, unfaithful servants.

rules.notes: Dated by Dale's Time of Events, which reads the life line from the wrist up (S.dale-1895.life).

rules.author: Dale
rules.work: Indian Palmistry
rules.meaning_hi: जीवन रेखा से अनामिका की ओर जाती रेखा किसी की कृपा से मिलने वाले सम्मान या लाभ की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A line passing from the life line toward the ring finger points to honours or gain through someone's favour.

citation.text: Dale — Indian Palmistry
citation.loc: Sec. The Line of Life; Time of Events, p.43
citation.quote: A line passing from the line of Life to the ring finger promises honours to follow by means of a lady of rank, or gain through favour.

rules.author: Dale
rules.work: Indian Palmistry
rules.meaning_hi: तर्जनी के नीचे अपने सिरे पर सामान्य से मोटी जीवन रेखा परिश्रम भरे बाद के जीवन की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A life line thicker than usual at its end under the forefinger points to a hard-working later life.

citation.text: Dale — Indian Palmistry
citation.loc: Sec. The Line of Life, p.43
citation.quote: The line of Life thicker than ordinary at the end under the forefinger shows a laborious old age.

rules.notes: Consistent with Dale's wrist-up reading: the end under the forefinger is old age.

rules.author: Dale
rules.work: Indian Palmistry
rules.meaning_hi: चंद्र पर्वत के पास या उस पर मस्तिष्क रेखा पर तारा — 'दरिद्रता का चिह्न' — बुढ़ापे में पैसों की तंगी की ओर इशारा करता है।
rules.meaning_en: A star on the head line near or on the Mount of the Moon, the 'cross of indigence', points to money trouble in old age.

citation.text: Dale — Indian Palmistry
citation.loc: Sec. References to Hand — No. 25, Cross of Indigence, pp.17-18
citation.quote: Name. — Cross of Indigence. Location. — A star on the Liver line or natural mean, near or on mount of the Moon. Interpretation. — Poverty in old age.

rules.author: Dale
rules.work: Indian Palmistry
rules.meaning_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा के सिरे को काटती छोटी रेखा बुढ़ापे में पैसों की तंगी की ओर इशारा करती है।
rules.meaning_en: A small line cutting the head line at its end points to money trouble in old age.

citation.text: Dale — Indian Palmistry
citation.quote: If cut at the end by a small intervening line, it threatens poverty in old age.

rules.notes: Dale's Liver line is the head line; the KB encodes this same passage on lines.health (PALM-DALE-079).

rules.author: Dale
rules.work: Indian Palmistry
rules.meaning_hi: हृदय रेखा में उलझी छोटी रेखाएँ कमज़ोर सेहत के दौर की ओर इशारा करती हैं: कनिष्ठा के नीचे हों तो आरंभिक जीवन में, अनामिका के नीचे प्रौढ़ अवस्था में, मध्यमा के नीचे बुढ़ापे में।
rules.meaning_en: Confused little lines in the heart line point to a period of poor health: under the little finger in early life, under the ring finger in the prime of life, under the middle finger in old age.

citation.text: Dale — Indian Palmistry
citation.loc: Sec. The Line of Fortune, p.47
citation.quote: Confused little lines in the line of Fortune denote sickness, and if under Mercury, in the first age; under the mount of the Sun in manhood; under the middle finger in old age.

rules.notes: Dale gives named life stages, not years (S.dale-1895.heart is unanchorable); the age window comes from other authors' heart scales, and she reads from the percussion side, the opposite way to Benham.
